jobs.title: Senior UX / Digital Product Designer (Mensch), Schwerpunkt FinTech
jobs.description:
Wir suchen eine:n in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit, im Frankfurter Raum oder mit hoher Reisebereitschaft einen Senior UX / Digital Product Designer (Mensch) mit Schwerpunkt FinTech, der:die den gesamten Prozess digitaler Produktentwicklung souverän beherrscht und Projekte in dynamischen Kontexten und Projektumfeldern eigenverantwortlich führen kann und sowohl strategisch als auch operativ auf Senior-Niveau agiert.

Taikonauten entwickelt digitale Produkte, Services und Plattformen für Organisationen aus Branchen wie Finance, FinTech, Mobility sowie Industrial & Manufacturing. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, ihre digitalen Angebote im Kontext von digitaler Transformation, Produktinnovation und Acceleration strategisch und nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Dabei arbeiten wir explorativ, konzeptionell tief und mit hohem gestalterischem Anspruch – immer mit starkem Fokus auf Nutzerzentrierung.

Unser Anspruch ist es, Produkte von der ersten Problemdefinition bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung im Markt zu begleiten. Neben fachlicher Expertise ist uns vor allem der menschliche Match wichtig. Wenn du Begeisterung für digitale Produktentwicklung mitbringst und aktiv an anspruchsvollen Projekten mitwirken möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Deine Mission

Du führst digitale Produktentwicklungen mit konzeptioneller Klarheit, methodischer Sicherheit und gestalterischer Exzellenz. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe und zunächst unklare Problemstellungen, triffst fundierte Designentscheidungen und argumentierst diese gegenüber Kund:innen und internen Teams. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung – nicht nur für Screens, sondern für Produktqualität, Nutzerzentrierung und Projektdynamik. Du verbindest Business-Ziele mit echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und führst Projekte von der Discovery-Phase bis zur Validierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kund:innen, Entwickler:innen und interdisziplinären Teams zusammen und setzt Qualitätsmaßstäbe in UX, Visual Design und konzeptioneller Klarheit.

Aufgaben

  • Verantwortung für den gesamten UX- und Product-Design-Prozess (Discovery bis Delivery)

  • Strukturierung unscharfer Problemstellungen (Problem Framing, Scope, Hypothesen)

  • Einbringung deiner fachlichen Perspektive und deines Beratungsstils in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen

  • Entwicklung tragfähiger UX-Konzepte für komplexe digitale Produkte

  • Erstellung von Informationsarchitekturen, User Journeys und End-to-End-Flows

  • Übersetzung von Anforderungen in testbare UX-Spezifikationen

  • Planung und Durchführung qualitativer Research-Formate (Interviews, Tests, Workshops)

  • Strukturierte Synthese von Insights und Ableitung belastbarer Empfehlungen

  • Konzeption und Ausarbeitung visuell hochwertiger UI-Designs und Design-Systeme

  • Moderation von Workshops zur Projektinitialisierung, Zielbilddefinition und Priorisierung

  • Argumentative Vertretung von UX- und Designentscheidungen gegenüber Stakeholdern

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Development-Teams während der Umsetzung

  • Eigenständige Strukturierung komplexer Projektphasen

Qualifikation

Erfahrung & Kompetenz

  • Langjährige Erfahrung im UX / Product Design (5+ Jahre)

  • Mehrjährige Agenturerfahrung mit parallelen Projekten und wechselnden Kunden

  • Fundierte Expertise in fachlich-strategischer UX-Konzeption

  • Nachweisbare End-to-End-Erfahrung in digitaler Produktentwicklung

  • Fundierte Expertise in User Research und quantitativer/qualitativer Analyse

  • Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Hypothesen abzuleiten und zu validieren

  • Sehr hoher Anspruch an visuelle Qualität (Layout, Typografie, Design-Systeme)

  • Strategisches Verständnis von Digital Strategy und Service Design

  • Souveräne Moderation auf Deutsch (mindestens B2, idealerweise C1)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma

Arbeitsweise & Haltung

  • Systemisches Denken und strukturierte Problemanalyse

  • Fähigkeit, Unsicherheit produktiv zu strukturieren

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Selbstorganisation

  • Belastbarkeit in dynamischen Projektumfeldern

  • Fähigkeit, Prioritäten eigenständig zu setzen

  • Anspruch, Designqualität aktiv zu vertreten und zu verteidigen

  • Offenheit und Interesse an KI-Tools sowie KI-gestützten Prozessen und Workflows

  • Bereitschaft, Verantwortung über die reine Designrolle hinaus zu übernehmen

  • Reisebereitschaft über mehrere Tage mit Übernachtungen, auch spontan

Gern gesehen, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen B2B- oder Enterprise-Plattformen

  • Data Analyse-Erfahrung (Analytics, Conversion-Optimierung)

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Frameworks (Scrum, SAFe o.ä.)

  • Grundverständnis technischer Architektur (APIs, Frontend-Strukturen)

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder der Skalierung von Design-Systemen

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools, sowie Arbeit mit KI-gestützten Prozessen und Workflows

  • Internationale Projekterfahrung

Benefits

Was wir für dich haben

  • Passionierte Kolleg:innen in einer offenen Unternehmenskultur mit flacher Hierarchie

  • Berufliche und persönliche Weiterbildung, gefördert und gefordert

  • Raum für Eigenverantwortung und eigene Ideen

  • Flexible und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten

  • Ein leidenschaftliches Team, das die soziale und umweltbewusste Zukunft aktiv mitgestaltet

Wie es weitergeht

Du hast Lust, große Schiffe für die digitale Zukunft fit zu machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf dein Portfolio und Lebenslauf oder dem Link zu deiner Website und deine Wünsche für deine berufliche Zukunft zusammen mit uns und einem Hallo.

Bitte verrate uns in deinem Anschreiben, wann du zur Verfügung stehen würdest, zu wievielen Wochenstunden und was dein gehaltswunsch ist.

Wenn wir neugierig auf mehr werden

Dann freuen wir uns auf viele Fragen von dir und ein gutes Kennenlernen.
Denn bei einem ersten positiven Eindruck sprichst du kurz mit Nancy. Im zweiten Gespräch lernst du die Teamleitung kennen. Das dritte Gespräch findet dann mit der Geschäftsführung statt.
Uns ist bewusst, dass das ein langer Weg sein kann, uns ist aber auch wichtig, dass es am Ende ein volles Ja von dir wird, nachdem du die Chance hattest, alle Ebenen deines zukünftigen Wirkens bei den Taikonauten kennenzulernen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Stationär väktare till Securitas Örebro
jobs.description: FöretagsbeskrivningSecuritas har en viktig roll i samhället och förvaltar ett av Sveriges viktigaste uppdrag - att skydda och hjälpa människor att känna sig trygga. Nu har du chansen att bli en del av Sveriges största säkerhetsföretag. Oavsett om du vill jobba mycket eller lite, dag eller natt så behöver vi bli fler.Som landets största arbetsgivare i vår bransch kan vi erbjuda dig utvecklingsmöjligheter och variation som få andra företag kan. Vi strävar efter ett enhetligt ledarskap med balans mellan förväntningar och förutsättningar.Securitas Sverige krigsplacerar sin personal. Detta innebär i korthet att du som anställd kommer, i händelse av krig, ha kvar din anställning och arbetsledas av Securitas.Du tar hand om människors säkerhet – Securitas tar hand om dig.JobbeskrivningSom stationärväktare är du kundmedveten och deras ansikte utåt. Här levererar du trygghet genom att vara uppmärksam och se till att allt är i sin ordning.Vi bedriver verksamhet dygnet runt, årets alla dagar, och söker nu en stationär väktare på heltid för nattjänstgöring. I rollen ansvarar du för att genomföra ronderingar inom objektet för att identifiera avvikelser, brister och säkerhetsrisker kopplade till kundens skalskydd och verksamhet.Under nattpassen, när lokalerna är tomma, är det särskilt viktigt att vara uppmärksam, observant och snabbt kunna agera vid händelser som avviker från det normala. Arbetet utförs självständigt, vilket ställer krav på ansvarstagande, gott omdöme och förmåga att fatta egna beslut. jobs.description: Le Centre Hospitalier Sèvre et Loire recrute un Praticien Hospitalier contractuel en SMRLe Centre Hospitalier Sèvre et Loire, établissement public de santé situé en Loire-Atlantique, recherche un Praticien Hospitalier contractuel pour rejoindre son service de Soins Médicaux et de Réadaptation (SMR) sur le site du Loroux-Bottereau.À propos du Centre Hospitalier Sèvre et LoireLe Centre Hospitalier Sèvre et Loire est un établissement de proximité organisé autour de deux sites hospitaliers et d'une Maison d'Accueil Spécialisée (MAS) :- Site de Vertou : 30 lits de médecine, 30 lits de SMR, 27 lits d'USLD et 155 lits d'EHPAD.- Site du Loroux-Bottereau : 59 lits de SMR, 28 lits d'USLD et 107 lits d'EHPAD.- Maison d'Accueil Spécialisée (MAS) : 50 lits.Le posteLe praticien rejoindra l'équipe médicale du SMR du Loroux-Bottereau, composée de 3,5 équivalents temps pleins médicaux.Le service de SMR dispose de 59 lits, répartis entre deux secteurs :- 20 lits de SMR polyvalent ;- 39 lits de SMR gériatrique.Le service accueille des patients présentant des pathologies variées, notamment :- suites d'hospitalisation en médecine ;- pathologies orthopédiques ;- oncologie ;- neurologie et suites d'AVC ;- soins palliatifs, avec 6 lits identifiés de soins palliatifs (LISP).Vos principales missionsLe praticien assure notamment :- le suivi médical et clinique quotidien des patients qui lui sont confiés ;- la coordination de leur prise en charge avec l'ensemble de l'équipe pluridisciplinaire ;- la participation aux synthèses pluriprofessionnelles ;- la participation aux réunions et aux différentes démarches institutionnelles, notamment celles relatives à la qualité et à la sécurité des soins ;- plus largement, la participation à la vie et au fonctionnement du service et de l'Etablissement. Conditions d'exercice- Participation à la continuité des soins le samedi matin, de 9h à 13h, sur le site du Loroux-Bottereau, à raison d'environ un samedi sur cinq.- Participation à la Permanence Des Soins (PDS) sous forme d'astreintes opérationnelles à domicile, avec disponibilité téléphonique et déplacement si nécessaire, sur les deux sites de Vertou et du Loroux-Bottereau :o une nuit de semaine du lundi au vendredi, environ tous les 8 à 10 jours ;o un week-end d'astreinte, en moyenne un week-end sur sept.Conditions de recrutement- Poste ouvert à un Praticien Hospitalier titulaire ou contractuel.- Temps partiel à 80 %.- Pour un temps plein : 25 jours de congés annuels (CA) et 19 jours de RTT par an.- Conditions de rémunération selon le statut et l'expérience du praticien.Date de prise de posteLe poste est à pourvoir à compter du 1er janvier 2027, avec possibilité d'adapter ces dates en fonction des disponibilités du candidat.Vous souhaitez rejoindre une équipe médicale dynamique et contribuer à une prise en charge de proximité, pluridisciplinaire et personnalisée des patients en SMR ?Nous serons heureux d'échanger avec vous sur le poste, son organisation et vos attentes.Pour toute question ou pour candidater :Monsieur Christophe PRESSE, Directeur.

jobs.title: Helpdesk Agent
jobs.description:
Will You Help Us Bring the Future to the Table?

We think you might.

If you’re hungry to make an impact- to move quickly, build smart, and help shape the future of an entire industry- you might be exactly who we’re looking for.

At Munu, we’re on a mission to transform how restaurants and bars run, grow, and thrive. We blend a deep love for food and tech with bold ambition — creating tools that simplify operations, elevate guest experiences, and empower hospitality teams to perform at their best.

We move fast- and we mean it. We’d rather try something, learn from it, and improve, than sit on the fence for too long. You’ll feel that from day one.

We challenge ideas, not people. We share wins. And because we work directly with restaurants every day, you’ll see the real-world impact of what you build.

If you like what you read, pull up a chair.

About the Role

When a venue’s tills stop, the evening doesn’t wait. As a Helpdesk Agent at Munu, you’re the first voice restaurants and bars hear when something isn’t working, and your job is to get them back to trading, fast.

You’ll handle first-line calls, tickets and chats from venues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark and Finland. You’ll solve what can be solved at first contact, escalate cleanly what can’t, and help reduce how many problems reach us in the first place.

You’ll work closely with our Product Support & Quality Specialists, who pick up your escalations; our Account Managers, whose customers you’re helping; and our Hardware & Logistics Specialist, on hardware faults and replacements.

Your Mission, Should You Choose to Accept It

  • Answer and resolve first-line calls, tickets and chats from venues across our Nordic markets, getting it right at first contact wherever you can.

  • Get to the real problem: establish what’s happening, how urgent it is for the customer’s service, and whether first line can fix it.

  • Escalate a diagnosed problem, along with what you’ve already tried, rather than a forwarded message, and raise potential major incidents to the Helpdesk Manager without delay.

  • Keep customers informed while an issue is being resolved by someone else.

  • Help reduce what arrives: guide customers to our self-service and help content, and flag recurring questions and missing or incorrect help content, with evidence, to our specialists and Product Managers.

  • Keep accurate ticket records in Zendesk and make handovers easy for colleagues to pick up.

  • Work to a rota that follows the hours venues trade, which may include shifts outside normal office hours, plus occasional travel for team gatherings, training and venue visits.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You…

  • Stay calm and friendly with a customer whose venue can’t trade.

  • Ask the right questions to find the real problem before acting.

  • Own a case until it’s resolved or cleanly handed over.

  • Write clear, accurate notes that a colleague can pick up without asking.

  • Have experience in customer support or customer service (for example first-line support, retail or hospitality), including troubleshooting technical or operational problems for customers under time pressure.

  • Have completed upper secondary education or a trade certificate, or at least 2 years of experience in customer service, customer support or hospitality.

  • Have experience at Munu with at least one of: supporting Munu customers by phone, ticket or chat; Munu Cloud Core (MCC) or Munu POS as used in venues; Munu’s hardware (terminals, printers, kitchen displays or in-venue networks); or onboarding, training and go-lives of Munu customers.

  • Communicate professionally in English, spoken and written. You’ll work across every function and with customers in several countries.

  • Use approved AI tools in your daily work, check what they produce, and protect customer data.

Bonus points if you…

  • Have worked in hospitality operations, such as a restaurant, bar or hotel.

  • Have experience with POS or payment systems.

  • Speak Norwegian and more than one Scandinavian language, since contacts come from venues across the Nordics.

  • Know Zendesk and Munu’s escalation routines to second line.

  • Have spotted recurring issues or gaps in help content and done something about it.

  • Have built an AI-supported routine or tool that colleagues use.

What Success Looks Like

  • Most of your contacts are resolved at first line, and they stay resolved.

  • Customers get answers quickly, and they rate your service well. Speed only counts when customers are served well.

  • Your escalations are accepted by second line first time, with nothing missing.

  • Recurring questions get fewer, because customers know where to find help and gaps in help content get fixed.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

  • You’ll grow with us. This role has real room to develop- into product support, implementation, or hardware and logistics, or towards handling our most complex contacts and helping train colleagues. You don’t need to have it all figured out from day one; we’ll help you get there.

  • You’ll be part of a company with deep industry knowledge and a mission that matters- empowering hospitality teams with better tools.

  • You’ll shape how a core business function is built- not just follow a playbook. We’re at a stage where your input genuinely changes how things work.

  • You’ll work with smart, kind, ambitious people across the Nordics- the kind who disagree openly, share the credit, and don’t take themselves too seriously.

  • You’ll have the freedom to test, fail, learn, and try again- with the support and tools to do your best work.

Who We Are

Munu is a Norwegian scale-up rethinking how restaurants and bars operate- and thrive. Since 2016, we’ve helped over 2,000 hospitality venues run smarter with our Munu Cloud platform, integrating everything from POS and Booking to Inventory and Payments. Our customers range from local gems to national brands, and our reach is growing fast across the Nordics.

Backed by strong investors and built by a team that lives and breathes hospitality, we’re committed to growing sustainably- without compromising trust, creativity, or simplicity. The best part? You’ll see the results of your work in the real world- in the restaurants and bars people actually love.

At Munu, we empower our customers- and we empower our people. How we work matters just as much as what we achieve. Michelin-star ambition, kitchen-team spirit. We move fast and hold high standards, but we also give feedback with care, celebrate each other’s wins, and make sure the best idea wins regardless of where it comes from.

If you’re curious about joining us, take a moment to read our Cultural Principles before you apply. They’ll give you a sense of who we are and the kind of culture you’ll be part of. Sound like the kind of place you’d do your best work? We’d love to hear from you.

Let’s bring the future to the table, together.

souhaité, PERMIS B obligatoire, EXPERIENCE : 3 ans minimum sur un poste similaire.APTITUDES PROFESSIONNELLES-SAVOIR ETRE :Profil manuel, autonome, organisé, minutieux et débrouillard avec une bonne jobs.title: RESPONSABLE BILLETTERIE ET DEVELOPPEMENT (H/F)
jobs.description: QUI NOUS SOMMES ? Treenity Group est un groupe indépendant du spectacle vivant : un comedy club (The Joke,deux salles à Paris), une activité de production et de tournées, du management d'artistes,un organisme de formation certifié Qualiopi, et Connecticket, notre plateforme debilletterie B2B.Connecticket est en pleine montée de charge : de plus en plus de productions et de sallesnous confient la diffusion de leurs spectacles. Nous cherchons la personne qui va portercette croissance, au croisement de l'opérationnel billetterie et du développementcommercial.LE POSTEVous êtes le premier titulaire opérationnel de la fonction Connecticket. Vous portez toutela chaîne, de la mise en vente à la relation client, jusqu'au développement du portefeuille deproductions partenaires. Concrètement, trois dimensions :Production billetterie. Vous créez et paramétrez les séances (tarifs, quotas, jauges), mettezen vente les représentations confiées par les productions, suivez les ventes et ajustez lesquotas sur nos deux salles et sur les spectacles partenaires. Une partie de la gestion desquotas sera progressivement automatisée par notre application interne Flow.Relation productions. Vous êtes l'interlocuteur des productions partenaires sur toute ladurée de la relation : suivi, reporting, gestion des situations sensibles (annulations, reports,remboursements, réclamations), opérations de visibilité, fidélisation et montée en volumedes comptes.Développement commercial. jobs.title: POPSYKKEL søker kokk
jobs.description:
POPSYKKEL er en is, kaffe og sandwichbar i Elverum. Åpnet våren 2023, og har siden den gang rukket å bli en liten institusjon i byen. Vi er på utkikk etter flere folk, i ulike stillingsprosenter, men først og fremst en kokk som kan gå inn i et 100 % vikariat fra mars - august.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en engasjert og selvstendig kokk, eller person med annen relevant erfaring. Du har interesse for mat, jobber effektivt og har lyst til å skape gode opplevelser for gjestene våres.

Potensielt kan den ansatte være med å utvikle, drifte serveringsstedet videre. Derfor vil erfaring med personal, timelister, innkjøp osv, også være av interesse.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Varierer fra forberedelser og produksjon på kjøkken, kundebehanding, kaffetilberedning, betjening av kasse, renhold.

Hovedsaklig dagtid, men også noe kveldsarbeid fredag og lørdag.

Vi tilbyr

Gunstige arbeidstider. Åpningstider fra 11-16 dagtid, og 19-00 fredag og lørdag.

Bli en del av et lite team der veien er kort fra idè til utførelse, og der man kan bidra til å utvikle og forme bedriftens framtid.

Mulighet for både fast ansettelse, og større ansvarsområder.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Is/kaffe/sandwich bar i Elverum. Fokuserer på hjemmelaget, fersk og lokal mat.

  • Integrate motion graphic design and colour correction to deliver cohesive final outputs

  • Experiment rapidly with new AI models, tools, and techniques, incorporating them into production workflows and sharing skills with the rest of the team

  • Align with your Content Lead’s creative direction while maintaining a high degree of autonomy in execution and technical decision-making

  • Continuously refine workflows for efficiency, scalability, and output quality


Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • 4–6+ years of experience in video production, VFX, or digital art, with a strong portfolio (AI-driven video work is a must)

  • Hands-on experience with the latest AI video tools and models (e.g., Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse, and similar emerging options)

  • Solid understanding of AI image/video generation pipelines, including prompting, batching, consistency techniques, and post-processing

  • Experience with traditional tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar for final assembly and polish

  • Strong grasp of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, and cinematic language

  • Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across sequences in AI-generated content


Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaboration skills (fluent in English)

🎯 High ownership — able to take ideas from concept to completion independently

⚡️ Experimental mindset — comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving tools

⏱️ Fast iteration cycles — able to test, fail, refine, and improve quickly

🧠 Curious and self-driven — constantly exploring new AI capabilities and workflows

🧢 Open to feedback and continuous improvement

🍭 #NSFW — Comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit adult content


Bonus Points

  • Experience in AI-native storytelling or filmmaking

  • Background in 3D, VFX, technical art or as a colourist

  • Familiarity with training/customizing models (LoRAs, embeddings, fine-tuning)

  • Prior experience in adult, dating, or adjacent creative industries a huge bonus

  • Experience with ComfyUI

  • Experience with Stable Diffusion / AUTOMATIC1111 and related tooling (Advanced prompting, working with trained LoRAs, refining, upscaling, inpainting etc.)

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineering Manager, Startups | Core
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Applied AI Engineering team partners closely with customers to help them move from experimentation to production with OpenAI’s technologies. We act as trusted technical advisors, working across customer strategy, architecture, deployment, and adoption to help organizations realize meaningful impact from frontier AI.

The Startups segment serves fast-moving, high-growth companies that are often building new products, workflows, and businesses directly on top of AI. These customers move quickly, operate with high ambiguity, and expect practical, creative, and technically rigorous partnership.

About the Role

We are looking for an Applied AI Engineering Manager, Startups to lead and scale the Startups Applied AI Engineering motion. This team helps high-growth startups move quickly from experimentation to production, unlock meaningful usage, and build durable technical partnerships with OpenAI.

This leader will operate in a high-velocity customer segment where founders, CTOs, and technical teams expect speed, judgment, and hands-on problem-solving. They will balance team leadership, technical depth, customer prioritization, and cross-functional influence across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and broader go-to-market teams.

In this role, you will define how OpenAI supports startup customers at scale: identifying where deep technical engagement can unlock outsized impact, building repeatable deployment mechanisms, and ensuring the team can serve a broad and dynamic customer base without losing quality or strategic focus.

In this role, you will:

  • Craft and continuously refine the strategic vision and operating model for the Startups Applied AI Engineering team, aligning it with OpenAI’s broader company objectives and the evolving needs of high-growth startup customers.

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of high-performing technical ICs supporting startup customers across AI-native, developer-led, and product-led companies.

  • Help startups move from early experimentation to production usage by identifying technical blockers, advising on architecture, and driving practical paths to deployment.

  • Partner closely with Sales to determine where technical engagement can accelerate adoption, production usage, and long-term account growth.

  • Represent the technical voice of startup customers by synthesizing high-signal feedback, especially around developer experience, product gaps, deployment blockers, model performance, and emerging use cases.

  • Translate recurring startup needs into repeatable playbooks, starter packs, reference architectures, internal tooling, and customer-facing assets that help the broader team move faster.

  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point for priority startup customers, including founder-, CTO-, and technical executive-level conversations.

  • Balance urgent customer needs with OpenAI’s broader product and platform priorities, especially when startups request niche features, bespoke support, or accelerated roadmap changes.

  • Coach Applied AI Engineers on technical quality, customer judgment, prioritization, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership.

  • Partner across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and other GTM teams to improve how OpenAI supports startups from early adoption through scaled production usage.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have proven experience founding, scaling, or operating within early-stage startups, ideally in technical leadership roles where you owned both product or customer outcomes and technical execution.

  • Have a strong track record of building and leading technical, customer-facing teams in high-growth, ambiguous, or startup-heavy environments.

  • Bring strong technical depth across APIs, platform products, AI/ML systems, developer workflows, and production deployment considerations.

  • Have experience creating scalable operating models, not just managing one-off customer escalations.

  • Are comfortable working directly with founders, CTOs, technical executives, and highly technical ICs.

  • Demonstrate strong judgment about when to go deep for a strategic customer versus when to build repeatable mechanisms for the broader segment.

  • Can translate complex technical and product considerations into clear decisions, practical guidance, and customer-facing recommendations.

  • Operate with speed, iteration, and pragmatic customer impact without sacrificing quality, safety, or OpenAI’s long-term platform strategy.

  • Are personally committed to fostering the safe and beneficial development of AI.

Success will be measured by:

  • A strong cadence of successful customer sprints and production-oriented technical engagements.

  • Strong Product and Research feedback loops informed by startup customer needs and emerging use cases.

  • Increased startup account usage, including tokens, requests, and production workloads.

  • High-quality customer stories, founder and CTO satisfaction, and referenceable startup wins.

  • Creation of repeatable startup deployment patterns, starter packs, templates, and reference architectures.

  • A healthy, high-performing team with strong prioritization, clear operating mechanisms, and the ability to scale coverage across a high-demand segment.


About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

Your Role

Now, we’re scaling again, and the next hires will shape what EverAI looks like at 100+ people. As our third Talent Acquisition Specialist, you’ll be central to that build, as you’re joining at a defining stage.

You’ll work closely with our CEO, Alexis, and partner with leaders across the business to help assemble the team behind one of the fastest-growing AI products globally. We hire internationally and across every function of the company, with a strong focus on tech, bringing together people from leading tech hubs around the world.

You’ll also have the opportunity to influence how Talent Acquisition evolves as we grow: refining our internal workflows, experimenting with new AI tools, launching employer branding initiatives, testing sourcing strategies that keep our quality bar high, and so on.

Key Mission

Identify, attract, and land top global talent, while helping build a recruitment stack that matches the scale and ambition of a company serving 50M users worldwide.

Talent Mapping & Sourcing:

  • Global Talent Scouting: Help map and engage elite talent from Tier 1 tech hubs and companies worldwide. You’ll identify and connect with candidates who aren’t actively applying through thoughtful outreach and strong networking.

  • Smart Sourcing: Support the implementation of an AI-first recruitment stack. You’ll use tools, from AI agents to niche technical communities and unconventional channels, to help us find exceptional talent

  • Relationship Building: Maintain long-term relationships with passive talent globally to ensure we stay ahead of hiring needs as we continue scaling

  • World-Class Candidate Experience: Own the candidate journey from the first discovery call to the final close. Ensure every interaction with EverAI, whether candidates join us or not, is clear, respectful, and high-quality

  • Interviews and Screenings: Conduct structured interviews to assess technical aptitude and cultural alignment, and provide concise, actionable summaries for Hiring Managers and Leadership

Process Innovation & Collaboration:

  • Hiring Operations: Work closely with Founders and Team Leads to improve hiring workflows, remove friction, and strengthen how we operate as we grow past 100+ employees

  • Employer Branding and other Initiatives: Contribute to creative initiatives and content that position EverAI as the #1 destination for the world’s best AI talent

Your Qualifications

Must-haves

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in recruitment, with at least 2 years in tech recruitment

  • Experience working in a start-up or scale-up environment

  • Global sourcing experience: You have a track record of helping attract talent from major tech hubs (USA, EU, LATAM, etc.)

  • Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools

  • You thrive in a high-trust environment where you are empowered to learn, improve processes, and make an impact

Others

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together

jobs.description:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the role

Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week.

In this role, you'll:

  • Manage a number of key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan.

  • Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to successful deployment.

  • Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects.

  • Own a consumption revenue target.

  • Manage consumption revenue forecasts.

  • Analyse key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.

  • Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering.

  • Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates.

  • Support the development of company culture.

We're seeking someone with experience including:

  • 10+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service.

  • Have full professional fluency in both French and English.

  • Achieving revenue targets >$2M per year for more than 3 years.

  • Designing and executing complex deal strategies.

  • Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies.

  • Working directly with c-level executives.

  • Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.).

  • Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.

  • Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.

  • Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.

  • Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.

  • Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organisation. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. jobs.title: Founding Robotics Engineer Navigation & Autonomy
jobs.description:
ABOUT NAXON

Naxon Robotics deploys swarms of mobile robots, quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, for security and industrial inspection. The fleet patrols perimeters, detects anomalies and inspects assets as one coordinated system, covering more ground 24/7 , delivering more value and reaching ROI faster than a single robot or a fleet of disconnected ones.

Why now: rising threats to critical infrastructure, too few people in security and industry , cheap and reliable hardware and fast moving AI agents. Hardware is ready . Deployment is not. Every new site is still a months-long expert project, so pilots rarely turn into rollouts. We make deployment repeatable, with swarms and an agentic platform that learns from each site.

Backed by EWOR, TUM VLABs and a robotics founder who built and exited a drone swarm company . Mentored by unicorn founders and Prof. Johannes Betz (autonomous driving and robotics, TUM).

THE ROLE

You own the autonomy stack every robot in our fleet runs on: SLAM, localisation and navigation, indoors and outdoors, across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones. You take it from the lab to production at customer sites and keep it robust there.

As the fleet grows, you grow the stack into multi robot coordination. This is the core the whole company scales on. You own the stack. The Field Robotics Engineer owns what runs at the customer.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build and own SLAM, localisation, mapping and navigation, indoor and outdoor

  • Select, combine and calibrate sensors: lidar , depth, RGB, thermal, IMU and GNSS

  • Generalise the stack across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones

  • Test and tune on real robots with benchmarks and field data, not only in simulation

  • Define what runs on the robot and what runs in the cloud, including failure and fallback

  • Take the stack to production at customer sites, then extend it to multi robot coordination

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Has taken SLAM or an autonomy stack to production at real customers, not only research demos

  • Strong in SLAM, localisation, state estimation and motion planning

  • Expert in ROS2, C++ and Python, and a heavy user of AI coding agents

  • Hands on with quadrupeds, wheeled robots or drones and their sensors on real hardware

  • MSc / PhD plus 2 to 4 years in industry, or equivalent proven experience

WHY JOIN NAXON

  • The challenge: one map shared across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, task allocation across a live site, and an edge/cloud split over networks that drop

  • Full ownership of your area, from architecture to what runs at the customer , and a clear path into leading it

  • Real robots at real customer sites, from research to working reliably in real world conditions

  • Hands-on work with cutting-edge robotics, hardware and AI

  • Competitive salary and equity (VSOP / ESOP) as a founding team member

  • Backing from EWOR and robotics mentors who have built, scaled and exited companies

  • A supportive and inclusive team that values ownership and creativity

Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics.

Large, high-volume contracts mean our factories need to run around the clock. Overnight shifts can bridge the gap, but the long-term answer is automated machine tending.   • Work with operators on the floor so automation fits how the factory runs.

jobs.title: SAP Integration Architect
jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for an SAP Integration Architect to own how Finto connects to SAP. Some of our customers run their finance operations on SAP, and no two landscapes look alike: R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, on-premise and cloud, Business One and Business ByDesign. You'll design how master data, invoices and postings move between those systems and our AI platform, and turn what starts as a bespoke integration into a product that goes live in weeks. This is a hands-on role, working directly with our CTO and the founding team: you'll set the architecture, write code, and sit across the table from customer IT. You're the first hire dedicated to SAP at Finto and you define what the practice becomes. We're headquartered in Munich, with roots in San Francisco through Y Combinator.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture from a customer's SAP system into Finto: master data, invoices, postings, write-back.

  • Choose the integration path per SAP flavour - OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI, file-based - and make that choice repeatable instead of re-deciding it per customer.

  • Build the connector platform: templates, validation, monitoring, and the tooling that makes every new landscape faster than the last.

  • Translate FI and MM process knowledge into specifications and field mappings our engineers build against.

  • Ship production code with the engineering team - same repo, same reviews, Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Be the SAP authority in the room: with customer IT, with their integration partners, and in our own technical conversations with prospects.

  • Set the standard for how Finto goes live on SAP, and move more of it into the product with every rollout.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of hands-on SAP integration work in real customer landscapes across R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, ideally more than one generation of them.

  • Deep knowledge of the accounts payable process in SAP: FI, MM, the document flow around incoming invoices, tax determination, and why the field a customer means is rarely the field the label says.

  • Fluency across SAP's integration surface - OData, IDocs, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI - and a clear position on clean core.

  • Strong coding skills, ideally in TypeScript/Node.js. You architect and you build; specifications alone aren't the job.

  • A product instinct: you'd rather build a pattern once than map the same fields twice.

  • Confidence in front of enterprise IT teams, and the directness to tell them when an export won't work.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • Bonus points for ABAP, for time on the consulting side of SAP rollouts, or for anything you've built that made your own job smaller.

Work at Finto

  • An environment where we enable you to have an impact and where we focus on outcomes, not time-tracking.

  • Career-defining growth: Big ambitions mean rapid progression, expanding responsibilities, and access to our San Francisco & YC network.

  • Shape your future role: As an early team member, you define what SAP at Finto looks like, and grow it into a team.

  • Real enterprise SAP landscapes from week one, not a sandbox.

  • 25 vacation days + 2 fixed "company recharge days."

  • A vibrant in-office culture (5 days/week) in a modern office.

Interview Process

  1. Intro - 20 mins with our CEO

  2. Technical Get to Know - 30 mins with our CTO

  3. Challenge - 60 mins architecture & design challenge on a real SAP landscape

  4. Culture call with our CPO

  5. Meet the team

  6. Offer

Compensation: €70K – €130K • Offers Equity

jobs.description:

Foleon is a leading content creation platform providing business teams with a fast and scalable way to produce highly-engaging content experiences that bring a new level of intelligence to their customer journeys.

Foleon is based in Amsterdam and New York and serves more than 1,200 global B2B brands. We value people who are bold, ambitious, collaborative, and customer-centric. Even better, the ones who know how to work hard and have fun at the same time. We’re a team of highly driven people, with a great sense of human connection and a clear focus.

Your Mission

As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and leadership to make sure what we build and ship holds up under the EU AI Act, cybersecurity law, digital accessibility rules and GDPR.

Your Job

  • Act as our product counsel: join product syncs, review features before they’re built, and flag legal and compliance questions early.

  • Lead compliance for our AI proposition: classify our AI use cases, map our obligations as a provider or deployer under the EU AI Act, and set up the documentation, transparency and governance it requires.

  • Make sure our platform, and the content our customers publish with it, meets the European Accessibility Act and related standards.

  • Build privacy into the product by advising on GDPR questions tied to new features and data.

  • Advise on cybersecurity law, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and incident reporting duties, working closely with our security team.

  • Track changes in AI, cybersecurity, accessibility and privacy regulation, and turn them into practical guidance for the team.


Your Competencies & Skills

  • Senior and independent: you make calls and own them, without someone steering you.

  • A practical communicator who explains complex regulation to product teams in plain language, with answers instead of memos full of caveats.

  • Proactive and curious: you spot gaps before they become problems and want to understand how the product actually works.

  • Comfortable working part-time and flexibly, and available when something urgent comes up.

Your Qualifications

  • A Master’s in Law (or equivalent) and 6+ years of experience, ideally a mix of law firm and in-house at a tech or SaaS company.

  • Hands-on experience as product counsel for software, ideally including AI products.

  • Deep working knowledge of the EU AI Act and how it applies to AI propositions in practice.

  • Experience with cybersecurity law (NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act) and digital accessibility rules (European Accessibility Act).

  • A solid grounding in commercial and corporate law, with working knowledge of employment law.

  • GDPR and privacy expertise is a plus, ideally at DPO level or with a certification such as CIPP/E.

  • Experience working with scale-ups on a retainer or fractional basis is a plus.

jobs.title: Développeur Nouveaux Projets (F/H/X)
jobs.description:
Localisation
Poste basé à Lyon ou Dijon.  

Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des énergies renouvelables et vous connaissez bien le tissu économique et territorial de l’Est de la France ? Rejoignez Novar et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique !

En tant que Développeur Nouveaux Projets, vous serez en première ligne pour identifier et sécuriser de nouveaux sites solaires et/ou de stockage en régions AURA et Bourgogne, tout en construisant des relations solides avec les acteurs locaux (collectivités, propriétaires fonciers, entreprises, partenaires). Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants.


Vos missions

·         Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire.

·         Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires.

·         Identifier de nouveaux sites à potentiel grâce à votre réseau, aux outils cartographiques et à vos actions de terrain.

·         Réaliser l’analyse technico-économique des sites, en intégrant contraintes et risques.

·         Approcher les propriétaires fonciers, agriculteurs, collectivités et clients C&I afin de présenter Novar et ses solutions.

·         Préparer et présenter des réponses à des appels à projets.

·         Négocier et contractualiser les accords fonciers et commerciaux.

·         Assurer le suivi des opportunités jusqu’à leur concrétisation et leur passage en phase de développement.

·         Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des outils, process et connaissances internes liés au développement territorial.

Votre profil

·         Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural.

·         Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle similaire (prospection foncière, développement ENR ou aménagement territorial).

·         Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation.

·         Goût prononcé pour le terrain et le contact direct avec les acteurs locaux.

·         Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets.

·         Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation.

 

Ce que NOVAR vous offre

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ?

💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours.
🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance.
🌴 Une prime vacances.
🩺 Mutuelle famille financée à 50% 
🚗 Une voiture de fonction.
🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous.
📚 Des opportunités de développement professionnel dans le domaine du stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS).
🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble.

À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. 

 

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. 

 

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain.

jobs.title: (Senior) Account Manager - Existing Customers (all genders)
jobs.description:
Description

In ganz Europa stehen Fuhrparks unter enormem Druck. Kraftstoffkosten steigen, regulatorische Anforderungen werden komplexer und der Umstieg auf emissionsärmere Fahrzeuge nimmt Fahrt auf. Gleichzeitig verwalten noch immer rund 70 % der europäischen Unternehmen ihre Flotten mit Excel-Tabellen, isolierten Tools und Prozessen, die für die heutigen Herausforderungen nie ausgelegt waren.

Shiftmove macht genau das einfacher. Wir sind ein profitables B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen und die am schnellsten wachsende Flottenmanagement-Plattform Europas. Entstanden aus dem Zusammenschluss von Avrios und Vimcar, unterstützen wir heute zehntausende Geschäftskunden in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, der Schweiz, Polen und weiteren europäischen Märkten. Mit den jüngsten Akquisitionen von Optimum und Ocean in Frankreich haben wir unsere Präsenz weiter ausgebaut und unsere Position in einem der größten Flottenmärkte Europas gestärkt.

Unsere KI-gestützte Plattform verbindet Fahrzeugdaten in Echtzeit mit intelligenter Software, damit Unternehmen ihre Fahrzeuge smarter beschaffen, Kosten kontrollieren, Compliance sicherstellen und die Mobilitätswende aktiv gestalten können – alles an einem Ort.

Über die Rolle

Als Account Manager:in übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum von Shiftmove bei. Dein Ziel ist es, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen nicht nur langfristig zu sichern, sondern ihr Potenzial gezielt auszuschöpfen – durch Renewals, Upselling, Cross-Selling und die Entwicklung neuer Umsatzmöglichkeiten.

Dabei betreust du ein umfangreiches Portfolio an B2B-Kunden mit einem Geschäftsvolumen von rund 4–5 Mio. €. Du erkennst kommerzielle Chancen, gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, führst Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen und bringst Opportunities erfolgreich zum Abschluss.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer Success Team zusammen, übernimmst aber die eigenständige Verantwortung für die kommerzielle Entwicklung deiner Accounts.

Das erwartet dich

  • Account Management & Kundenentwicklung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich ein Portfolio aus Mid-Market-Kund und ausgewählten Enterprise Accounts. Du behältst den Überblick über deine Accounts, priorisierst Chancen und Risiken und definierst klare nächste Schritte.
  • Renewal Management: Du verantwortest die Verlängerung bestehender Verträge – von der Vorbereitung des Angebots über die Abstimmung mit Kund bis hin zur Preisverhandlung und zum Abschluss.
  • Expansion: Gemeinsam mit Customer Success identifizierst du Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kund und kannst nachvollziehbar vermitteln, welchen Mehrwert zusätzliche Produkte oder Lösungen für sie schaffen.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du kommunizierst mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner auf Kundenseite und lernst, auch komplexere Entscheidungsprozesse strukturiert zu steuern.
  • Pipeline & Forecasting: Du dokumentierst relevante Entwicklungen in Salesforce und Planhat, hältst deine Opportunities aktuell und erstellst realistische Forecasts für deine Pipeline.

Was du mitbringst

  • B2B Sales Erfahrung: Du bringst ca. 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, z.B. im Account Management, Existing Customer Sales oder als Account Executive.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick & Closing: Du hast bereits eigenständig Verkaufsgespräche geführt, kommerzielle Verhandlungen gesteuert und Deals erfolgreich abgeschlossen, idealerweise im fünfstelligen Bereich.
  • Portfolio Management: Du hast Erfahrung in der Betreuung und kommerziellen Entwicklung eines größeren Kundenportfolios und weißt, wie du Accounts und Opportunities effektiv priorisierst.
  • Sales Drive & Proaktivität: Du gehst aktiv auf Kunden zu, erkennst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und hast Freude daran, Umsatzpotenziale in konkrete Abschlüsse umzuwandeln.
  • Consultative Selling: Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und kannst den Mehrwert einer Lösung überzeugend vermitteln, statt dich ausschließlich auf Produktfeatures zu konzentrieren.
  • Lernbereitschaft & Coachability: Du bist offen für Feedback, möchtest dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau.

Warum uns?

  • Produkte mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Herausforderungen für tausende Unternehmen in ganz Europa und machen komplexe Flottenprozesse einfacher, effizienter und datengetriebener.
  • Etwas Sinnvolles skalieren: Als profitables, PE-finanziertes Scale-up mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen verbinden wir Stabilität mit Geschwindigkeit und Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Internationales Umfeld: Über 40 Nationalitäten, Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und Teams in ganz Europa sorgen für spannende Perspektiven und echte Zusammenarbeit.
  • Verantwortung statt Micromanagement: Wir geben Menschen den Freiraum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ideen einzubringen und Dinge voranzutreiben.

Benefits

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Workation: Bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote von überall auf der Welt arbeiten
  • Hundefreundliches Büro: Weil tierische Kolleg einfach dazugehören 🐶
  • Weiterentwicklung: 2.000 € jährliches Budget für persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung
  • Benefits nach Wahl: Urban Sports Club, Hrmony, JobRad oder Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket/BVG-Ticket
  • Wellbeing: 1 Mental Health Day plus Zugang zu nilo.health
  • Für Foodies: Kostenloses Mittagessen einmal pro Woche, gemeinsames Frühstück alle zwei Wochen sowie Snacks und Getränke rund um die Uhr 🍕

We mean it!

Mit über 40 Nationalitäten verbindet uns vor allem eines: der gemeinsame Anspruch, Mobilität für Unternehmen einfacher zu machen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven machen unsere Arbeit besser.

Uns ist nicht wichtig, ob dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Uns interessieren Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Dinge ins Rollen bringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen.

Du bist nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Und wenn du im Bewerbungsprozess etwas brauchst oder Anpassungen notwendig sind, sag einfach Bescheid – wir finden eine Lösung.

jobs.title: Arbetsterapeut till Danderyds sjukhus
jobs.description: Vårt anställningserbjudandeVill du förstärka vår enhet och göra skillnad för patienterna på sjukhuset? Vill du vara en viktig kugge när enhetens uppdrag utökas från att ha haft huvudfokus på de geriatriska avdelningarna till att ansvara för fler avdelningar på sjukhuset där vår kompetens kring multisjuka patienter kommer väl till pass.Uppdraget består i nuläget av den geriatriska akutvårdsavdelning (GAVA), avdelningen för sjukhusgeriatrik där patienter med behov av rehabilitering och närhet till akutsjukhusets resurser vårdas, njurmedicin, gastro, endokrin och sjukhusets palliativa avdelning. Är du legitimerad arbetsterapeut och vill arbeta på akutsjukhus? Drivs du av samarbete och korta beslutsvägar? Tilltalas du av möjligheten att arbeta på olika delar av sjukhuset? Trivs du i en kontext som är under ständig utveckling för att tillgodose behoven hos patienterna.Oavsett om du har många år i yrket eller om du precis är redo att ta dina första steg i karriären finns en plats för dig hos oss! Har du erfarenhet tar vi gärna del av din kompetens. Är du nyutbildad erbjuder vi en trygg och stöttande introduktion där du får växa in i rollen tillsammans med erfarna kollegor. Det viktigaste för oss är att du är engagerad, nyfiken och vill bidra!Vi arbetar måndagar till fredagar och har flextid. Viss helgtjänstgöring kan bli aktuellt i framtiden då verksamheten utvecklas och behoven förändras. ArbetsbeskrivningKliniskt arbete på akutsjukhus. Korta vårdtider och multisjuka patienter.Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar tidiga, snabba och kliniskt säkra bedömningar av patienternas aktivitetsförmågor. Fokus på att fånga förändringar i relation till hur vardagen fungerat senaste tiden innan sjukhusinläggningen. Träning och bedömning av ADL-aktiviteter.Din bedömning är viktig input i utskrivningsprocessen. Hjälpmedelsutprovning/förskrivning och överrapportering är betydelsefulla för smidiga övergångar till nästa steg i vårdkedjan.Arbetet kräver god interaktions- och kommunikationsförmåga med kollegor, andra professioner samt med patienter och närstående. Förmåga att prioritera och ta säkra beslut, i ett tidvis högt tempo, är en förutsättning för att trivas bra med arbetsuppgifterna. Du arbetar självständigt men aldrig ensam – du har alltid kollegor att rådfråga. Arbete på andra avdelningar på sjukhuset kan ingå i arbetsuppgifterna. Handledning av arbetsterapeutstudenter ingår. KvalifikationerLegitimerad arbetsterapeut med legitimation utfärdad av Socialstyrelsen. Meriterande- Arbete på akutsjukhus och/eller geriatrisk klinik.- Handledning av arbetsterapeutstudenter.- Handledarutbildning (7,5 hp).- Magister-/masterexamen eller påbörjade studier inom relevant område. Personliga egenskaper- Intresse av arbete på akutsjukhus med multisjuka patienter.- God samarbetsförmåga och förmåga att arbeta såväl självständigt som i grupp.- God förmåga att ta egna initiativ, prioritera och hantera flera saker samtidigt.- Ett positivt och kreativt förhållningssätt.- Du vill bidra till en arbetsplats där vi inkluderar, inspirerar och uppskattar varandra.- Vi värdesätter ett positivt och prestigelöst förhållningssätt till patienter, arbetskamrater och arbetsuppgifter.- Stor hänsyn tas till personlig lämplighet. ÖvrigtTillsvidareanställning heltid (40h/vecka). Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. AnsökanIntervjuer kan påbörjas innan sista ansökningsdag. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!Vid rekrytering av medarbetare till verksamhet som kan komma att hantera barn och/eller ungdomar upp till 18 år tar vi utdrag ur belastnings- och misstankeregistret inför eventuell anställning.Om Danderyds sjukhus Danderyds sjukhus är ett av Sveriges största akutsjukhus med natur, vatten och t-bana runt knuten. Hos oss arbetar omkring 4700 medarbetare och vi tar emot 2000 studenter varje år. Här möts akutsjukvårdens puls med högkvalitativ vård och det nära omhändertagandet. Vi hjälper varandra och ger dig möjligheten att växa och utvecklas från student till erfaren medarbetare. Du som värnar patienten och du som vill driva patientnära forskning kommer att trivas här. Danderyds sjukhus har en egen institution vid Karolinska Institutet vilket innebär ett omfattande uppdrag inom klinisk forskning och grundutbildning. Detta uppdrag är starkt integrerat med den kliniska verksamheten och sjukhusets utveckling.Danderyds sjukhus en förvaltning inom Akutsjukhusnämnden i Region Stockholm.Här kan du läsa mer om Danderyds sjukhus Om verksamheten Organisatoriskt tillhör du den Paramedicinska Sektionen som består av ca 80 medarbetare fördelade på fem olika enheter som omfattar arbetsterapi-, fysioterapi-, nutritions- och kuratorsverksamhet. Här arbetar arbetsterapeuter, fysioterapeuter, dietister och kuratorer inom de flesta av sjukhusets verksamhetsområden, med både sluten-och öppenvård. Enheten har en bred kompetens inom respektive yrkesgrupp och kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap och erfarenhet.

jobs.title: Teknisk Förvaltare | El & Kraft | Caverion
jobs.description: Är du en erfaren specialist inom elkraft och teknisk förvaltning som vill arbeta med några av Sveriges mest verksamhetskritiska anläggningar? Vill du kombinera din tekniska expertis med strategiskt utvecklingsarbete och vara en viktig rådgivare till både kunder och verksamhet? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig. Läs mer och ansök nedanaverion är en ledande partner inom tekniska installationer, fastighetsdrift och industriella tjänster. Genom innovativa och hållbara lösningar hjälper Caverion sina kunder att skapa säkra, effektiva och framtidssäkrade miljöer. Inom affärsområdet Nationella Kunder arbetar Caverion med några av Sveriges mest komplexa och samhällsviktiga anläggningar där höga krav ställs på driftsäkerhet, elsäkerhet och teknisk tillgänglighet.<img src="https://sae3ndp007.blob.core.windows.net/swe/26146e4c-55fc-4f4c-ac8b-1e5e7fcf24e2.jpg">Om rollenSom Teknisk Förvaltare El & Kraft får du en central specialistroll med ansvar för att utveckla, kvalitetssäkra och förvalta Caverions tekniska leverans inom el- och kraftområdet. Du fungerar som expertstöd till både kunder och den egna organisationen samt säkerställer att tekniska lösningar, underhållsstrategier och arbetssätt håller högsta kvalitet ur ett driftsäkerhets- och elsäkerhetsperspektiv.Du kommer att arbeta nära kontraktschefer, produktionsledare, tekniker, projektledare och kundrepresentanter. Rollen innebär ett stort ansvar för att identifiera risker, analysera avvikelser och driva förbättringsinitiativ som stärker anläggningarnas tillgänglighet, livslängd och funktion. Resor inom Sverige förekommer som en naturlig del av tjänstenI rollen ingår att:    Ansvara för den tekniska förvaltningen inom el- och kraftområdet för tilldelade kundavtal    Utveckla och kvalitetssäkra underhållsplaner, driftinstruktioner och tekniska arbetssätt    Analysera driftstörningar, felhistorik och tekniska avvikelser samt driva rotorsaksanalyser    Identifiera tekniska risker, dokumentationsbrister och investeringsbehov    Ta fram beslutsunderlag, åtgärdsplaner och rekommendationer till kund    Stödja kunder i frågor kring eldriftansvar, elsäkerhet, riskanalyser och fortlöpande kontroll    Säkerställa att teknisk dokumentation är aktuell, strukturerad och spårbar    Vara rådgivande specialist till kunder, produktionsorganisation och projektverksamhet    Delta i utveckling av nya tekniska tjänster, förbättrade arbetssätt och standardiserade processer    Bidra till kompetensutveckling, mentorskap och kunskapsdelning inom organisationen Vem söker vi?Vi söker dig som har en stark teknisk bakgrund inom elkraft, drift eller teknisk förvaltning och som motiveras av att kombinera specialistkunskap med utvecklingsarbete och kunddialog. Du trivs i en rådgivande roll där du får analysera komplexa frågeställningar, skapa struktur och bidra till långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.Vi ser gärna att du har:    Högskoleutbildning inom elkraft, elektroteknik eller motsvarande alternativt annan relevant teknisk utbildning i kombination med gedigen erfarenhet    Minst fem års erfarenhet inom elkraft, drift, underhåll eller teknisk förvaltning    Erfarenhet från tekniskt komplexa eller verksamhetskritiska anläggningar    God kunskap om elsäkerhetslagstiftning, arbetsmiljökrav och relevanta standarder    Erfarenhet av riskbedömningar, teknisk dokumentation och underhållsplanering    Förmåga att analysera tekniska problem och omsätta resultat till konkreta förbättringsåtgärder    Mycket god administrativ och dokumenterande förmåga    Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift    Möjlighet att resa inom Sverige i tjänstenDet är meriterande om du har erfarenhet som elanläggningsansvarig, eldriftansvarig, elkraftsingenjör, teknisk förvaltare eller elprojektledare. Erfarenhet av reservkraft, UPS-system, ställverk, reläskydd, högspänning eller kritisk infrastruktur såsom datahallar, telekom, sjukvård eller industri är också positivt.Som person är du strukturerad, analytisk och ansvarstagande. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroende, kommunicerar tekniska frågor på ett pedagogiskt sätt och kan balansera tekniska krav med affärsmässiga överväganden. Du är självgående i ditt arbete samtidigt som du uppskattar samarbete och kunskapsutbyte med kollegor och kunder.Med verksamhet över hela Sverige erbjuder vi en flexibel placering där du kan utgå från Stockholm, Göteborg, Helsingborg eller KarlstadVi erbjuderVi erbjuder en specialistroll med stort inflytande och möjlighet att påverka utvecklingen av tekniska leveranser inom några av Sveriges mest samhällsviktiga anläggningar. Här får du arbeta i en organisation med stark teknisk kompetens, engagerade kollegor och tydligt fokus på kvalitet, innovation och hållbarhet.Du får möjlighet att utveckla framtidens arbetssätt inom el- och kraftområdet, arbeta nära kunder med höga krav på driftsäkerhet och bidra till att skapa långsiktigt hållbara och säkra tekniska lösningar.AnsökanI denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Jefferson Wells. Du ansöker genom att registrera ditt CV på vår hemsida via länken nedan. Vi kan tyvärr inte ta emot ansökningar via e-post.Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. Tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att anställning förutsätter godkänd säkerhetsprövning och bakgrundskontroll På Manpower, Experis och Jefferson Wells värnar vi om en trygg och transparent rekryteringsprocess. Vi kommer aldrig att be dig om betalning, bankuppgifter eller annan känslig personlig information i samband med en jobbansökan eller rekrytering. Om du får misstänkta meddelanden som sägs komma från oss ber vi dig att kontakta oss på contactcenter@manpower.se.

jobs.title: SAP Senior Consultant (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

BeNeering was founded in 2007 by experienced SAP solution architects who had spent years working inside global corporations. We know from first-hand experience where procurement gets slowed down and how to fix it. As a German software company and certified SAP partner, we started out in consulting and became a solutions provider in 2013. Our core development team from that time is still with us today.

Our main product is the BeNeering Digital Procurement Platform. It uses AI-powered guidance and automation to make indirect procurement easy. The platform connects to SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA in real time, so SAP remains the system of record while employees shop in a modern, intuitive interface that feels like a web shop. Many of our customers use it as the modern replacement for SAP SRM.

BeNeering is privately owned and has no outside investors. We don’t chase short-term targets. We build long-term partnerships and develop our product together with our customers.

About the Job

Are you an experienced SAP procurement consultant who wants to move beyond configuring standard modules and help shape a modern, AI-powered procurement platform? At BeNeering you will bring our solutions to life at some of the world's largest companies, working hand in hand with customers, developers and product management.

Responsibilities

  • Lead implementations of the BeNeering Digital Procurement Platform at customers running SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA, from kickoff to go-live and hypercare

  • Run workshops with procurement and IT stakeholders, analyze purchasing processes and translate requirements into solution designs

  • Configure the integration between BeNeering and SAP MM, MM-SRV, PM and SRM, including roles, workflows, catalogs and service procurement

  • Guide customers migrating from SAP SRM or classic MM purchasing to a modern, Clean Core procurement setup

  • Act as the bridge between customers and our development team: write functional specifications and support testing and acceptance

  • Lead project workstreams, coach junior consultants and help onboard partners on BeNeering solutions

  • Train key users and contribute to best practices, documentation and the evolution of our product

Who You Are

  • University degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Business Administration or a related field

  • 5+ years of SAP consulting experience, including at least 2 full-lifecycle implementation projects

  • Strong functional knowledge of SAP procurement: SAP MM (purchasing, contracts, service procurement MM-SRV) and/or SAP SRM

  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA

  • Solid technical understanding of SAP integration (BAPIs, RFC, OData) and enough ABAP knowledge to read code and debug

  • Confidence leading customer workshops and presenting to stakeholders

  • Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP BTP, SAP Fiori/UI5 or SAP Integration Suite

  • Experience with SAP Ariba, catalog management or guided buying solutions

  • SAP certifications, for example S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement

  • Interest in using AI in SAP projects

Why Work With Us

  • Take on responsibility from day one and help shape our company and technology

  • Contribute your ideas to a fast-growing team with flat hierarchies

  • Use AI in your daily work and bring new ideas to how we work

  • Work closely with experienced experts from procurement and technology

  • Individual bonus payments based on performance

  • Flexible hours that adapt to your schedule, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl

  • A hybrid model that combines office time and working from home

  • A laptop and company phone, which you can also use privately

  • Additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve

  • Regular team events and an annual company event with networking opportunities

    Annen informasjon:

    Vi tar personvern på alvor og mottar derfor kun søknader sendt via vår annonse.

    Ved spørsmål, ta gjerne kontakt med: Ausra Stene

    Vi ser frem til å motta søknaden din!

    Om arbeidsgiveren:

    I Coor møter vi hverandre med nysgjerrighet og varme. Hos oss jobber mennesker med ulik bakgrunn, personlighet og talent – og det er nettopp dette mangfoldet som gjør oss sterkere. Vi lærer av hverandre, støtter hverandre og skaper mer verdi for kundene våre når vi blir inkludert og får tillit.

    Coor er service – vi tar hånd om kundens arbeidsplass. Vi drifter og vedlikeholder bygninger, lager mat, rengjør, leverer post, ønsker gjester velkommen og sørger for at alt fungerer slik det skal – hver dag. Totalt leverer vi hundrevis av Facility Management-tjenester til noen av Nordens største virksomheter.

    Vårt felles oppdrag er å skape de beste arbeidsmiljøene i Norden – hyggelige, sunne og inspirerende, både for kundene våre og for oss selv. Vi skaper verdi ved å utføre, lede og utvikle serviceleveransene, slik at kundene våre kan konsentrere seg om det de gjør best.

    Gjennom vår sterke kultur og ved godt samarbeid har vi det morsommere på jobb – og vi leverer bedre. Kanskje er det derfor vi er ett av Nordens ledende selskaper innen Facility Management.
