jobs.title: Lokalt ansvarig för Maskrosbarns ungdomsgård i Göteborg
jobs.description: Om ossMaskrosbarn är en barnrättsorganisation som stöttar barn mellan 13-19 år med föräldrar som har ett missbruk, en psykisk sjukdom eller som utsätter dem för våld. Maskrosbarn har sedan starten 2005 mött tusentals ungdomar genom vår lägerverksamhet, coachprogram, ungdomsgårdar, stödsamtal och chatt. Maskrosbarn har kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö och Umeå. Totalt är vi på Maskrosbarn 45 heltidsanställda och 250 timanställda och volontärer.På kontoret i Göteborg arbetar sex personer och vi är ett tight team som arbetar nära varandra och i vårt arbete möter vi ungdomar från hela Västra Götaland. Utöver den heltidsanställda kontorspersonalen har vi deltidsanställda, praktikanter och volontärer som arbetar i stödverksamheten.Om uppdragetUngdomsgården, Torsdagsmys, äger rum varje torsdag kväll mellan kl. 16.30 och 20.00, och varje tillfälle deltar runt 20 ungdomar. Ungdomsgården är hela stödverksamhetens hjärta och ett väldigt viktigt och uppskattat stöd av ungdomarna. Torsdagarna är en trygg plats för ungdomarna att vara på, äta middag och skapa fantastiska upplevelser tillsammans. Maskrosbarn har även ett mat- och klädstöd som är kopplat till ungdomsgården.I rollen som lokalt ansvarig för Maskrosbarns ungdomsgård ingår att planera, genomföra och följa upp ungdomsgårdsverksamheten. Det ingår även visst strategiarbete, rekrytering, budgetuppföljning samt arbetsledning av en grupp volontärer och deltidsanställda.I dina arbetsuppgifter kommer du också göra en del utåtriktat arbete där du kommer presentera Maskrosbarn för ungdomar i vår målgrupp och för professionella/vuxna som möter vår målgrupp. Du har det samordnande ansvaret för våra elevföreläsare som håller föreläsningar ute på skolor.Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och utgår från vårt Göteborgskontor. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning.Vem är du?För att passa i rollen som lokalt ansvarig för Maskrosbarns ungdomsgård behöver du vara varm, öppen och genuin i ditt bemötande av ungdomar och kollegor. Du behöver vara så pass trygg i ditt ledarskap att du kan leda en grupp ungdomar såväl som att arbetsleda timanställda och volontärer. Eftersom du är ansvarig för innehållet på Torsdagsmysen behöver du kunna ta initiativ, vara kreativ och självständigt kunna planera aktiviteter för ungdomarna. Du behöver vara flexibel och ha en analytisk förmåga för att skapa strukturer utifrån ungdomsgruppens behov. Du behöver kunna anpassa ditt sätt till att vara både lekfull med ungdomarna såväl som en trygg vuxen.Vi söker dig som;    Har någon typ av eftergymnasial utbildning som socionom, fritidsledare, beteendevetare, fritidspedagog, socialpedagog eller motsvarande erfarenhet som av arbetsgivaren bedöms likvärdig.    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete med ungdomar    Identifierar dig själv som ett maskrosbarn; du har växt upp med en förälder som har ett missbruk, psykisk ohälsa eller som har utsatt dig för våld. Det är ett krav i den här rollen då identifikation mellan ungdomar och personal är en del av vår metod. Du har bearbetat dina egna upplevelser och mår bra idag.Vidare tror vi att du;    Är flexibel i arbetstid då en del av tjänsten är förlagd kvällstid. Resor förekommer.    Är varm och utåtriktad med god förmåga att skapa relation och tillit med ungdomar    Är självgående, strukturerad och kan planera din tid väl    Har förmågan att härbärgera ungdomars svåra känslor    Du trivs med att vara motorn i att hitta aktiviteter som ungdomarna uppskattar och kan arbeta väl tillsammans mot gemensamma uppsatta mål med kollegor    Du tycker att det är roligt att arbeta med ungdomar    Vill vara en del av en familjär ideell organisationVi värnar om mångfald och uppmuntrar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter.AnsökanVälkommen med din ansökan via vårt rekryteringssystem senast 29 november 2026. Urval kommer sker löpande så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. Vi vill att du bifogar CV samt personligt brev där du besvarar frågorna nedan;    Varför passar just du för denna tjänst?    Vad har du för relevanta erfarenheter för denna tjänst?    Varför är du ett maskrosbarn?Bifoga personliga brevet under "Övriga dokument".Första intervjun kommer att genomföras 30 november och 1 december. Om du går vidare i processen genomförs en andra intervju 16 december. Samtliga intervjuer hålls på Maskrosbarns kontor i Göteborg.Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta:Johanna Azar – Verksamhetschef Göteborg johanna@maskrosbarn.orgDenise Madsen - Stödchef denise@maskrosbarn.orgLäs mer om oss på maskrosbarn.org.

jobs.title: Vi söker timvikarier som personlig assistent i Kristianstad med omnejd
jobs.description: Om arbetsplatsen Furuboda Assistans är en privat assistansanordnare i södra Sverige med rötter i den ideella Föreningen Furuboda. Bolaget skapades år 2005 och är ett växande företag. I dagsläget består Furuboda Assistans av ca 700 medarbetare. Vi strävar efter att vara ett föredöme inom hållbart företagande. För oss handlar hållbart företagande om att ha ett starkt kundfokus, välmående personal samt att eftersträva en låg klimat- och miljö-påverkan.Vill du ha ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete där du gör verklig skillnad i en annan människas vardag? Vi söker nu ansvarsfulla och lyhörda timvikarier till flera av våra kunder i Kristianstad med omnejd.Att arbeta som personlig assistent är mer än ett jobb. Hos oss får du möjlighet att lära känna en annan människa, vara en viktig del av vardagen och samtidigt utvecklas själv. Vi erbjuder ett tryggt och givande arbete där relation, lyhördhet och respekt står i centrum.Om jobbetSom personlig assistent stöttar du en av våra kunder i deras vardag så att hen kan leva ett så självständigt, aktivt och tryggt liv som möjligt. Alla våra uppdrag är unika och anpassade efter den person du arbetar hos.Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:    Hjälp med personlig omvårdnad    Stöd i vardagliga sysslor och rutiner i hemmet    Följa med på aktiviteter, utflykter eller träning    Vara ett tryggt, närvarande och flexibelt stöd i vardagen    Övriga uppgifter utifrån kundens specifika behov och önskemålArbetstiderna varierar (dag, kväll, natt och helg). Du kan arbeta hos en och samma kund över tid eller hos flera olika kunder utifrån din tillgänglighet och verksamhetens behov.Vem söker vi?Du behöver inte ha arbetat som personlig assistent tidigare – tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande, men vi lägger absolut störst vikt vid personlig lämplighet och matchning. Vi söker dig som:    Är ansvarstagande, lyhörd och pålitlig    Är trygg i dig själv och har ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med människor    Är flexibel och anpassningsbar efter olika individers behov och personligheterVad erbjuder vi?    Ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete där du gör skillnad på riktigt    Grundlig introduktion och stöd inför dina uppdrag    Ett flexibelt extrajobb utifrån dina möjligheter    Goda möjligheter till fortsatt och mer omfattande arbete framöverAnsökanVi rekryterar löpande. Du ansöker enkelt genom att svara på några korta frågor i vårt ansökningsformulär – inget CV eller personligt brev krävs.Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!Övrigt Som anställd på Furuboda Assistans blir du erbjuden ett meningsfullt arbete med trygg anställning, friskvårdsbidrag på 2500 kronor, utbildningar och möjlighet till att utvecklas i ditt uppdrag. Vi tycker det är viktigt att medarbetare känner glädje och gemenskap på jobbet, och erbjuder därför en rad olika aktiviteter. Hos oss får du precis som våra kunder vara precis den du är. Vi har kollektivavtal och är medlemmar i IfA, Intresseföreningen för assistansberättigade, och möter deras höga kvalitetskrav som IfA-godkänd anordnare av personlig assistans

jobs.title: Professor/Associate Professor in Educational Psychology
jobs.description:
About the position

The Department of Education at the University of Oslo invites applications for a position in Educational Psychology. We seek applicants with a strong research interest in counselling practices targeting schools, Early Childhood Education and Care (ECEC) settings, and/or Educational Psychological Counselling settings. 

Educational systems in Norway and internationally face growing challenges concerning inclusion, diversity, and equity. Addressing these challenges requires stronger collaboration across the education system, including early childhood education and care (ECEC), schools, and support services. It also calls for closer links between research and practice, to improve educational quality and learning outcomes. We are seeking applicants with a research portfolio in these areas. 

The position is suited for candidates who wish to advance research on counselling, implementation processes, and/or organizational development. We particularly encourage applicants whose research focuses on inclusion in educational communities. Relevant experience includes experimental interventions and longitudinal studies involving families or educational settings and examining the conditions that support learning, development, well-being, and engagement. 

We welcome diverse scholarly profiles but particularly value innovative, methodologically rigorous research. Expertise in quantitative methods will be emphasised, while experience integrating qualitative approaches, such as observation of collaboration and interaction, is an advantage. Experience leading large-scale projects, managing complex project structures or coordinating interdisciplinary teams will be valued.

The position involves 47 % teaching, 47 % research, and 6 % administrative tasks.

More about the position

The successful candidate is expected to strengthen research in educational psychology and contribute to the Faculty of Educational Sciences’ research group, Development, Equity and Literacy in Learning Contexts (DEAL). 

The successful candidate is also expected to actively participate in the collective development of our education programs and teach at the bachelor- and master-level programs in Educational Psychology.

The candidates’ scientific production in the past 5 years will be emphasized in the assessment. It is expected that the successful candidate publishes internationally and seeks external funding. 

Work tasks and responsibilities

The appointee must be able to lead and initiate research, supervise doctoral degree students, participate in teaching and examination work at all levels, and undertake administrative tasks, in accordance with applicable provisions. 

More specifically the appointee must:

  • Contribute to the development of research and study programs in Educational Psychology
  • Contribute to the research group DEAL 
  • Participate in national and international research networks 
  • Plan, teach, and supervise in the bachelor and master level courses in Educational Psychology 
  • Disseminate research 
  • Apply for external funding 
  • Conduct administrative tasks 
Qualifications

For Associate Professor:

In this role you must have:

  • Doctoral degree within Education Psychology or competence at an equivalent level documented through scientific work of the same scope and quality 
  • Documented basic university pedagogical competence. Applicants who do not have documented basic university pedagogical competence must acquire this within two years from appointment
  • Good communication skills both written and oral in English and Norwegian or another Scandinavian language at level B2 are a prerequisite for performing all the tasks associated with the position. Applicants who do not master a Scandinavian language at the time of appointment are given a deadline of three years to learn Norwegian
  • Publications in high ranked international journals within educational psychology

It is an advantage if you have:

  • strong competence and experience in research methods and experience with quantitative methodology related to longitudinal and/or experimental designs 
  • experience in obtaining external funds
  • experience in leading large-scale research projects
  • documentation of qualifications in the field of academic management and administration

For Professor:

In this role you must have:

  • Doctoral degree or competence at an equivalent level and a track record that documents efforts and results over time within the field of Educational Psychology.
  • Substantial academic production and significant contributions to research at the highest level, in accordance with international or national standards within the field. 
  • Success in obtaining grants for major research applications and experience in leading and completing research projects. The research should be of high quality, demonstrating both breadth and depth within the research field and showing the ability to address new issues.
  • Research production should reflect an independent research profile, but also the ability to initiate and conduct high-level research in collaboration with other researchers and research institutions. 
  • Strong competence and experience in research methods. Experience with quantitative methodology related to longitudinal and/or experimental designs is an advantage.
  • Documented basic university pedagogical competence 
  • Broad experience in the development and implementation of teaching, supervision and collegial work with high pedagogical quality, as well as a willingness and ability for continuous professional development as a teacher and supervisor.
  • Good qualifications in the field of academic leadership and experience with management of research projects or research groups.
  • Good communication skills both written and oral in English and Norwegian or another Scandinavian language at level B2 are a prerequisite for performing all the tasks associated with the position. Applicants who do not master a Scandinavian language at the time of appointment are given a deadline of three years to learn Norwegian
  • Publications in high ranked international journals within educational psychology.

It is an advantage if you have:

  • strong competence and experience in research methods and experience with quantitative methodology related to longitudinal and/or experimental designs
  • experience in obtaining external funds
  • experience in leading large-scale research projects
  • documentation of qualifications in the field of academic management and administration
Personal skills
  • Good/excellent collaborative and communication skills
  • Ability to build strong academic environments and promote collaboration and quality
  • High work capacity and strong ability to deliver results
  • Strong teaching and coaching abilities and experiences

Personal suitability and motivation will be given decisive weight in the assessment.

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us.

We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful responsibilities in an institution with a strong societal mission, contributing to research, education and knowledge dissemination that support sustainable and equitable societal development
  • Committed colleagues in an ambitious and collaborative working environment
  • Membership in SPK - The Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which is one of Norway’s best pension schemes
  • Good employee benefits 
  • Salary in position as Professor, position code 1013, in a salary range from kr. 865 000 to kr. 1 010 000 depending on competencies. 2 percent of the salary is deducted in statutory contributions to The Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Salary in position as Associate Professor, position code 1011, in a salary range from kr. 750 000 to kr. 865 000 depending on competencies. 2 percent of the salary is deducted in statutory contributions to The Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
The application must include
  • Application letter 
  • CV 
  • A complete list of publications
  • Transcripts, diplomas and certificates
  • Educational portfolio of 3-6 pages, providing a comprehensive and systematic presentation of the applicant’s educational expertise. Documenting educational competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own practice and learning vision is anchored in the SoTL criteria (focus on student learning, development over time, a research approach and collegial attitude and practice. For guidance, see this page 
  • Documentation and reflection relating to the applicant’s own qualification within the areas of applied knowledge, academic management, administration and personal qualities relevant to the position
  • A separate note (one page) where the applicant explains their future plans for research in educational psychology. The note must include ambitions for feasible future research funding and how this can be done in collaboration with other members of the research group DEAL. The content of this note will be given great importance in the process of evaluating and ranking applicants
  • Applicants for position as Associate Professor are requested to submit up to 10 academic works with an overview and brief account of their scientific significance and, in case of co-authorship, a description of the applicants' contribution to each publication
  • Applicants for position as Professor are requested to submit up to 15 academic works with an overview and brief account of their scientific significance and, in case of co-authorship, a description of the applicants' contribution to each publication
  • References (list of 2-3 persons with name, title, email and phone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our online recruitment system Jobbnorge. 

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documents must be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

Incomplete applications will not be assessed. 

Interviews and trial lecture will form part of the appointment process. The entire breadth of qualifications will be assessed in ranking competent applicants.

General information

Please refer to the Rules for employment and promotion for professor and associate Professor positions at the University of Oslo, the Guide for applicants for Professor and Associate professor positions and Rules for practicing the requirement for basic pedagogical competence at the University of Oslo.

Please also see Guidance memo concerning employment and promotion of professors at the Faculty of Educational Sciences, UiO. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with the Norwegian Freedom of Information Act §25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You need to justify an exemption, and we will decide whether your request is granted. If we can’t, you will hear from us. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.The Department of Education  was established in 1938 and is one of three departments at the Faculty of Educational Sciences. Research at the department is characterized by interdisciplinarity and encompasses a broad range of human learning across the entire life course, from early childhood education and care to higher education and workplace learning.The breadth of our research is reflected in our bachelor’s and master’s programmes, which also include an international master’s programme. IPED currently has approximately 90 staff members, comprising around 40 academic full-time equivalents, 30 doctoral research fellows and 20 administrative full-time equivalents. The department has about 700 students.

jobs.title: PhD Fellow in Evolutionary Biochemistry
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

A 4-year PhD position in Evolutionary Biochemistry is available at the Department of Medical Biology, Faculty of Health Sciences, within the Host–Microbe Interaction (HMI) research group. The position is part of the LacZymes project, led by Dr. Christopher Frøhlich.

General information about the position.

The position is for a period of four years. The nominal length of the PhD programme is three years. The fourth year is distributed as 25 % each year and will consist of teaching and other duties. The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to the PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

The project 

Do you hold a Master’s degree in molecular biology (or a related field) and have a strong interest in the molecular mechanisms underlying antibiotic resistance development? Are you motivated to conduct interdisciplinary research at one of the northernmost universities in the world? If so, this PhD position may be of interest to you.

The successful candidate will join a project aiming to uncover the molecular mechanisms of AMR evolution at the enzymatic level. To address this, the project integrates ancestral sequence reconstruction, directed evolution, pre-steady-state and steady-state enzyme kinetics, and X-ray crystallography. Candidates with experience in one or more of these areas are encouraged to apply.

The PhD candidate will report to Dr. Christopher Frøhlich and is expected to contribute actively to the project while developing expertise at the interface of molecular biology, enzymology, and evolutionary biology.

The PhD candidate will work on the following tasks: 

  • Manage their own research project
  • Experimental design and execution
  • Enzyme evolution and selection
  • Enzyme production and purification
  • Biochemical enzyme characterization
  • Structural and functional characterization
  • Writing scientific papers and a PhD thesis
  • Presenting the work in national and international arenas

Personal characteristics:The applicant should be motivated, creative and ambitious, with a strong ability to work problem-solution orientated both in teams and independently. The applicant should be genuinely interested in the field of molecular evolution and AMR as well as scientific dissemination. In the evaluation of which applicant is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience, and personal suitability, in terms of the qualification requirements specified in this position announcement. The appointment is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants and national guidelines for appointment as PhD fellow

Applicants are required to submit a motivation letter describing how the position aligns with their research interests.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Christopher Frøhlich:

  • phone: +47 46 96 87 78
  • email: christopher.frohlich@uit.no
Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • Master’s degree in molecular biology, microbiology, chemistry or equivalent education, with a grade of C or better. Candidates who have not yet completed their Master’s education must submit a written statement from their main supervisor stating the tentative date of their Master’s defence.
  • Experience in at least two of the following areas: molecular cloning, protein expression and purification, biochemical characterization of enzymes (e.g. kinetic investigations), X-ray crystallography
  • Documented oral and written English skills

Applicants must document fluency of in English and be able to work in an international environment. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.  Working knowledge of Norwegian or a Scandinavian language is also beneficial.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in the field of AMR and AMR mechanisms
  • Experience in coding (e.g. Python) and competence with computer-based analytical tools (e.g., Pymol)
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language
  • Experience in writing publications
  • Experience in a biosafety level-2 laboratory environment

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. (The motivation letter will also be considered.) In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

We will also emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good collaboration skills
  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Wants to contribute to a good working environment

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.

Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Health Sciences and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

 

Applicants must have a grade of C or better on the master's thesis and have a grade point average of C or better for the master's degree. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here.

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.

Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.

We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • PhD Fellows are normally given a salary of 580 000 NOK/year with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility

Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • A motivation letter describing how this position aligns with the applicant’s research interests.
  • CV, including a list of publications, if applicable. 
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Two references with contact information

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a statement from your supervisor or institution indicating when the degree will be obtained. You must still submit your transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 

Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 

General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure.

jobs.title: Søker pålitelig BPA-tilkallingsassistent på kort varsel og ved fravær
jobs.description:
Trygg og rolig tilkallingsassistent søkes

Er du glad i frisk luft, koselige kattedyr og å utgjøre en forskjell i hverdagen? Jeg søker nå en fleksibel og pålitelig tilkallingsvikar som kan stille opp ved behov – særlig i ferier, ved fravær og når ting dukker opp på kort varsel.

Hvem er jeg?

Jeg er en kreativ og naturglad dame på 51 år som bor nord i Åsane i Bergen sammen med katten min Lucy. Fordi jeg lever med ME, varierer energien og dagsformen min fra dag til dag. På gode dager liker jeg å komme meg ut på rolige turer i skog og mark, gjerne med Lucy på slep. På tyngre dager trenger jeg mest avlastning til å holde orden i hjemmet og få hverdagen til å gå rundt. Du vil fungere som mine ekstra armer og ben, og jobben handler først og fremst om praktisk støtte i en rolig og hyggelig atmosfære.

Stillingstype

Tilkallingsvikar (ekstrahjelp ved behov, ferieavvikling og på kort varsel). Hovedsakelig dagtid etter lunsj/ettermiddag. Helg og kveld kan forekomme.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet: blant annet husarbeid, klesvask, matlaging og enkel orden
  • Være sjåfør og medhjelper på handling og korte ærender
  • Korte, rolige turer i nærområdet, skog og mark – ofte sammen med katten Lucy

Hvem er du?

  • Rolig og pålitelig: Du har en trygg og behagelig tilstedeværelse og forstår at dagsformen min kan svinge
  • Selvstendig og ryddig: Du ser hva som må gjøres i et hjem og tar gjerne praktiske initiativ
  • Glad i dyr: Du må tåle katt i stua og på tur (du kan ikke være allergisk)
  • Førerkort klasse B: Du disponerer gjerne egen bil eller er trygg som sjåfør på korte turer og bynære strøk
  • Krav: Du er over 18 år og har plettfri vandel (politiattest må fremlegges før oppstart)

Vi tilbyr

  • En trivelig, variert og meningsfull ekstrajobb i rolige omgivelser
  • Grundig opplæring direkte fra meg som din arbeidsleder
  • Ryddige og trygge arbeidsforhold gjennom Brageva med tariffestet lønn, pensjonsordning og forsikring
  • Relevante kurs og opplæring i rollen som BPA-assistent
Om arbeidsgiver

Brageva har vært formell arbeidsgiver for assistenter siden 2016. Vi har spesialisert oss på tjenesten BPA (brukerstyrt personlig assistanse) og leverer i dag denne tjenesten i hele Norge. Vi har konsesjon for å levere BPA i over 120 kommuner. Vi elsker for øvrig frigjøringsverktøyet BPA som gir mennesker med funksjonsnedsettelser muligheter til å leve selvstendige liv og bidra på alle områder i samfunnet.

Vi er en liten aktør i BPA-bransjen og har derfor korte beslutningsveier, som kommer både våre ansatte og våre arbeidsledere til gode. Vår administrasjon sitter i Trondheim og består av en herlig gjeng med ulik bakgrunn, kunnskap og personligheter. Vi er den lille BPA-leverandøren med det store hjertet.

Les mer om oss på https://brageva.no/

We are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Specialist to bridge the gap between our Customer Care and DevOps teams. You will troubleshoot technical issues by connecting the dots between customer reports and multiple systems and forming a clear hypotheses.

Hva vi ser etter Qualifications

  • Practical understanding of web applications (SaaS), mobile app sync, and how software runs in production.

  • Comfortable using application telemetry, monitoring, or server logs to validate your hypotheses efficiently without getting lost in the data.

You enjoy testing your theories through clean replication, knowing exactly when to resolve it yourself and when to package a well-scoped ticket for escalation.

Vi tilbyr

Seksjonen arbeider med oppfølging av barn, ungdom og familier i henhold til lov om barnevern. 

Seksjonen består av 13 stillingshjemler, herunder en seksjonsleder, to spesialkonsulenter og 10 barnevernkonsulenter.

Stovner barneverntjeneste har 62 stillingshjemler, lokalisert på Rommen nær bygrensen mot Nittedal, Skedsmo og Lørenskog kommune. Barneverntjenesten ledes av barnevernsjef og hver seksjon ledes av en seksjonsleder. Tjenesten er delt  inn i seksjon for mottak og undersøkelse, seksjon for barn i tiltak, seksjon omsorg og ettervern, seksjon lokale tiltak samt seksjon kontorfag. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships in Mathematical Sciences
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,600 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You can find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

     

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

We have a vacancy for up to two postdoctoral fellowships at the Department of Mathematical Sciences.

The purpose of a postdoctoral position is to build up a researcher profile that qualifies for a position as associate professor. The position may also offer additional skills that are relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career.

The Department of Mathematical Sciences wants to support excellent and highly motivated candidates within any of the Department's main research disciplines; please see https://www.ntnu.edu/imf/research/ for an overview.

The positions must start no later than October 1st, 2027.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.

Duties of the position
  • Carry out high quality research.
  • Academic publications.
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign academic institutions.
  • Teaching and other duties.
Required selection criteria
  • You must have completed a doctoral degree in one of the research areas of the Department. If you are in the final phase of your doctorate and can document that the thesis has been submitted or that the defense date has been confirmed, your application can be considered even if you have not defended. NOTE: Documentation of the obtained doctorate must be presented before you can take up the position.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

If you do not already have educational competence that meets the requirements for a position as associate professor in Norway, NTNU will arrange for you to acquire such competence during the employment period. In such cases, you will also be assigned relevant teaching as part of the career-promoting work.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions and for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Preference will be given to candidates who have a strong potential to strengthen the current research areas, or can provide a bridge between the different research activities in the department.
  • Experience with teaching.
Personal characteristics
  • Motivation for conducting research at an advanced level.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Motivation for teaching.

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer 
  • An exciting job with an important social mission.
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment.
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues.
  • Favorable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.
  • Free Norwegian language training.

As a Postdoctoral Fellow at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

As a Postdoctoral Fellow (code 1352) you are normally paid from gross NOK 667 000,- per annum before tax, depending on qualifications and seniority. From the salary, 2% is deducted as a contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The period of employment is 3 years (including 1 year of career promotion work/ teaching duties).

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and to adapt to them. 

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed

About the application 

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above.

The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request. 

The application must include:

  • A project plan written together with a permanent scientific employee (who will act as a mentor) at the Department (maximum 800 words/2 pages).
  • A brief statement from the potential mentor that they are willing to host the proposed project.
  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's-,Master's- and PhD degrees. If you have not yet completed your PhD, you must provideconfirmation on your estimated date for the doctoral dissertation, or confirmation that your PhD thesis has been submitted.
  • Documentation of a completed doctoral degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • CV, including information about teaching experience, if applicable.
  • Academic works - published or unpublished (up to 5 items).
  • Name and contact information of three referees.

If all or parts of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education. Description of the documentation required can be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.Joint works will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint works, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

If you have had leave or another break in your career, it is important that this is stated in your application so that the selection committee can take this into account and that the amount of your research may be reduced as a result.

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal qualities. Motivation, ambitions and potential for research will also be emphasized in the assessment of the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and is committed to follow evaluation criteria for research quality according to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment DORA and the obligations in CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information 

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public list of applicants, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Marte P. H. Andresen (marte.andresen@ntnu.no).

If you find this position interesting, and in accordance with your qualifications, please submit your application electronically via jobbnorge.no with your CV, diplomas and certificates attached. 

Application deadline: 10.12.2026.

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000.The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Mathematical Sciences 

We are Norway’s largest university environment in mathematical sciences. The Department has a particular responsibility for all basis education in mathematical sciences for engineering and natural science students at NTNU. We focus on long-term basic research and applied research at a high international level. Our aim is to meet the society’s needs for mathematical and statistical expertise in business and public administration as well as in the research and education sector.  The Department of Mathematical Sciences is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

jobs.title: Veileder i Meskano AS - din neste drømmejobb?
jobs.description:
Er du praktisk anlagt, god med mennesker og nysgjerrig på veilederrollen? Ta kontakt med oss og finn ut om dette er DIN drømmejobb!

Ta kontakt med kjersti.overby@meskano.no eller maria.aasheim@meskano.no eller send søknad gjennom linken.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Praktisk eller teknisk yrkes -og fagbakgrunn, gjerne fra grøntarbeid, landbruk, skogbruk, håndverk, vaktmesterarbeid eller lignende

  • Erfaring i arbeidsveiledning eller opplæring

  • Erfaring med bruk og vedlikehold av maskiner/utstyr og praktisk arbeidsledelse

  • God forståelse for HMS og sikkerhet i arbeidet

  • Evne til å lære bort, motivere og tilrettelegge for andre

  • Førerkort klasse B (BE og truckførerbevis er ønskelig)

Du må være en trygg og tydelig veileder, ha god tålmodighet og kunne holde oversikt når mye skjer samtidig. Vi legger stor vekt på personlig egnethet. Erfaring fra arbeidsinkludering er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Send oss ditt søknadsbrev og CV i dag!

Arbeidsoppgaver

Vi søker en trygg og engasjert veileder / arbeidsleder for avdelingen Plen, Service og Ved hos Meskano.

Avdelingen driver plenklipping og serviceoppdrag for kunder på Tynset i sommerhalvåret, og innendørs vedproduksjon i vår oppvarmede vedhall på vinteren. Du skal bidra til at ansatte med ulike forutsetninger opplever mestring, utvikling og arbeidsglede gjennom tilrettelagt arbeid. Arbeidet krever god arbeidsledelse og planlegging, teknisk forståelse og et særlig fokus på HMS og trygg opplæring.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Hos oss er målet å bidra til at flere får mulighet til å delta i arbeidslivet. Stillingen er særlig relevant for deg som ønsker en jobb med praktisk og pedagogisk tilnærming, og er interessert i å bidra med tilrettelegging og inkludering.

  • Lede og organisere den daglige driften av avdelingen

  • Veilede, motivere og tilrettelegge arbeidet for ansatte i varig tilrettelagt arbeid (VTA)

  • Bidra til struktur, mestring og utvikling i arbeidshverdagen

  • Sørge for god opplæring, HMS og sikker bruk av maskiner og utstyr

  • Planlegge og delta i plenklipping, serviceoppdrag og vedproduksjon

  • Følge opp kunder, vedlikehold på maskiner/utstyr og kvalitet på leveranser

  • Administrative oppgaver relatert til ansatte, utstyr, salg og HMS

  • Samarbeid med andre avdelinger på Meskano og andre instanser ved behov

Vi tilbyr

  • Bli en del av en arbeidsinkluderingsbedrift med ~50 ansatte

  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du gjør en forskjell for andre

  • En variert og aktiv arbeidshverdag med mye ansvar

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger

  • Opplæring og støtte i veilederrollen

  • Lønn etter avtale og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Meskano er Fjellregionens største arbeids- og inkluderingsbedrift, eid av de seks kommunene i Nord-Østerdalen.

I samarbeid med NAV og lokalt næringsliv jobber vi for at flere mennesker skal få mulighet til å delta i arbeidslivet. Vi leverer blant annet arbeidsmarkedstiltakene varig tilrettelagt arbeid (VTA) og arbeidsforberedende trening (AFT).

Hos oss er praktisk arbeid et viktig verktøy for inkludering, mestring og utvikling. Våre veiledere har en sentral rolle i å skape en trygg og meningsfull arbeidshverdag for den enkelte. Ta en kikk på vår hjemmeside www.meskano.no for å lære mer om oss!

jobs.title: Liker du å lage mat, reise og gjøre en forskjell i et annet menneskes hverdag?
jobs.description:
Jeg er en aktiv og sosial kvinne på 43 år som søker en fast assistent til arbeid hver tredje helg, samt flere tilkallingsassistenter. Vaktene er på 4 timer og starter kl. 11.00. Hos meg får du en meningsfull jobb der vi sammen skaper gode dager med både hverdagsliv, aktiviteter og hyggelige opplevelser.

Om meg

Jeg er 43 år gammel og bruker rullestol i hverdagen. Jeg er engasjert i foreningsarbeid,teater,konserter og liker å være aktiv og setter stor pris på å reise og oppleve nye steder. Jeg trives med sosialt samvær, gode samtaler og et hjem hvor det er hyggelig å være.

For meg er det viktig å ha assistenter som bidrar til at hverdagen flyter godt, samtidig som vi kan ha det hyggelig sammen. Kjemi og personlig egnethet betyr derfor mye.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet bestå av:

  • Bistand til personlig hygiene og morgenrutiner
  • Praktisk hjelp i hjemmet
  • Matlaging og tilrettelegging av måltider
  • Følge til aktiviteter og avtaler ved behov
  • Bidra til at hverdagen fungerer godt og smidig

Oppgavene vil variere noe, men du vil få god opplæring.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg tror du er en person som:

  • Liker å lage mat og gjerne prøver nye oppskrifter
  • Er pålitelig og punktlig
  • Har en positiv innstilling og godt humør
  • Er selvstendig, men også flink til å samarbeide
  • Er komfortabel med å bistå med personlig hygiene
  • Verdsetter gode relasjoner og respektfull kommunikasjon

Erfaring som assistent er ikke nødvendig. Det viktigste er at vi trives sammen, og at du ønsker å bidra til at jeg kan leve det livet jeg ønsker.

Hva tilbyr jeg?

  • En meningsfull og variert jobb
  • Et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø med nær kontakt med arbeidsleder
  • God opplæring og oppfølging
  • Mulighet til å gjøre en reell forskjell i et annet menneskes hverdag
  • Kurs og oppfølging gjennom Prima Assistanse

Praktisk informasjon

  • Fast stilling hver tredje helg
  • Tilkallingsassistenter søkes også
  • Vaktene er på 4 timer og starter kl. 11.00
  • Oppstart etter avtale

Høres dette ut som en jobb for deg? Da håper jeg du sender inn en søknad. Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra akkurat deg!

 

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Job i dansk kundeservice på Cypern
jobs.description:
Vil du hjælpe danske kunder og prøve hverdagen på Cypern? Jobsun søger på vegne af en international virksomhed dansktalende kundeservicemedarbejdere til to stillinger på et kontor i Larnaca. Du kan arbejde med gaming og spillekonsoller eller med apps og digitale tjenester.

I begge stillinger hjælper du danske kunder via telefon, chat og e-mail. Du bliver en del af et internationalt team og får oplæring i de systemer og produkter, du skal arbejde med.

Gaming og spillekonsoller

Du hjælper kunder med spørgsmål om spillekonsoller, brugerkonti og onlinetjenester. Det kan være en kunde, der har problemer med at logge ind, oplever en ustabil forbindelse eller har spørgsmål til en betaling. Du hjælper med fejlfinding og sender mere komplekse sager videre til det rette team.

  • Arbejdstid. Mandag til fredag med vagter inden for kl. 09.00 til 19.30 lokal tid. Du har fri i weekenden.

  • Oplæring. Fem uger, mandag til fredag kl. 10.00 til 18.45 lokal tid.

  • Kontrakt. To år med seks måneders prøvetid og mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse.

Apps og digitale tjenester

Du guider brugere i at bruge apps og hjemmesider, hjælper med almindelige tekniske problemer og håndterer spørgsmål og klager. Når en sag kræver yderligere hjælp, sender du den videre til det relevante team.

  • Arbejdstid. Skiftende vagter inden for kl. 09.00 til 21.00 lokal tid, mandag til søndag. Der indgår weekendarbejde.

  • Oplæring. Mandag til fredag kl. 09.00 til 17.30 lokal tid.

Løn og arbejdssted

Begge stillinger er på 40 timer om ugen og foregår på virksomhedens kontor i Larnaca. Den faste månedsløn er 1.350 euro før skat og stiger til 1.400 euro efter seks måneders ansættelse.

Hvem søger vi?

  • Du taler og skriver dansk på C2-niveau og har engelskkundskaber på mindst B2-niveau.

  • Du har afsluttet en gymnasial uddannelse eller tilsvarende.

  • Du er fortrolig med IT og kan forklare en løsning, så kunden kan følge med.

  • Du er tålmodig, serviceminded og god til at bevare overblikket.

  • Du er EU-borger og bor på Cypern eller er klar til at flytte dertil.

Erfaring med kundeservice eller teknisk support er en fordel. Til gamingstillingen er det også en fordel, hvis du interesserer dig for spillekonsoller.

Hjælp til at flytte til Cypern

Hvis du flytter til Cypern for jobbet, kan du vælge mellem to flyttepakker.

  • 1.500 euro i flyttetilskud. Tilskuddet udbetales to til tre uger efter jobstart. Du arrangerer og betaler i første omgang selv fly og bolig.

  • Op til 300 euro i refusion af flybilletten og mulighed for indkvartering i op til to måneder. Første måned er gratis, og anden måned koster 100 euro. Du booker selv flybilletten.

Vi gennemgår betingelserne for flyttepakken med dig under rekrutteringen.

Jobsun er med dig under hele opholdet

Jobsun er din kontaktperson og mentor før afrejse, under opstarten og gennem hele dit ophold. Du kan altid kontakte os, hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet, hverdagen på Cypern eller har brug for hjælp til noget praktisk.

Interesseret? Et CV er nok

Der er løbende opstart med mulighed for at starte i november eller december 2026.

Send dit CV via ansøgningsmuligheden i opslaget. Du behøver ikke skrive en ansøgning. Hvis du allerede ved, hvilken af de to stillinger du foretrækker, må du gerne nævne det.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer

This job posting expires on 25th November 2026.If you have any questions about your application, please contact Zsofia Tamaska - zsofia.tamaska@tetrapak.com.For trade union information, contact Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320 and Akademikerklubben Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533A background check may be performed on the final candidate as part of the recruitment process.Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities togrow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

jobs.title: Hays - Solution Architect
jobs.description:
You will join a Belgian IT department of approximately 30 professionals who work closely with colleagues and external partners across multiple countries. The environment includes a mix of modern and legacy systems, requiring a pragmatic and adaptable approach to technology and architecture. The company values collaboration, knowledge sharing and sustainable growth while maintaining a strong focus on work-life balance.

Your new role

As a Solution Architect, you play a key role in translating business needs into scalable and secure technology solutions. You work closely with business stakeholders, analysts, developers and architects to define the technical direction of projects and ensure successful implementation. Your responsibilities include:
  • Translating business and IT requirements into end-to-end solution designs
  • Creating and documenting architecture and technical designs
  • Defining the technologies, integration patterns and architectural standards to be applied
  • Analysing how different applications and platforms interact within the organisation
  • Supporting the evolution of complex application landscapes
  • Ensuring security, quality and architectural consistency across solutions
  • Collaborating with business stakeholders and IT teams in Belgium and abroad
  • Guiding development teams and providing technical leadership
  • Assisting in the resolution of complex technical challenges
  • Promoting best practices related to software architecture, integration and application design
You will operate in an international environment where collaboration with both local and offshore teams is part of daily business.

What you'll get in return

You will join a stable international organisation that offers flexibility, autonomy and opportunities for professional growth. The package includes:
  • Gross monthly salary between EUR6.000 and EUR7.100 depending on experience
  • Company car
  • Meal vouchers (EUR8 per day, with employee contribution)
  • Hospitalisation and group insurance
  • 35-hour working week
  • Flexible working hours
  • Hybrid working possibilities and flexibility in organising your agenda
  • Easily accessible office location by public transport
  • Career development opportunities within an international environment
Training and certification opportunities can be discussed with the hiring manager depending on team priorities and development plans. For this Solution Architect position, we are looking for an experienced IT professional who combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills. You ideally have:
  • Fluency in English, combined with French or Dutch
  • At least 8 years of relevant IT experience
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience
  • Solid experience with Java-based environments
  • Strong knowledge of API architectures, REST APIs and Swagger/OpenAPI
  • Experience with MicroServices architectures
  • Knowledge of container platforms such as Kubernetes, OpenShift and Docker
  • Understanding of authentication and security concepts, including OAuth2 and OpenID Connect
  • Experience designing application and solution architectures
  • The ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience in consultancy or large international organisations is considered a strong asset. Experience within the financial sector is welcomed but not required.

What you need to do now
