jobs.title: Er du min nye personlige assistent? Kvinne 30 år søker tilkallingsvikarer
jobs.description:
Er du min nye personlige assistent? Kvinne 30 år søker BPA-assistent sentralt i Bergen.

Jeg søker deg som trives med alt fra å trene, være med på aktiviteter, lage mat, turer, svømming og å holde orden på hus og hjem. Jobben som personlig assistent hos meg innebærer å assistere med praktiske gjøremål i hverdagen slik at jeg kan leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv.

Jeg søker deg som er serviceinnstilt, positiv, fleksibel og pålitelig. Du bør like nye utfordringer og kunne tilpasse deg ulike arbeidssituasjoner. Det er kjekt om du deler min interesse for idrett, men dette er ikke et krav.

Du bør være strukturert, oppmerksom og utadvendt. Du må ha gode evner til samarbeid og kommunikasjon, og samtidig kunne jobbe selvstendig.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Bistå med praktisk assistanse i og utenfor hjemmet, bl.a. ved trening, svømming, matlaging, handling, personlige gjøremål og andre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til hverdagslivet.

Jeg kan tilby:

En variert og lærerik jobb i et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø. Opplæring gis ved ansettelse. Jeg blir din arbeidsleder og Prima Assistanse blir din formelle arbeidsgiver. Du trenger ikke å ha erfaring fra liknende arbeid, da det viktigste er at du er motivert til å lære.

Jeg søker tilkallingsvikarer som har mulighet til å stille på kort varsel. Arbeidstid vil hovedsakelig være på ettermiddager i ukedager og i helg. Noen vakter på dagtid i ukedagene kan forekomme, men dette er sjeldent. Konkurransedyktig lønn.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Ikke allergisk mot klor (p.g.a. assistanse ved svømming)
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt
  • Det er med fordel om du kan bli med på reise i forbindelse med idrettsamling
  • Kvinner oppfordres til å søke grunnet jobbens art

Arbeidssted: Bergen

Søkere innkalles til intervju fortløpende. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Ønsker du å følge opp enslige mindreårige flyktninger?
jobs.description:
Nav Vestre Aker er et av de minste Nav-kontorene i Oslo. Vi har et stort hjerte og en sterk vilje til å gi mennesker muligheter. Vi er lokalisert i Sørkedalsveien 150, og betjener bydelens innbyggere på ca. 50.000.  

Intro- og bosettingsteamet jobber med å gi flyktninger de verktøyene og ressursene de trenger for å lykkes i sitt nye hjemland. Vårt team er engasjert og kompetent, og vi er stolte av å kunne tilby en helhetlig og koordinert oppfølging som sikrer at hver enkelt flyktning får den støtten de trenger. Hos oss vil du finne et team som brenner for å gjøre en forskjell og som jobber sammen for å skape et inkluderende samfunn hvor alle har mulighet til å bidra. 

Vi søker en veileder som skal ha ansvar for oppfølging av enslige mindreårige flyktninger. Oppfølging av enslige mindreårige flyktninger er et samarbeid mellom Nav og barneverntjenesten i bydelen. Stillingen fordeler seg derfor 50% i Nav og 50% i barneverntjenesten. 

Vi søker deg som: 

  • Tenker og tror på muligheter og jobb først 
  • Er opptatt av å ta vare på mennesker 
  • Tør å stå i samtaler med mennesker i sårbare livssituasjoner 
  • Har et stort engasjement for Navs samfunnsoppdrag 
  • Klarer å være strukturert i en hverdag som aldri er lik 
  • Nav Vestre Aker er i stadig utvikling, og vi forventer at våre ansatte bidrar inn i dette arbeidet slik at vi kan tilby stadig bedre tjenester for brukerne våre. 

Verden er i endring, og arbeidsoppgavene i stillingen kan forandre seg. Du må derfor trives med endring. Fast ansettelse under forutsetning om at stillingen godkjennes i MBU i bydelen. Intervjuer gjennomføres onsdag 25. november. 

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Helhetlig oppfølging av enslige mindreårige flyktninger i både barneverntjenesten og Nav. Målgruppen kan endre seg. 
  • Kartlegging av ressurser og behov inn mot en selvstendig tilværelse. 
  • Følge ungdommer i overgang til utdanning og jobb. 
  • Sikre helhetlig og koordinert oppfølging etter integreringsloven, barnevernsloven, Nav-loven, folketrygdloven, sosialtjenesteloven og tiltaksforskriften. 
  • Saksbehandling etter gjeldende lovverk. 
  • Samarbeide tett med andre relevante aktører, både innenfor og utenfor Nav-kontoret. Særlig Utdanningsetaten og Oslo Voksenopplæring.  
  • Bidra til at de som bosettes knyttes systematisk opp mot aktiviteter og kontakter i frivillig sektor. 
  • Gi praktisk bistand til unge flyktninger i bosettingsfasen, samt bistå ungdommen i å bli kjent med byen og nærmiljøet. 
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Du må ha overblikk og forståelse for Nav sitt virkeområde og samspill med andre samarbeidspartnere, spesielt arbeidsgivere. 
  • Erfaring fra Nav og kjennskap til Nav sine fagsystemer, herunder erfaring fra saksbehandling etter Lov om sosiale tjenester og bruk av Navs tiltak og virkemidler. 
  • Erfaring med barnevernets fagsystem, Modulus.  
  • Arbeidserfaring og/eller dokumentert kompetanse fra å jobbe med integrering og inkludering av arbeidssøkere med innvandrerbakgrunn. 
  • Kjennskap til Oslo Voksenopplæring og deres ansvarsområde er en fordel. 
  • Det er en stor fordel om du snakker og forstår ukrainsk. 
  • Fullført utdannelse på minimum bachelorgradsnivå, helst innen pedagogikk, sosialfag, humanistiske, juridiske eller samfunnsvitenskapelige fag. 
  • Meget god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne, gjerne erfaring fra undervisning og å holde workshops og gruppeveiledning. 
  • Generelt god kompetanse på IKT- og dataverktøy. 
  • Det legges vekt på barnevernfaglig erfaring rundt oppfølging av ungdommer som skal etablere seg i et nytt land alene uten egen kjernefamilie 
  • Det er ønskelig at søker har nettverksfokus. Dette innebærer også å ha kontakt med brukers familie i hjemlandet 
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du må ha gode evner til å forstå andres perspektiv – trygg i møte med mennesker i en sårbar situasjon. 
  • Et indre driv og en vilje til å stå på – du må tåle høyt arbeidspress og å følge opp mennesker i krevende livssituasjoner over tid. 
  • Selvstendig, selvgående og i stand til å fatte beslutninger – du må lære kjapt og ta ansvar for egen læring. 
  • Du må være omstillingsdyktig og trives med å bidra i endringsprosesser – både arbeidshverdagen og samfunnet endrer seg raskt. 
  • God til å samarbeide og motivere - skape og dele gode løsninger kolleger og samarbeidspartnere. 
  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges. 
Vi tilbyr
  • Meningsfulle og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver. 
  • Engasjerte kolleger, som brenner for å hjelpe mennesker. 
  • Store muligheter for å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag. 
  • Store muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling. 
  • Gruppeveiledning med obligatorisk deltakelse. 
  • Innplassering som sosialkonsulent i stillingskode 0106000, lønnsramme 22, alt. 7 (34-43). Dette tilsvarer en årslønn mellom kr.  633 200 – 740 600.  
  • God pensjonsordning gjennom Oslo pensjonsforsikring
KontaktinformasjonVilde Borgersen, Avdelingsleder , 45863387, vilde.borgersen@nav.no ArbeidsstedSørkedalsveien 150 b 0754 OSLO Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo kommune Referansenr.: 5204430432 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 22.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Bydel Vestre Aker har vi som målsetning å skape selvstendighet, mestring, trygghet og fellesskap gjennom våre tjenestetilbud. Våre ansatte er en viktig ressurs i dette arbeidet, og vi er opptatte av å rekruttere dyktige medarbeidere som ønsker å skape gode fremtidsrettede tjenester for bydelens beboere. Bydelen ligger vest i Oslo med kort vei til sentrum, og det bor ca. 50 000 innbyggere her. 

Arbeidsplassene i Oslo kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Oslo kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du behov for det.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet, men dette vil du i så tilfelle få varsel om.

jobs.title: BPA-assistenter søkes – bonuspoeng hvis du vet hvor alle barnas sko har blitt av 👟😅
jobs.description:
Er du en person som klarer å holde hodet kaldt når tre ting skjer samtidig, som liker barn, og som ikke er redd for å ta i et tak? Da kan du være akkurat den BPA-assistenten vi ser etter!

Jeg er mamma til fire herlige barn og søker nå BPA-assistenter som kan være med på å få hverdagen til å gå litt smidigere. Hos oss er ingen dager helt like. Det kan være levering i barnehagen, kjøring til aktiviteter, handling, husarbeid eller å hjelpe meg med å holde oversikt når kroppen og hodet bestemmer seg for å samarbeide litt mindre enn planlagt.

Hvem er jeg?

Jeg lever med flere helseutfordringer, blant annet fibromyalgi, FND, hypotyreose, ADHD og kompleks PTSD.

På gode dager er jeg aktiv, engasjert og liker å få ting gjort. Samtidig er ADHD-en en fast følgesvenn som sørger for at planlegging, struktur og organisering ikke alltid går helt av seg selv. Selv på mine beste dager kan jeg derfor ha nytte av en assistent som hjelper meg med å holde litt orden på både planer, gjøremål og alle de geniale idéene som dukker opp underveis.

På mindre gode dager kan kroppen føles som om batteriet gikk tomt for flere timer siden. Da er det ekstra godt å ha en assistent som kan bidra med praktiske oppgaver, skape struktur i hverdagen og være en trygg støtte når energien ikke strekker til. 😊

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Levere og hente barn i barnehage
  • Følge til fritidsaktiviteter
  • Praktisk hjelp i hjemmet
  • Handle og løpe ærender
  • Bidra til struktur og oversikt i hverdagen
  • Hjelpe til når helsen plutselig setter inn bremsene
  • Være en ekstra trygg voksen rundt barna

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Du trenger ikke være superhelt, men det skader ikke å være litt god på logistikk.

Du er gjerne:

✅ Glad i barn

✅ Tålmodig og trygg

✅ Selvstendig og løsningsorientert

✅ Fleksibel når planer må justeres

✅ Praktisk anlagt

✅ Innehaver av førerkort klasse B

Det er også en fordel om du kan finne ting som ligger rett foran meg uten å si: "Har du sett ordentlig etter?" 😄

Hva får du?

  • En meningsfull jobb der du utgjør en stor forskjell
  • En variert arbeidshverdag
  • Mye latter, små og store øyeblikk
  • Opplæring og oppfølging
  • Lønn etter gjeldende ordninger

Arbeidstid:

Vil variere mellom dag og kveld, men ser for oss dagvakter fra 0800 -1200 og kveldsvakter 15-20.00.

Personlig egnethet er viktigere enn lang erfaring. Det viktigste er at du er en person som skaper trygghet, har godt humør og ønsker å bidra til at en familie får en bedre hverdag.

Kjenner du deg igjen? Da håper jeg du sender en søknad. Kanskje er du akkurat den hverdagshelten vi leter etter! 🌟

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: PhD position in forest genetics
jobs.description: Would you like to help develop the next generation of birch forests? Join our research team and investigate how flowering and seed production can support faster progress in forest tree breeding.Improved planting material contributes to productive and resilient forests. In silver birch, efficient breeding and reliable seed production depend on our ability to understand and influence flowering. Skogforsk is seeking a motivated PhD student to investigate these processes and develop methods that can be applied in breeding programmes and seed production.The position is part of Phase II of Trees For Me, a centre of excellence focusing on fast-growing broadleaved trees for sustainable forests, materials and energy.Research project and dutiesThe overall aim of this four-year PhD project is to improve our understanding of flowering in silver birch and develop practical methods to promote early and reliable flowering and seed production.The project will investigate how environmental conditions and cultivation treatments influence flowering in young plants and older breeding material. Particular attention will be given to light conditions, plant development and genetic differences in flowering responses. The research will connect fundamental questions about reproductive development with practical challenges in birch breeding.Earlier flowering could shorten the breeding cycle and help realise the benefits of genomic selection by allowing selected individuals to be crossed at a younger age. Improved control of flowering could also support more reliable seed production.Your work will include:    Planning, establishing and managing experiments in controlled environments, greenhouses and, where relevant, the field.    Assessing growth, development, male and female flowering, and seed production and quality.    Analysing experimental data using statistical methods.    Publishing scientific papers and communicating results to researchers, breeders and other stakeholders.    Completing doctoral courses in forest genetics, breeding and related subjects.The detailed research questions and experimental programme will be developed together with the supervisory team.Trees For Me – Phase IITrees For Me brings together universities, research institutes, industry and public-sector organisations to develop knowledge and solutions for the sustainable use of fast-growing broadleaved trees, including birch, poplar and aspen.Within Phase II, this PhD project will contribute knowledge and methods to strengthen birch breeding and the supply of improved reproductive material. The student will participate in an interdisciplinary research environment and collaborate with researchers and stakeholders across the forest sector.Research environmentThe project is a collaboration between Skogforsk and the Southern Swedish Forest Research Centre at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Alnarp. The student will be employed by Skogforsk and based at the Ekebo research station in Svalöv, with doctoral enrolment at SLU.You will join a team working with forest tree genetics, breeding and seed production. The position offers close contact with operational breeding, access to experimental facilities and breeding material, and opportunities for national and international collaboration.QualificationsWe are looking for a motivated and curious candidate with a master’s degree in forestry, biology, plant science, genetics, environmental science or an equivalent subject relevant to the project.You should have an interest in experimental research, plant development and the practical application of scientific results. Good communication skills and proficiency in spoken and written English are essential.The following qualifications are considered merits:    Knowledge of plant physiology, flowering biology, forest genetics or tree breeding.    Experience in establishing and managing plant experiments.    Experience in statistical analysis and programming in R or equivalent software.    Experience working with plants in greenhouses, controlled environments or field trials.You should be able to work independently and collaboratively, organise your work carefully and take responsibility for practical experiments. A valid driving licence is required.Applicants must meet SLU’s requirements for admission to doctoral studies.Employment and applicationEmployment: Four-year, fixed-term employment as a PhD student at Skogforsk.Location: Ekebo research station, Svalöv, Sweden.Starting date: By agreement.Application deadline: 6 December.Your application should include:    A cover letter describing your motivation, relevant experience and research interests.    A CV.Degree certificates and transcripts.    Contact details for two referees.Send your application to eva.persson@skogforsk.se, using the subject line “PhD application – birch”. Deadline for application is 6th of December.For further information, please contact Mateusz Liziniewicz (mateusz.liziniewicz@skogforsk.se), Researcher, Skogforsk.About SkogforskSkogforsk is the Swedish forestry research institute. Our vision is "World-class forestry for sustainable development." We develop and communicate knowledge, services, and products that contribute to the sustainable development of forestry for the benefit of society.We operate at three locations: Uppsala, Sävar in Västerbotten, and Ekebo in Skåne. In total, we have approximately 160 employees.At Ekebo, our research includes forest tree breeding, genetics and the production of improved planting material.

jobs.title: Kokk - 14/14 rotasjon
jobs.employer: COOR CLEANING CATERING AND PROPERTY AVD HAMMERFEST KANTINER EQUINOR
jobs.description:
Du utgjør hele forskjellen!

Vi som jobber i Coor er lidenskapelig opptatt av å yte god service, brenner for å gi våre gjester gode matopplevelser og skape en hyggelig arbeidsdag for alle med mat og drikke som dagens høydepunkter.

Er du drevet av å skape magiske øyeblikk for gjestene og levere topp kvalitet – så kan dette være din neste utfordring.

I Coor blir du del av en kultur der det er forskjellene våre som bringer oss videre. Vi vet at magi oppstår i møtet mellom forskjellige bakgrunner, ferdigheter og personligheter. Vi ser det hver eneste dag. Vi er over 12 000 ansatte, og sammen kan vi oppnå mye. Så bli med og gjør oss bedre basert på den du er. Velkommen til oss - hos Coor utgjør du hele forskjellen!

Hvem er vi?

Coor tilbyr en trygg arbeidsplass med en imøtekommende og inkluderende kultur, hvor du har sjansen til å utvikle deg i din karriere samtidig som du har en god balanse i hverdagen.

Som kokk leverer du en opplevelse i toppklasse med fokus på gjesteopplevelse, samarbeid og service. Vi serverer både godt tilberedt mat på tallerken og tilbyr smakskombinasjoner med fleksibel meny for å redusere matsvinn.

I Coor er gjesten alltid i fokus, og vi ønsker at våre kokker skal være synlige og tilstedeværende for gjestene.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver og ansvar:

  • Tilberede og presentere mat av høy kvalitet i parsonalrestauranten(e)
  • Produsere varm og kald mat
  • Varemottak og daglig lagerstyring
  • Etterleve og utføre daglige interne IK-mat/HACCP-rutiner
  • Etterleve våre konsepter og matfilosofi
  • Bidra til å videreutvikle vår leveranse hos kunden
  • Delta på møter og samlinger
  • Bidra til å skape et godt team med stå på vilje
  • Stedfortreder for kantineleder ved ferieavvikling etc.
  • Sørg for at hygieneprosedyrer og mathåndtering alltid følges
  • Arbeide aktivt for å redusere matsvinn og implementere bærekraftige løsninger

Om tjenesten

  • Ansettelsesform: Fast ansettelse
  • Stillingsprosent: Heltid 100%
  • Arbeidstid: etter avtale
  • Oppstart: etter avtale

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som har en genuin interesse for matlaging og service. Du elsker å overgå gjestenes forventninger, og trives på et kjøkken hvor tempoet kan være høyt men stemningen alltid er god. Du er selvstendig, men ser på deg selv som en lagspiller som alltid har øye for detaljer.

Vi ser etter deg som er/har:

  • Sterk faglig kunnskap om mat, presentasjon og god service
  • Fagbrev som kokk, lang arbeidserfaring kan erstatte fagbrev
  • Interesse og lidenskap for mat og god service
  • Strukturert og fleksibel i hverdagen. Har overblikk og hjelpe til der hvor det trengs
  • En fantastisk kollega med gode kommunikasjonsevner
  • Kan kommunisere på skandinavisk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig
  • Kreativ, utadvendt, positiv utstråling og selvstendig

Hos oss får du:

  • Mulighet til å bygge videre på din kompetanse med spennende og varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • En spennende og variert arbeidsplass i et godt sosialt arbeidsmiljø
  • Nært samarbeid med et bredt fagmiljø i en organisasjon i utvikling
  • Bli en del av et sterkt tverrfaglig team hvor latteren sitter løst og vi spiller hverandre gode
  • Vi er opptatt av din helse og har en god avtale med Naardic om fri digital trening for alle våre ansatte

Kunden og kontrakten har strenge krav til oppfølging av HMS. Dette innebærer risikovurdering, forståelse og sikker jobbutførelse i en positiv HMS-kultur.

Annen informasjon:

Vi tar personvern på alvor og mottar derfor kun søknader sendt via vår annonse.

Ved spørsmål, ta gjerne kontakt med: Bard.Masdalen@coor.com

Vi ser frem til å motta søknaden din!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Coor møter vi hverandre med nysgjerrighet og varme. Hos oss jobber mennesker med ulik bakgrunn, personlighet og talent – og det er nettopp dette mangfoldet som gjør oss sterkere. Vi lærer av hverandre, støtter hverandre og skaper mer verdi for kundene våre når vi blir inkludert og får tillit.

Coor er service – vi tar hånd om kundens arbeidsplass. Vi drifter og vedlikeholder bygninger, lager mat, rengjør, leverer post, ønsker gjester velkommen og sørger for at alt fungerer slik det skal – hver dag. Totalt leverer vi hundrevis av Facility Management-tjenester til noen av Nordens største virksomheter.

Vårt felles oppdrag er å skape de beste arbeidsmiljøene i Norden – hyggelige, sunne og inspirerende, både for kundene våre og for oss selv. Vi skaper verdi ved å utføre, lede og utvikle serviceleveransene, slik at kundene våre kan konsentrere seg om det de gjør best.

Gjennom vår sterke kultur og ved godt samarbeid har vi det morsommere på jobb – og vi leverer bedre. Kanskje er det derfor vi er ett av Nordens ledende selskaper innen Facility Management.

jobs.title: Utbildningsledare med starkt näringslivsfokus
jobs.description: Är du en driven, social och organiserad person som tycker om att bygga relationer, nätverka och skapa nya samarbeten? Trivs du med att träffa företag, knyta kontakter och aktivt arbeta med näringslivet? Är du dessutom en person som gärna tar egna initiativ, lyfter luren och tar direktkontakt med företag för att skapa nya möjligheter? Samtidigt har du ett engagemang för utbildning och att hjälpa studerande att lyckas. Då kan detta vara rollen för dig!Om rollenSom utbildningsledare på Grit Academy har du en central roll där du kombinerar studentstöd och utbildningsadministration med ett omfattande arbete mot näringslivet.En betydande del av tjänsten handlar om att utveckla, stärka och underhålla våra samarbeten med företag och arbetslivet. Du arbetar aktivt med att skapa nya kontakter, bygga långsiktiga relationer, utveckla vårt företagsnätverk och säkerställa att våra utbildningar har en stark förankring i näringslivet.Du ansvarar även för mentorskap, studentuppföljning, LIA (praktikplatser) och samordning av utbildningarnas ledningsgrupper. I rollen ingår också att bidra till arbetet med utbildningsansökningar, särskilt när det gäller samverkan med arbetslivet och att säkerställa näringslivets engagemang i våra utbildningar.Rollen passar dig som är utåtriktad, självgående och resultatorienterad. Du tar egna initiativ, söker aktivt upp nya företagskontakter och trivs med att skapa möjligheter genom personliga möten och direktkontakt.Tjänsten är på 100 % och arbetet utgår från vår arbetsplats i centrala Malmö.Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden    Näringslivssamarbete: Aktivt utveckla och underhålla relationer med företag, skapa nya kontakter och bygga långsiktiga samarbeten med arbetslivet.    Nätverkande och företagskontakter: Representera Grit Academy vid företagsbesök, möten och nätverksträffar samt proaktivt kontakta företag för att utveckla vårt nätverk och skapa nya samarbeten.    LIA-hantering: Aktivt arbeta med att hitta, organisera och säkerställa praktikplatser för våra studerande samt utveckla samarbeten med LIA-företag och handledare.    Utbildningsansökningar: Medverka i arbetet med ansökningar om nya och befintliga utbildningar, med särskilt fokus på arbetslivets behov, företagskontakter och näringslivets medverkan.    Ledningsgruppsarbete: Samordna och utveckla utbildningarnas ledningsgrupper, planera möten och upprätthålla en aktiv dialog med ledamöterna.    Studentstöd och mentorskap: Handleda, coacha och följa upp studerandes utveckling för att hjälpa dem att nå sina mål och ta examen.    Administration och uppföljning: Arbeta strukturerat med utbildningsadministration, dokumentation, planering och kvalitetsuppföljning.Vem vi sökerFör att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:    Akademisk examen och erfarenhet av handledning, coachning, utbildning eller liknande arbete.    En utåtriktad och relationsskapande personlighet med ett genuint intresse för att träffa företag och bygga professionella nätverk.    Erfarenhet av eller god förmåga att etablera och utveckla samarbeten med företag och andra externa aktörer.    En naturlig initiativförmåga och trygghet i att lyfta luren, ta direktkontakt med nya företag och självständigt boka möten.    God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att representera en verksamhet professionellt, både i enskilda möten och inför grupper.    Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat, självständigt och resultatorienterat med flera parallella processer.    Ett genuint engagemang för utbildning, studerandes utveckling och kopplingen mellan utbildning och arbetsliv.    Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personlighet, ditt driv och din förmåga att skapa relationer.Du är en person som får energi av att möta människor, tycker om att nätverka och har lätt för att etablera förtroende. Du är inte rädd för att ta nya initiativ, lyfta luren eller kontakta företag du inte tidigare har någon relation till. Du väntar inte på att möjligheter ska uppstå, utan arbetar aktivt för att skapa dem.Samtidigt är du organiserad, ansvarstagande och har förmågan att kombinera ett aktivt arbete mot näringslivet med studentstöd och utbildningsadministration.Du trivs i en entreprenöriell miljö där eget ansvar, initiativförmåga och ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt värdesätts.Om Grit AcademyGrit Academy är en yrkeshögskola i centrala Malmö med nära koppling till näringslivet. Vi arbetar för att ge våra studerande rätt kompetens och goda förutsättningar att lyckas i arbetslivet.Hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat team där varje medarbetare har möjlighet att påverka och bidra till verksamhetens utveckling. Vår arbetsmiljö präglas av samarbete, entreprenörskap och personligt ansvar.Vi erbjuder en centralt belägen arbetsplats, friskvård och pensionsavsättningar.Kontakt och ansökanSkicka ditt CV och personliga brev på svenska till rekrytering@gritacademy.se.För att effektivisera vår rekryteringsprocess vill vi gärna att du även besvarar följande frågor i din ansökan:    När skulle du kunna tillträda tjänsten?    Vilket lönespann har du i åtanke?    Beskriv kortfattat din erfarenhet av att skapa och utveckla företagskontakter och samarbeten med näringslivet.Ange referensen Utbildningsledare näringsliv i din ansökan.Vi gör löpande urval, så skicka gärna din ansökan så snart som möjligt.Ansökningar skrivna med ChatGPT eller liknande AI-verktyg undanbedes, liksom oseriösa ansökningar.Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer for Web Platform .NET / 3D / ML
jobs.description:
Building the future of workspace design at Inspacion

Inspacion is a 100% bootstrapped ETH Spin-off based in Schlieren, Zurich. Our SaaS product is being used by major hospitals, manufacturing companies, and partners within Europe.

Our web platform and VR software currently enables whole teams in various industries, ranging from healthcare to manufacturing, to design optimal workspaces. As a software engineer at Inspacion, you will be part of a team building the future of how organizations plan and operate buildings with the use of machine learning, 3D web-apps and virtual reality technologies.

Your responsibilities

As a software engineer in our team, you will take responsibility for key parts of our web platform and solve challenges at the forefront of machine learning and advanced language model integration for building scalable solutions in an agile fashion:

  • Architect, implement, and maintain technical solutions (web services, web UIs, data persistence) using cloud technologies.

  • Fast prototyping, testing, and implementation of software components for machine learning approaches and Web3D applications.

  • Take an active part defining both the roadmap of the platform and the long-term vision of the product.

  • Deploy and maintain software and systems on-premises at customers where security and privacy is key.

Benefits

We are looking for a proactive, growth-minded Service Manager to lead our Norwegian accounting team and take ownership of key customer relationships. This is your opportunity to make a visible impact – shaping how we lead our team, serve our customers, and grow our operations in Norway.

Journey that awaits you

As the key link between your team, our customers and Staria’s delivery teams, you will build trusted partnerships and shape scalable services that help both our accounting team and customers succeed.

By creating clarity, anticipating risks, and turning decisions into action, you will keep priorities, responsibilities, and deadlines on track. You will also work closely with Sales to help accelerate Staria’s growth in Norway. While there is no individual sales target, you will act as a trusted subject-matter expert, uncovering customer needs, identifying opportunities to expand partnerships, and ensuring our solutions create value for both customers and Staria.

jobs.description: Etsitkö mukavaa ja joustavaa palkkatyötä ilman koulutus- tai tutkintovaatimusta? Haluatko itse vaikuttaa omaan työmäärääsi sekä siihen, missä ja milloin työskentelet? Koetko muiden ihmisten auttamisen tärkeäksi ja haluat tehdä työtä, josta jää hyvä mieli? Mikäli vastasit yllä oleviin kysymyksiin kyllä, suosittelemme sinulle henkilökohtaisen avustajan töitä Aarre Avustajilla. Alta löydät lisätietoja Aarre Avustajista ja henkilökohtaisen avustajan työstä sekä linkin työnhakulomakkeeseen, jonka kautta voit hakea meille helposti töihin ilman erillistä CV:tä. Otathan rohkeasti yhteyttä, mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää!Helposti täytettävän työnhakulomakkeen löydät tästä linkistä: https://www.tuntinetti.fi/AarreAvustajatHakulomake.htmlTÖITÄ TARJOLLA HENKILÖKOHTAISENA AVUSTAJANAEtsimme nyt asiakkaillemme uusia henkilökohtaisia avustajia tärkeään, mutta joustavaan avustustyöhön. Työ on palkkatyötä yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti ja sopii niin kokopäiväistä, osa-aikaista, satunnaista kuin keikkatyötäkin etsivälle hyvälle tyypille. Henkilökohtaisena avustajana saat itse määritellä, kuinka paljon ja milloin työskentelet, joten avustajan työ sopii myös toisen työn tai opiskelun ohelle. Sinulla ei tarvitse olla erityistä koulutusta avustajan työhön, vaan oikea asenne ja luotettavuus ovat tärkeimmät ominaisuudet erinomaiselle henkilökohtaiselle avustajalle. Aarre Avustajilla saat jatkuvan tuen ja ohjauksen omalta toimihenkilöltäsi, etkä jää koskaan asioittesi tai kysymyksiesi kanssa yksin, sen lupaamme. MITÄ HENKILÖKOHTAINEN APU ON JA MITÄ AVUSTAJA TEKEE?Henkilökohtainen apu on palvelu, jossa henkilökohtainen avustaja toimii asiakkaan käsinä ja jalkoina toteuttaen niitä toimia, jotka asiakas tekisi itse, mutta ei niistä vamman tai sairauden vuoksi selviä yksin. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tarkoitus on auttaa asiakasta jokapäiväisissä arjen tehtävissä niin kotona kuin myös kodin ulkopuolella. Avustustehtävät ovat usein tavallisia arkisia askareita, joita me kaikki toteutamme myös omassa arjessamme. Avustajan työhön ei siten sisälly tehtäviä, jotka vaativat erillistä, esimerkiksi lähihoitajan tutkintoa, vaan kuka tahansa voi toimia avustajana. Avustustehtäviä ovat esimerkiksi asiakkaan avustaminen kaupassa käynnissä, ulkoilussa, ruokailussa tai ruoanlaitossa, pukeutumisessa, harrastuksissa tai kodinhoidossa. MILLAINEN HENKILÖ SOPII AVUSTAJAKSI?Voimme useiden satojen henkilökohtaisten avustajien työnantajana todeta, että henkilökohtaisiksi avustajiksi sopivat parhaiten henkilöt, joilla on oikea asenne tärkeää avustamistyötä kohtaan. Avustajan on hyvä olla luotettava, positiivinen, avulias, ahkera ja ihmisläheinen henkilö. Sinulla ei tarvitse olla aikaisempaa vastaavaa työkokemusta, sillä jokainen uusi avustaja perehdytetään kattavalla perehdytyksellä Aarre Avustajien omassa Aarre Akatemiassa ennen työn aloittamista. Avustamis- ja hoiva-alan kokemuksesta tai koulutuksesta voi kuitenkin olla hyötyä joidenkin asiakkaiden kohdalla.MILLAISIA TYÖVUOROJA ON TARJOLLA JA VOINKO ITSE VAIKUTTAA NIIHIN?Henkilökohtainen apu on palvelu, joka tapahtuu niin arkisin kuin myös viikonloppuisin ja mahdollisia työvuoroja on usein tarjolla aamusta iltaan. Aarre Avustajilla voit itse vaikuttaa siihen, miten paljon ja milloin haluat työskennellä sekä millaiselle asiakkaalle. Pyrimme yhdistämään asiakkaidemme avustajatarpeet ja avustajiemme työtoiveet niin, että ne sopivat kaikille. Saat aina tavata mahdollisen uuden asiakkaan ennen asiakassuhteen aloittamista, ja mikäli koet, että jokin asia ei toimi niin kuin ajattelit, voimme yhdessä etsiä sinulle sopivan vaihtoehdon. Meillä voit tehdä halutessasi avustajan töitä niin monelle asiakkaalle kuin itse haluat.HAKEMINENRekrytointimme on jatkuvaa, joten täytäthän työnhakulomakkeen tarkasti. Muista lisätä työnhakulomakkeeseen kaikki sinulle sopivat kunnat, joissa voit työskennellä, niin osaamme olla sinuun yhteydessä heti, kun löydämme sinulle sopivan asiakkaan. Työnhakulomakkeen täyttäminen ei vielä sido sinua mihinkään. Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.Tervetuloa meidän mahtavaan tiimiimme!HAE ROHKEASTI TÖIHIN AARRE AVUSTAJILLE!Helposti täytettävän työnhakulomakkeen löydät tästä linkistä: https://www.tuntinetti.fi/AarreAvustajatHakulomake.htmlLISÄTIEDOTwww.aarreavustajat.fiVoit lähettää kaikki kysymyksesi työpaikkaan liittyen alla olevaan sähköpostiin:rekry@aarreavustajat.fi

jobs.title: PhD student in Horticultural Science
jobs.description: Department of Biosystems and TechnologyPhD Project: Valorization and Risk Assessment of Anaerobic Digestates for Sustainable Horticultural ProductionThird-cycle subject area: Horticultural ScienceDescription of the doctoral project The transition to circular food and energy systems requires safe, high-quality products that can return nutrients and organic matter to horticultural production. Anaerobic digestate from biogas production is a promising resource containing plant nutrients and organic fibre originating from, for example, manure, food and household waste, slaughterhouse by-products, park and garden residues, and biomass from intermediate crops or roadside vegetation. The digestate can be separated into a nutrient-rich liquid fraction and a fibre fraction. While the liquid fraction has potential for use in nutrient solutions, the fibre fraction is particularly relevant as a constituent of growing media and a potential partial replacement for peat and other fibre materials. Developing safe, functional and locally available alternatives to peat is an important challenge for sustainable horticultural production. A key barrier is the possible presence of pyralid herbicide residues. These herbicides can accumulate in crop material, persist during anaerobic digestion and cause growth disturbances in sensitive horticultural crops at very low concentrations. The project will investigate the occurrence and fate of pyralids in selected feedstocks and digestate fractions, with particular focus on the fibre fraction and its use in growing media.About the positionThe doctoral project will combine greenhouse and growth-chamber bioassays with laboratory studies and chemical characterisation. It will assess effects on plant growth and nutrient uptake, examine the distribution, degradation and immobilisation of herbicide residues, and generate knowledge to support risk assessment and the safe valorisation of digestate-derived growing-media products. The project is an important part in the ongoing transition for more circular productions systems where plant nutrients and fiber is recycled from waste to production. The project is a part of the Biogas Solutions Research Center, which means that there will be collaboration with other PhD students both at SLU and at Linköping University. Communication of results, both orally and in writing to both academic and industrial stakeholders are also important parts of the project. As a PhD-student, you will also take PhD courses and be a part of the daily work at the department.RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in Horticultural Science. To meet the specific entry requirements the applicant must have the equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in relevant subject areas. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.You should have received a degree at advanced level (second cycle) within the fields of Horticultural Science, Agricultural Science, or similar subject. You should also have documented experience with laboratory work and experimental work within the field of study.Beneficial competences Driver’s licence valid in Sweden. Documented experience from scientific writing and scientific communication.Your profileWe are looking for an engaged and self-going candidate with genuine interest in horticulture and circular solutions. Suitable backgrounds are as a Horticulturist or Agronomist. Experience with laboratory work, for example microbial analyses, is beneficial. You should also have experience with practical plant cultivation. Great emphasis will be put on personal skills like curiosity, ability to work individually and in group, and ability to independently plan and perform research related tasks. You are expected to be open to new challenges and to take on various work tasks to contribute to the development of the department’s activities. Very good skills in speaking and writing in English is mandatory.About usAt the department of Biosystems and Technology you will work in a multi-disciplinary environment together with around 60 colleagues, among which around 10 PhD students. The holder of this position will be a part of a national, transdisciplinary center of excellence called Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC). Here, new and relevant knowledge is generated through collaboration between different scientific disciplines as well as between researchers and practitioners from industry and public organizations. The BSRC includes researchers and support from two universities (Linköping University and SLU) and about 50 private and public organizations involving all parts of the biogas system and has additional support from Swedish Energy Agency. All doctoral positions advertised within BSRC will be formulated so that they fit into the competence center's research plans and at the same time reflect our parties' interests. This way, we ensure long-term competence supply to both industry and academia.Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/Form of employment / Funding Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme). Location: Alnarp, SwedenScope: 100%Start date: Upon agreement, but preferably 2027-01-01.Application and selection: Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is November 27, 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time.

jobs.title: PhD student in biomass resources from sustainable cropping systems
jobs.description: Department of Biosystems and Technology PhD project in Agricultural Science: Using agricultural crop biomass for biogas in synergy with the development of sustainable cropping systems Note: This advertisement is abbreviated to fit in Platsbanken's recruitment tool. To view the ad in its entirety including additional information, please visit https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/jobs-and-vacancies/ About the positionTargeting the sustainable supply of agricultural crop biomass as substrates for biogas, the project will use a field experiment platform to investigate crop yields and crop nutrient dynamics in different scenarios for biomass removal and nutrient redistribution via digestates. The research will primarily be based on an ongoing long-term cropping systems experiment with four distinct systems: conventional, organic, agroforestry and perennial cereal.The biomass resources to be studied include, but are not limited to: cover crops, ley, straw (from cereals, grain legumes and oilseed crops), beet leaves, and possibly wood. Studies on quantities and nutrient contents of different biomasses build on existing data from the experiment, to be complemented with additional sample collection and analyses as well as literature data or data from agricultural statistics databases. The holder of this position will be a part of a national transdisciplinary center of excellence called Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC). Here, co-production of new and relevant knowledge is generated through collaboration between different scientific disciplines as well as between researchers and practitioners from industry and public organizations. The BSRC includes researchers and support from two universities, Linköping University and Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences, as well as about 50 private and public organizations involving all parts of the biogas system. It also has support from the Swedish Energy Agency. All doctoral positions advertised within BSRC will be formulated so that they fit into the competence center's research plans and at the same time reflect our parties' interests. This way, we ensure long-term competence supply to both industry and academia. RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39). You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6. You should have a Master’s degree, or equivalent qualification, in a relevant field such as agricultural engineering (with specialization in crop production), agricultural science, agroecology, agronomy, biology, environmental science, horticultural science or another closely related discipline. Your profileWe are looking for a highly motivated candidate with an interest in sustainable agriculture and bioeconomy systems, and in analysing complex interactions between biomass and food production and cropping system sustainability. Experience or documented knowledge in one or several of the following areas is particularly relevant:    agricultural cropping systems, crop management and diversification;    systems analysis and/or multi-criteria sustainability assessments;    modelling or scenario analysis;    bioenergy systems based on agricultural crop biomass resources;    nutrient cycling e.g. via redistribution of biomass resources and biogas digestates;    crop and soil nutrient dynamics and nutrient balances at field and cropping system levels;    statistical analysis and handling of datasets with multiple experimental factors and response variables The project strives to provide knowledge for several societal sectors (bioenergy, food production, environmental impact), it is therefore important to have an ability to understand and integrate information from different scientific fields. The successful candidate should have good analytical skills, be able to work independently and systematically, and at the same time enjoy collaboration in an interdisciplinary research environment. Excellent written and spoken English is required. Good communication skills and an interest in communicating research both scientifically and to stakeholders are important. Knowledge of Swedish is advantageous but not a requirement. Personal qualities, motivation for doctoral studies and the ability to successfully complete the research project will be given considerable weight in the selection process. About usInformation about the department: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/biosystems-technology/ Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee on https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/ Form of employment / FundingEmployment as a doctoral student (4-year programme). Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed. Location:Alnarp, Sweden Scope:100% Start date:Upon agreement. Preferably in January/February 2027. Application and selection:Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is November 27, 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update. Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/ Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time.

jobs.title: Veileder innen arbeidsinkludering
jobs.description:
Vi søker en engasjert og løsningsorientert veileder som motiveres av å jobbe med mennesker og skape muligheter for den enkelte. Hos oss får du en variert og meningsfull hverdag der relasjonsbygging, arbeidsinkludering og tett oppfølging står sentralt.

Hva vi ser etter

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Relevant utdanning på høyskole/universitetsnivå, gjerne innen veiledning, pedagogikk, eller helse- og sosialfaglig eller tilsvarende

  • Kompetanse og erfaring innen veiledning og relasjonsarbeid

  • Erfaring med arbeidsinkludering og/eller karriereveiledning

  • Kompetanse i systematisk kartlegging av ressurser og arbeidsevne

  • Erfaring med tilrettelegging for personer med helse- og/eller språkutfordringer

  • Erfaring med kurs, opplæring eller undervisning er en fordel

  • God skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne

  • God forståelse for arbeidslivet og arbeidsgivernes behov

  • Førerkort klasse B og mulighet til å disponere egen bil

Relevant erfaring og personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Personlige kvalifikasjoner:

  • Vi ser etter deg som liker å jobbe med mennesker, og som evner å se muligheter også når veien videre ikke er åpenbar.

  • Du er positiv, trygg og løsningsorientert

  • Bygger gode relasjoner og skaper tillit

  • Arbeider strukturert og selvstendig

  • Trives med en variert arbeidshverdag og kan håndtere flere oppgaver samtidig

  • Samarbeider godt og deler kunnskap med andre

  • Kommuniserer åpent, tydelig og profesjonelt

  • Motiveres av å bidra til utvikling, mestring og nye muligheter for andre

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Veiledning og karriereveiledning av deltakere

  • Kartlegging av ressurser, kompetanse og muligheter

  • Individuell oppfølging og tilrettelegging

  • Oppfølging av deltakere i interne og eksterne praksiser

  • Samarbeid med arbeidsgivere og andre aktuelle samarbeidspartnere

  • Bidra til å finne gode løsninger som kobler deltakerens ressurser og muligheter med arbeidslivets behov

  • Dokumentasjon og annet relevant oppfølgingsarbeid

Vi tilbyr

  • En inkluderende arbeidsplass med et sterkt samfunnsoppdrag

  • Faglig utvikling og opplæring i arbeidsinkludering og integrering

  • Lønn etter avtale

  • Gode pensjons og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sølve er et kompetansesenter for læring som leverer tjenester til NAV, fylkeskommuner og kommuner innen arbeidsmarkedstiltak, forberedende opplæring for voksne, norskopplæring og samfunnskunnskapskurs for bosatte innvandrere, fag- og yrkeskvalifisering samt arbeidsrettede introduksjonsprogram. Virksomheten har et tydelig samfunnsoppdrag om å gi mennesker de beste mulighetene i arbeidslivet. I Sølve får deltakere tilbud om individuelt tilpassede oppgaver, arbeidstrening og kursing som gjør de i stand til å delta i arbeidslivet. Samtidig produseres det nyttige produkter og tjenester som gir inntekter, og den enkelte får en meningsfull og trivelig arbeidshverdag.

Sølve består av de fire selskapene Sølve Kompetanse Arbeid, Sølve Læring Pluss AS, Sølve AS og Sølve Karriere AS. Konsernet ble etablert i 1990, holder til i Hov i Land og er 100 % eid av Søndre Land kommune.

jobs.title: PhD Position  - in the Oral Physiology and Cancer Research Group (OPCG)
jobs.description:
About the position 

A PhD research fellowship is available in the Oral Physiology and Cancer Research Group (OPCG) at the Institute of Oral biology, Faculty of Dentistry, the University of Oslo. One of our group’s major interests is the study of how extracellular vesicles from cancer cells affect various normal cells, both in the immediate vicinity of the tumor and at a distance, changing their phenotype to support the growing tumor mass. In the proposed project, we aim to investigate the effect of extracellular vesicles from oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) on the function of normal cells, including endothelial cells. 

The candidate will apply various experimental methods to assess whether the normal phenotype changes towards a tumor-supporting one upon OSCC-derived extracellular vesicle exposure. Such alterations may include increased proliferation, modifications of intracellular Ca2+ signalling pathways, shifts in the metabolic profile and more.     

More about the position

The main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

Project title: “Tumor-host interaction in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC)”

This is a 100% full-time, three-year PhD Research Fellowship position. The successful candidate is expected to produce three scientific papers and a doctoral thesis. The place of work is Oslo, Norway.

More about the fellowship

Admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Dentistry is a prerequisite for taking up the position. The candidate is expected to complete the project within the fellowship period. A final plan for the research training must be approved and formalised no later than three months after the start of the position.

The main supervisor will be Professor Trude Marie Haug - Institute of Oral Biology

Qualification requirements

Mandatory requirements

  • Applicants must hold a Master’s degree equivalent to a Norwegian master’s degree in molecular biology, cell biology, dentistry or in another field relevant to the research project.
  • The Master’s thesis must have a grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system.
  • A good level of written and oral communication skills in English is required.
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements: https://www.odont.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/supplementary-rules.html
  • Publications in international peer-reviewed scientific journals will be advantageous but not required

Experience in the following methods will be advantageous:

  • Cell culturing
  • Standard molecular biological techniques and immunohistochemistry
  • Analysis of -omics data
  • Intracellular Ca2+ imaging
Personal skills:
  • Ability to work independently and in an interdisciplinary scientific environment
  • Self-motivation, creativity, genuine curiosity about the subject, work discipline, professional ethics, and ambition
  • Strong practical and analytical skills
  • Good social and collaboration skills

We need different perspectives in our work

  • UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that aims to provide an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. We fulfil our mission most effectively when we draw on different experiences, backgrounds and perspectives.
  • We will do our best to accommodate individual needs. Relevant adjustments may include adaptations to working hours, tasks, digital or physical tools, or other practical measures. Applicants with an immigrant background, a disability or gaps in their CV are encouraged to indicate this in the application portal. UiO invites at least one qualified applicant from each of these groups to interview in accordance with applicable state-sector procedures.
Why should you choose us?
  • A clearly defined and fully funded three-year PhD project with established core infrastructure.
  • Dedicated supervision and research-training.
  • An interdisciplinary and internationally connected research environment at the Faculty of Dentistry.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities, good welfare schemes and up to 1.5 hours per week of exercise during working hours.(Good welfare schemes)
  • Membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (Statens Pensjonskasse), with beneficial pension, mortgage and insurance arrangements.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly environment, with extensive cultural and outdoor opportunities.
  • Dedicated mentoring and a professionally stimulating working environment.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 551000 - to 605000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

How to apply

Your application must include:

  • A cover letter of 1-2 pages describing your motivation for the position, your relevant academic and practical experience, and how your background matches the project.
  • A CV summarizing education, work experience, research experience and other qualifying activities.
  • Copies of diplomas, academic transcripts and certificates. Applicants should retrieve available results from Vitnemålsportalen; where this is not possible, copies must be uploaded.
  • Documentation of English proficiency where required under the Faculty’s supplementary admission rules.
  • A complete list of publications and other academic work, if applicable, together with the work the applicant wishes the evaluation committee to consider.
  • A copy of your master thesis if possible.
  • Contact information for two to three references, including name, position, relationship to the applicant, e-mail address and telephone number.
  • The application and all attachments must be submitted through UiO’s electronic recruitment system, Jobbnorge, by clicking “Apply for the position”. All documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language. Applicants with education from outside Scandinavia should include an explanation of their university’s grading system and a Diploma Supplement where available. A recognition statement from the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), if already obtained, may also be attached.
  • Particular emphasis will be placed on documented academic qualifications, relevant experimental competence, motivation and personal suitability. The best-qualified candidates will be invited to interview and may be asked to give a brief presentation of previous research or technical work.
General information

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian),  Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO - University of Oslo

Doctoral degree: PhD in Dentistry - Faculty of Dentistry

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology, and services). 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 28 000 students and 7000 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Faculty of Dentistry is one of the leading odontological research and educational institutions in Europe. The faculty's research groups contribute top research within several odontological fields.

In addition to educating dentists and dental hygienists, the Faculty has Ph.D program and professional-oriented specialist education. The Faculty holds significant competence in the various research and clinical disciplines, with good interdisciplinary collaboration. It is a modern faculty with approximately 420 students and approximately 420 employees. The faculty is also Norway's largest dental clinic with approximately 50,000 patient visits a year. The Faculty of Dentistry has two departments: Institute of Clinical Dentistry and Department of Oral Biology.

jobs.title: PhD in Electrolyte Solvation and Interphase Engineering for Rechargeable Calcium Batteries
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from 1st of March 2027 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasksYou will develop and investigate non-aqueous liquid electrolytes for rechargeable calcium batteries, focusing on how Ca2+ solvation, ion pairing and interphase formation govern electrochemical reversibility. Your work will contribute to a complementary research programme on calcium-battery electrode materials and cell development at AAU Energy.

You will systematically vary salt chemistry, solvent composition and concentration within selected electrolyte families. Physicochemical measurements and spectroscopic analysis will be used to examine electrolyte coordination environments and ion association. These investigations will guide the selection of formulations for detailed electrochemical and interfacial studies.

A central part of the work will be the design and evaluation of calcium plating and stripping experiments, including measurements of coulombic efficiency, polarization and cycling stability under defined conditions. You will use appropriate controls and complementary analyses to verify metallic calcium deposition and distinguish it from electrolyte decomposition or other electrochemical reactions. You will investigate electrode interphase composition and evolution using XPS, supported by electron microscopy and, where appropriate, ToF-SIMS for morphology and species distribution. Raman spectroscopy, complemented by NMR where relevant, will probe electrolyte coordination and ion association. Targeted MD simulations may clarify Ca²⁺ solvation and ion pairing. Correlating these findings with electrochemical performance will establish mechanism-based guidelines for electrolyte formulation and selection.

Working closely with the PhD researcher developing cathode and calcium-alloying anode materials, you will assess selected electrode–electrolyte combinations and contribute to reproducible coin-cell evaluation. You will also contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, teaching, supervision of student projects and departmental dissemination activities.

The position is offered in relation to the Batteries research group, and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Power Electronics Systems Integration and Materials”.

Your competencies Applicants are expected to hold an M.Sc. degree in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering, or a closely related discipline. Candidates should have a solid scientific background and preferably hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: electrochemistry, electrolyte formulation and preparation, battery testing and characterization, or the handling of air- and moisture-sensitive materials under controlled environments. A strong interest in electrochemical energy storage, interfacial chemistry, spectroscopic characterization techniques, and quantitative experimental data analysis is highly desirable.

Experience with advanced characterization techniques, particularly spectroscopy and surface analysis, will be considered an advantage. Familiarity with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations or other computational approaches for investigating electrolyte properties is beneficial but not essential, as the position is primarily focused on experimental research.

Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, together with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary and international research environment, are essential.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges.

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (2-5 pages), that describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost. 

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: PhD student in agricultural bioeconomy systems
jobs.description: Department of Biosystems and TechnologyPhD project: Sustainable utilisation of agricultural green biomass in integrated protein and biogas systemsSubject area: TechnologyDescription of the doctoral project A circular and fossil-independent bioeconomy requires renewable biomass without increasing competition for agricultural land and food production. Crop residues and intermediate crops are therefore particularly relevant resources. Research at SLU shows that these biomass resources can be substantial, but their potential and sustainable utilisation vary regionally. They can be used for biogas, while effects on soil carbon and nutrient cycling need to be considered.  Green biomass can also be biorefined into plant protein for feed or food, after which the remaining streams are used for biogas. The same feedstock can thereby provide protein, energy and recycled nutrients.The project aims to assess the potential and consequences of large-scale utilisation of green crop residues and intermediate crops in integrated biogas and green biorefinery systems.The project will:    assess sustainably available biomass from green crop residues and intermediate crops in Sweden;    assess the potential for biogas and combined plant protein and biogas production;    develop implementation scenarios based on feedstock availability, infrastructure, logistics and markets;    assess effects on nutrient cycling, soil carbon, biomethane, fertilizer use, and feed and food production; and    evaluate economic and wider socio-economic benefits, drawbacks and trade-offs.The project combines GIS and agricultural data with mass and nutrient balances, scenario modelling, and life cycle-based, techno-economic and socio-economic methods. Data will be drawn from research, statistics, literature and national databases.The doctoral student will join an interdisciplinary research environment at SLU Alnarp focusing on sustainable agricultural production, bioenergy, circular bioeconomy and systems analysis.About the positionThe work includes collection and processing of agricultural and process data, GIS, modelling of biomass and product flows, scenario development, and environmental and economic assessments.  You will integrate information from crop production and biomass availability to biorefineries, biogas, and food and energy systems.  You will analyse data, develop models and scenarios, and publish and present research results. The work will be conducted with researchers at SLU and external partners.  The doctoral student will be part of the Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC), a national transdisciplinary centre where Linköping University, SLU and around 50 private and public organisations collaborate. The centre is supported by the Swedish Energy Agency. The PhD project follows BSRC’s research plans and contributes to long-term competence development in industry and academia.RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in technology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have the equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in relevant subject areas. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.  You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.You should have a Master’s degree or equivalent in, for example, biosystems/agricultural engineering, environmental engineering, agricultural science, energy systems, industrial ecology, environmental science or a related field.Your profileWe are looking for a motivated candidate interested in sustainable agricultural and bioeconomy systems and quantitative analysis.Experience or documented knowledge in one or several of the following areas is desirable:    systems analysis, modelling or scenario analysis;    GIS and spatial analysis;    life cycle assessment, environmental systems analysis or material-flow analysis;    techno-economic or socio-economic assessment;    bioenergy, biogas or biorefinery systems;    agricultural production systems and agricultural biomass;    statistical analysis and handling of larger datasets;    experience of programming or quantitative modelling, for example using Python, R or MATLAB.You should have good analytical skills, be able to integrate information from different fields, work independently and collaborate well.Excellent written and spoken English is required. Good communication skills are important. Knowledge of Swedish is advantageous but not required.Personal qualities, motivation and the ability to successfully complete doctoral studies will be given considerable weight. About usThe Department of Biosystems and Technology develops knowledge for sustainable and resource-efficient agriculture, horticulture and bioeconomy through research combining biological production systems, technology and systems analysis. The project lies at the intersection of agriculture, biosystems engineering, sustainability assessment and bioeconomy. Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/Form of employment / FundingEmployment as a doctoral student (4-year programme) Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed.Location:Alnarp, SwedenScope:100%Start date:Upon agreement. A start date in January or February 2027 is preferred. Application and selection: Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is November 27, 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time.

Als Marketplace & eCommerce Manager (m/w/d) verbindest du strategischen Weitblick mit operativer Umsetzung und einem klaren Blick für profitables Wachstum. Deine Aufgaben im Detail:
