Läs gärna mer på www.gotland.se/formanerPå Instagramkontot @viarregiongotland kan du följa våra medarbetare och se bredden i våra olika verksamheter.Så rekryterar viVi arbetar enligt kompetensbaserad rekryteringsmetod och lägger därför stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet i enlighet med de kompetenser som beskrivs i annonsen. På så vis jobbar vi även aktivt för att motverka diskriminering. Vi är måna om säkerhet och kvalité i våra rekryteringar och du kan därför komma att omfattas av kontroller inför anställning. Om det är aktuellt får du mer information av rekryterare. jobs.title: Junior Customer Success Manager (DACH) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We build AI voice agents for small and medium-sized businesses so they never miss a call and can focus on the work they actually love.

Our AI handles every call automatically. But voice is just the beginning. Our vision: to build the world's first fully automated CRM.

11,000+ customers. >€15M ARR. ~30% monthly growth.

We live ownership. You're responsible for your projects and tasks end-to-end. No politics, few meetings, direct feedback. At fonio you'll build alongside the smartest and most ambitious people around.

Join us now to be part of one of Europe's most exciting growth stories! 1 Junior Customer Success Manager (DACH) (m/f/d) Your Role

As Junior Customer Success Manager for Activation in DACH, you make sure every new German-speaking customer goes from "just signed" to "fonio picks up our calls every day". You own the first weeks of the customer journey: setting up their AI assistant, testing and fine-tuning it, and getting it live on their phone line.

You'll spend most of your time in onboarding calls with customers and inside the fonio platform. You learn how every feature works and figure out the best setup for each customer, whether that's a dental practice in Munich, a law firm in Vienna or a car workshop in Zurich.

What to expect

* Run onboarding calls with new DACH customers and set up their AI assistant together with them

* Translate each customer's business into a working setup: prompt, knowledge base, call transfers, notifications and integrations

* Test and fine-tune assistants until they're ready to go live, so customers don't get stuck in "almost done"

* Help customers connect their phone system and get call forwarding running

* Follow up with customers who signed but aren't active yet, and get them over the line

* Become a power user of the platform: learn how each feature works and which setup fits which use case

* Bring patterns and friction points from onboardings back to Product and CS to improve templates, guides and the product

* Hand activated customers over to Customer Success with a clean setup and clear notes

* Track your onboardings and activation results in HubSpot

Who We're Looking For

* 0-2 years of experience in a customer-facing role (onboarding, support, CS, sales, hospitality or customer service) or a strong graduate profile. Internships count.

* German, fluent English

* Basic technical skills and real curiosity about how things work. You enjoy clicking through a platform until you understand it, and you're not scared of webhooks, APIs or phone settings.

* You like solving puzzles: "How do I build this for this customer?" excites you

* You explain things simply and stay patient with non-technical customers, by phone or video

* Structured: you can run several onboardings in parallel without dropping anything

* Hands-on and quick to learn. You take initiative and don't wait to be told what to do.

* Willing to relocate to Vienna

What We Offer

* €50,000-55,000

* You'll learn AI and voice tech faster than anywhere else, with a real path into Customer Success, Solutions or Forward Deployment

* Lunch and dinner are on us. Every day.

* The fridge is always full: Red Bull, Mate, Cola, Almdudler and more

* Need a tool, course or book? It's yours. No approval loops.

* Your setup, your choice: pick the gear you want to work with

* A product customers actually love: 4.5 stars on Trustpilot, Google and OMR. It mostly sells itself.

* Onsite in Vienna with a team that's here to do the best work of their careers

Hiring Process

* 20 min intro call

* 30 min skill interview

* 15 min with interview with our CCO

* 20 min culture call with our Founders

jobs.title: UI Designer - AI Neobank App
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a UI Designer to craft intuitive, elegant and high-performing interfaces for BJAK's AI and financial products.

This role is for someone who obsesses over visual quality, interaction details and usability. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to design mobile-first experiences that make complex financial products feel simple, trustworthy and enjoyable to use.

What You'll Own

  • Design polished, user-centric interfaces for mobile and web products.

  • Transform product requirements into wireframes, user flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI.

  • Build intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial services.

  • Maintain and evolve BJAK's design system to ensure consistency across products.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to deliver pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Iterate designs using user feedback, analytics and usability testing.

  • Ensure accessibility, responsiveness and visual consistency across different devices and platforms.

  • Contribute to improving overall product usability, interaction patterns and visual language.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong focus on mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, interaction design and UI craftsmanship.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design workflows.

  • Strong understanding of mobile-first design principles, platform guidelines (iOS & Android) and responsive layouts.

  • Good understanding of UX principles, information architecture and user-centred design.

  • Ability to simplify complex user journeys into intuitive interfaces.

  • High attention to detail with strong visual hierarchy, typography and spacing.

  • Portfolio is required. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Design Tools

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • Auto Layout & Components

  • Design Tokens

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in complete user journeys, not just beautiful screens.

  • Obsesses over clarity, consistency and usability.

  • Designs interfaces that reduce friction and build user trust.

  • Works closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.

  • Moves quickly while maintaining a high standard of visual quality.

  • Takes ownership of problems instead of waiting for detailed instructions.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers who focus only on aesthetics without considering usability.

  • People who copy trends without understanding user problems.

  • Designers who struggle to collaborate with product and engineering teams.

  • Individuals who require extensive direction before making design decisions.

  • Candidates who cannot clearly explain the rationale behind their design choices or their individual contributions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Switzerland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Switzerland.

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Portfolio review

  2. Practical design task (if applicable)

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines: turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

  • Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

  • Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

  • Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

  • Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

  • You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

  • Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

  • Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

  • Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

  • Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

  • Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

  • Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

jobs.title: Make Things Happen: We’re Hiring a Contract Manager Who Loves Action!
jobs.description:
Do you love the buzz of a fast-moving environment where you get real responsibility and make an impact from day one? Do you want to join a team of bold, curious and driven people who are building something extraordinary together? Does negotiating excite you? Then you might just be the Contract Manager we are looking for.

About us

Since 1981, Delta of Scandinavia has been crafting unforgettable travel experiences across the Nordics, from the magic of Iceland’s northern lights to the timeless beauty of Norway’s fjords. Luxury escapes, wild adventures, sustainable journeys: all designed with passion, creativity and a true love for the North.

What do we offer

Join a young, international team where ideas travel fast and every day feels different.

Work in a vibrant environment that inspires creativity, collaboration and fun.

Grow fast, with real career opportunities and intense hands-on training that will boost your skills from day one.

Your responsibilities

As Contract Manager you negotiate and manage our supplier agreements, securing the best commercial conditions and building strong partnerships. Your work supports product quality, operational efficiency and our wider company objectives.

You will be involved in many exciting areas, including:

•      Identify, collect, analyse and negotiate a wide variety of contracts with suppliers. Optimise every agreement to maximise value and keep Delta competitive.

•      Ensure that all contractual terms align with company standards and objectives.

•      Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with suppliers, and act as the main point of contact for contractual matters.

•      Foster collaboration with suppliers to improve product quality and commercial outcomes.

•      Troubleshoot contract-related issues.

•      Make sure that booking procedures with suppliers work well, and identify and implement solutions that improve processes and efficiency.

•      Be in contact with the Department Managers to establish the strategy for the product and stay aware of the departments’ needs.

•      Contribute insights that support product strategy and development.

•      Collaborate with destination partners to stay up to date on product knowledge and market developments, and make sure Delta is involved in the strategies of the Tourist Boards and DMOs, including invitations to events and FAM trips.

•      Keep the communication about the product flowing between staff at all times: exchange news and keep a regular update.

What we expect from you

You bring an exceptional work ethic and a strong sense of urgency. You are driven by ambition and always push yourself to reach the highest standards. You take full ownership of your work, and you are proactive, reliable and committed to delivering results. At the same time, you stay humble and share our enthusiasm for creating and growing new ventures.

We love working from the office: it is where teamwork, creativity and growth truly thrive, when we are together in person. From 1 December 2026 our office will be located at Axeltårn: difficult to find a better location in town.

Meie objektid on peamiselt elamud ja korterid ning tööd võivad hõlmata ka katuse-, fassaadi-, maalri- ja muid ehitustöid. Ootame Sind, kui oskad oma tööd planeerida ja iseseisvalt teostada, tunned ehitusest rõõmu ning pead oluliseks korralikku ja kvaliteetset lõpptulemust. Objektid asuvad peamiselt Harjumaal, kuid huvitavamad projektid võivad viia ka mujale Eestis.

Kandideerimisel palume kindlasti märkida ka oma soovitud töötasu.

Peamised tööülesanded: - nõustab abi vajavaid isikuid sotsiaalhoolekandealaste õiguste ja abi võimaluste osas; - abistab abi vajavaid isikuid sotsiaalhoolekandealase abi saamiseks vajaliku taotluse vormistamisel; - korraldab abivajajatele sotsiaalabitoetuse ja sotsiaalteenuste osutamist; - selgitab taotluse esitamisel või abivajaduse ilmnemisel välja abi vajaduse ja ulatuse; - arvestab toetusi ja määrab teenuseid lähtuvalt hinnatud abi vajadusest; - menetleb taotlusi riiklikus sotsiaaltoetuste ja -teenuste andmebaasis STAR; - teeb juhtumipõhiselt koostööd ja osaleb võrgustikutöös; - teeb kodukülastusi teenistusülesannete täitmise eesmärgil. Täpsemalt saad lugeda ametijuhendist siit: https://www.tyri.ee/sites/default/files/documents/2025-11/Sotsiaaltoospetsialisti_ametijuhend.pdf

Omalt poolt pakume: • võimalust aidata Türi valla abivajavaid inimesi;• meeskonnatööd uuendusmeelses kollektiivis ja toetavaid kolleege; • arenguvõimalust ja vastutusrikast tööd; • põhipuhkust 35 päeva, millele lisandub 3 tasustatud tervisepäeva; • võimalust kasutada ametiautosid ja/või saada hüvitist isikliku auto kasutamisel. • tervise- ja spordikulude hüvitamist.

Muud nõuded: Me väga ootame Sind kui:Sul on kõrgharidus sotsiaaltöös või sellele vastav kvalifikatsioon või kutseseaduse alusel välja antud sotsiaaltöötaja kutse; Sa tunned oma valdkonnaga seonduvaid seaduseid ja õigusakte; Sa saad iseseisvalt oma tööga hakkama, kuid oled ka hea meeskonna mängija; Omad positiivset ellu suhtumist ning sinu iseloomupangast leiab tasakaalukust, sihikindlust, paindlikkust ja rahulikku meelt; Oled abivalmis ja vajadusel julged ka ise abi küsida.

jobs.description:

Tööülesanded: Projekti ja jooniste lugemine: Ventilatsiooni- ja ehitusjooniste analüüsimine, et mõista süsteemi kulgemist, seadmete asukohti ja tehnilisi nõudeid.Magistraalide ja torustike paigaldus: Ümarate või kandiliste ventilatsioonitorude montaaž, isoleerimine (soojus- ja tuletõkkeisolatsioon) ning kinnitamine lagedele või seintele. Sõlmede ja lisakomponentide ühendamine: Mürasummutite, tuletõkkeklappide, reguleerimisklappide ja õhujaotajate (plafoonid, restid) paigaldus. Ventilatsiooniseadmete paigaldus: Agregaatide (sissepuhke-väljatõmbe seadmed, katuseventilaatorid, kütte- ja jahutuskalorifeerid) paika tõstmine ja ühendamine torustikuga.

Muud nõuded: Erialane jooniste lugemise oskus: Võime vabalt aru saada ventilatsiooni- ja ehitusjoonistest.Tööriistade käsitsemise oskus: Kogemus peamiste käsi- ja elektritööriistade ohutul ning efektiivsel kasutamisel. Hea füüsiline vorm ja vastupidavus: Valmisolek füüsiliseks tööks, sealhulgas raskuste tõstmiseks ning tööks kõrgustes (tellingud, tõstukid, redelid). Tehniline taip ja ruumiline mõtlemine: Oskus hinnata olukorda objektil ja leida jooniste elluviimiseks parimad praktilised lahendused. Täpsus ja kohusetundlikkus: Korrektne suhtumine töökvaliteeti (õhupidavus, esteetiline välimus) ning tähtaegadest kinnipidamine. Iseseisvus ja meeskonnatöö valmidus: Suutlikkus töötada nii omaette kui ka tõhusalt koos teiste ehitusplatsil viibivate spetsialistidega.

jobs.title: Finantsjuht
jobs.description:
Riigi Kaitseinvesteeringute Keskus

Tööülesanded: Otsime oma meeskonda tugevat strateegilist juhtkonna partnerit, kelle eesmärk on finantsteenuse juhtimine ja arendamine, sh finantsarvestuse ja –aruandluse tagamine ning kulujuhtimissüsteemi arendamine. Oled keskuse finantsvaldkonna eestvedaja, kes vastutab eelarvestamise, finantsplaneerimise ja kulujuhtimise korraldamise ning arendamise eest. Juhid finantsistide tööd, koostad ja analüüsid eelarveid ning finantsaruandeid, tagad finantsprotsesside ja infosüsteemide toimimise ning nõustad juhtkonda ja osakondi finantsalaste otsuste tegemisel. Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas. jobs.title: Sales Manager – Packaging Equipment and Automated Packaging Solutions
jobs.description:
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Automated packaging lines and packaging equipment.

Work tasks: Alpina Electronics OÜ is expanding its activities in the field of automated packaging equipment and packaging lines and is looking for a Sales Manager for the Estonian and Finnish markets. Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Our range of solutions includes: Automated packaging lines and equipment in cooperation with the Polish manufacturer RADPAK. Palletizing equipment, including solutions developed by Alpina Electronics. Thermoforming packaging machines for the food industry, primarily for the Finnish market, supplied by Colimatic. Your Key Responsibilities Identifying potential customers and establishing new business relationships in Estonia and Finland. Visiting customers to understand their production processes and packaging requirements. Presenting suitable packaging equipment and automated packaging solutions. Working closely with equipment manufacturers and technical specialists. Managing sales projects from initial customer contact through to order confirmation. Every manufacturing company and project is different. Your role will be to understand each customer's specific needs and work together with our team and the manufacturers' technical specialists to develop the most suitable solution.

We offer: We offer an opportunity to play an active role in establishing a new sales division and developing the market for automated packaging equipment and packaging lines in Estonia and Finland. We offer: A competitive base salary combined with performance-based bonuses. An independent and responsible position with a high degree of autonomy. Flexible working arrangements, including the opportunity to work from home. A company car, computer, mobile phone, and all other necessary work equipment. Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

Other requirements: This position is ideal for someone who values independence, enjoys planning their own work, and wants to see a direct connection between their efforts and achievements.

Option to work from home: Yes

Working load, shifts: 0,5

jobs.title: Accounts Technician
jobs.description: Xeinadin was established in 2019 when a number of leading business advisory and accountancy practices across the UK and Ireland came together to re-imagine the future of accountancy. Our collective mission to provide locally forged, trusted business advice to SMEs through forward-thinking, close-knit relationships remains pivotal to our growth. It's our people who drive our business forward, and we offer them future-focused career opportunities whilst supporting individual specialisms. Our regional offices of over 3000 colleagues operate collaboratively, combining collective expertise to maximise potential.We are recruiting for an ambitious, motivated and detail-oriented Accounting Technician to join our team and support the delivery of high-quality services to our clients.Your role•    Prepare monthly management accounts, financial reports and supporting schedules, ensuring accurateand timely reporting of financial performance.•    Analyse revenue, costs, margins and profitability, including budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actualvariances, and communicate key performance drivers.•    Develop KPI dashboards, forecasts, financial models and scenario analyses to support commercialplanning and management decision-making.•    Process and review journals, accruals, prepayments and supplier invoices, and examine general ledgerbalances, trial balances and reconciliations.•    Assess customer, product and business-unit profitability, identifying trends, anomalies, financial risksand opportunities for improvement.•    Support budgeting, month-end reporting and external audits by liaising with stakeholders, preparingdocumentation and responding to queries.The ideal candidate•    Accounting Technician qualification (ATI) or equivalent.•    Minimum 2 years' experience in an accountancy practice environment.•    Strong knowledge of bookkeeping principles and financial accounting.•    Experience preparing VAT returns and payroll processing.•    Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.•    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.•    Strong written and verbal communication skills.Hours37.5 hoursJob Types: Full-time, PermanentWork Location: Office based in BallsbridgeWork Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
jobs.description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

jobs.title: Academic Advisor to the Stockholm School of Economics
jobs.description: The Education Office (EdO) is one of SSE’s Professional Services units and consists of around 58 colleagues. As a central part of the SSE journey, we support and develop key academic services for students and stakeholders across our BSc, MSc, and PhD programs. Our work spans assessment, program management, scholarships, international collaborations, academic support, central course and exam coordination, as well as degrees and certificates.We are looking for an Academic Advisor to join our Guidance and Wellbeing Office (GWO). As an Academic Advisor at SSE, you will work closely with students across our Bachelor and Master programs, providing guidance and support throughout their studies. The GWO team consists of two Academic Advisors and one Student Wellbeing Counsellor. Together, the team provides a first point of contact for students who need support related to their studies, their individual educational needs, or challenges that may affect their ability to study. The team also coordinates support for students with specific educational needs. As an Academic Advisor, you will:     Provide individual guidance to students on study-related matters, helping them navigate challenges and make informed decisions about their studies.     Meet students with a wide range of needs and circumstances and help identify appropriate forms of support.     Coordinate support for students with specific educational needs and work with relevant colleagues to ensure appropriate arrangements.     Work closely with the Student Wellbeing Counsellor and the other Academic Advisor to provide coordinated support to students.     Guide students to other relevant functions or professional support when their needs fall outside the scope of academic advising.     Collaborate with faculty and other colleagues across SSE on student-related matters.     Contribute to developing routines, information and ways of working within GWO     Participate in preventive and student-focused initiatives aimed at creating good conditions for students to succeed in their studies. What we offer youAt SSE, you’ll join a small, close-knit GWO team and work across a lively academic community. The role combines one-to-one work with students and collaboration with faculty and colleagues throughout the School. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how GWO supports students, develop its ways of working and contribute to initiatives that strengthen the study experience. It’s a varied role with room to take initiative, build strong working relationships and be part of students’ academic journeys.About youYou are an attentive, confident communicator who can build trust while maintaining clear professional boundaries. You are comfortable meeting students with varied needs, including in challenging or sensitive situations.You listen with care, ask thoughtful questions and can work out what kind of guidance or support may be most useful. You are calm and practical when situations are complex, and you enjoy working closely with colleagues who bring different areas of expertise. You are also ready to contribute to initiatives that strengthen students’ wellbeing and study experience.QualificationsWe are looking for someone with:    A Bachelor’s degree in Study and Career Guidance (Swedish: Studie- och yrkesvägledarexamen).    Experience in student support, academic advising, counselling, education or another role involving professional guidance and individual support.    Spoken and written Swedish and English.Meritorious    Knowledge of educational support for students with disabilities or other specific educational needs.    Experience using Nais and Ladok.    Experience working in higher education.Other:This is a full-time, permanent position with an initial six-month probationary period. The position is based in Stockholm and start date is according to agreement.We encourage you to apply promptly as we are actively reviewing applications on an ongoing basis. We look forward to receiving your application.About the Stockholm School of EconomicsThe Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

jobs.title: Servicegartner søges
jobs.description:
Har du en solid grøn faglighed, trives du med at tage fat, og kan du lide at arbejde selvstændigt i et tæt makkerskab? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til at holde Skjoldhøjparken grøn, sikker og i topform hele året.

Skjoldhøjparkens Grundejerforening søger en dygtig og engageret gartner til den daglige drift af vores fælles områder. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med en anden gartner og få en varieret hverdag, hvor du er med til at sikre, at området fremstår pænt, sikkert og velplejet hele året.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en del af et lille team på to gartnere ansat af bestyrelsen, og dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Klippe græs og pleje områdets grønne arealer

  • Udføre snerydning og glatførebekæmpelse i vinterhalvåret

  • Beskæring af træer og buske

  • Vedligeholde og tjekke områdets legepladser

  • Have den daglige dialog med leverandører og samarbejdspartnere samt følge op på aftalte opgaver

  • Løse lettere administrative opgaver digitalt

  • Løse øvrige driftsopgaver i området, som opstår hen over året

  • Bidrage til gode arbejdsgange og fortløbende forbedringer i driften

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet gartner, anlægsgartner, landmand, bygningsservicetekniker eller har en anden relevant grøn uddannelse. Det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring, kan arbejde med frihed under ansvar og finder stor glæde ved pleje og vedligeholdelse af grønne områder.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og pålideligt

  • Er god til at samarbejde og dele opgaverne med din kollega

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt og venligt med leverandører og med områdets beboere

  • Kan overskue og prioritere, når vejr og årstid ændrer opgaverne

  • Har almindelige IT-kompetencer

 

Det er en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med drift af større boligområder, grundejerforeninger eller lignende

  • Kan lide at snakke med beboere i området

  • Har kendskab til kontrol og vedligeholdelse af legepladser

  • Har erfaring med at arbejde med leverandører og indhente tilbud

  • Kan udføre let administrativt arbejde

Vi tilbyder

  • En alsidig stilling med praktisk arbejde og ansvar for områdets drift

  • Et tæt samarbejde med en gartnerkollega

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge arbejdsgangene

  • Et arbejdsmiljø, hvor du kommer tæt på de mennesker, der bor og færdes i området

Praktiske oplysninger

  • Du skal have gyldigt kørekort til kategori B

  • Du skal kunne stå til rådighed for snerydning i vinterhalvåret

  • Arbejdstid 37 timer ugentligt

  • Arbejdspladsen er Fejøvænget 33, 8381 Tilst

  • Tiltrædelse snarest muligt

  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst ved 3F

Ansøgning

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og opslaget tages ned, når den rette er fundet.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV via job@skjoldhoj.dk, hvor alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte bestyrelsen på kontakt@skjoldhoj.dk

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion's engineering and product teams are shipping faster than ever, which means there's more for customers to discover, understand, and adopt than ever before. We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to drive awareness of new Notion features and capabilities, and to run the programs that turn early activation into lasting adoption. This is a full-stack role: you'll flex across launches, growth programs, and pricing and packaging. That last one means helping decide how new capabilities map to plans and tiers, and making sure customers can tell what they get and what they pay for. You're a messaging master with a genuine point of view: someone who can build narratives sharp and specific enough to cut through an increasingly noisy market, and a strategic partner to Product from early development all the way through go-to-market.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead launches big and small, coordinating efforts across our Marketing and GTM org to land a successful launch day.

 - Drive continued awareness, growth, and adoption of high-PMF features well after launch day. Launch is the start of the story, not the end of it.

 - Take on pricing and packaging projects for new capabilities, working with Product, Design, and Web to decide whether something becomes a new SKU or tier or joins an existing one, then landing the change on notion.com/pricing http://notion.com/pricing, in-product, and in release comms.

 - Serve as a strategic partner to Product, informing strategy during product development, competitive positioning, and user insights.

 - Collaborate with Enterprise PMMs and Sales to build sales enablement materials that turn product capability into stories reps can use in the field.

 - Partnering with Demand Gen and Lifecycle on sequences, webinars, and more.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 10+ years directly relevant experience in product marketing or adjacent marketing function.

 - A distinctive point of view and the creativity to build narratives that stand out in a crowded, noisy market.

 - Experience running product launches, adoption, or growth programs, ideally at a fast-moving product or technology company.

 - A real point of view on pricing and packaging, or the appetite to build one fast. You can reason about plans, tiers, and value, not just features and launches.

 - Strong cross-functional skills, comfortable coordinating Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing toward one outcome.

 - Genuine passion for shaping the future of work with AI, a growth mindset, and a scrappy, high-ownership approach to getting things done.

 - Sharp writing and storytelling instincts: you know the difference between a headline that's technically accurate and one that actually lands.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're already a Notion user, fluent in the product and plugged into the community.

 - You look beyond just AI & tech companies for creative inspiration

 - You're a pro at building and using agents, inside Notion and beyond.

 - You've worked through a pricing or packaging change before, such as a new tier, a plan change, or a paywall, and can talk about the tradeoffs.

 - PMM experience at a larger company, though we care more about your instincts and ownership than your resume's logos.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Success
jobs.description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a data engine for clinical trial intelligence. It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments.

 

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

 

We seek highly self-motivated, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup.

 

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Customer Success to lead and scale how Rivia delivers value to customers. As our first dedicated Customer Success leader, you will oversee the post-sales journey, from onboarding and technical implementation through adoption, retention, and long-term account growth.

You will lead Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering, build a repeatable operating model, and stay close to strategic biotech and pharmaceutical customers. You will combine scientific and technical credibility with strong people leadership, commercial judgment, and a builder’s mindset.

Ownership and Commercial Collaboration

Customer Success owns the post-sales customer relationship, implementation, adoption, measurable value realization, customer health, retention strategy, and renewal readiness. The They will be accountable for customer outcomes and for proactively identifying and developing expansion opportunities.

Sales owns the commercial pipeline and execution of renewal and upsell transactions, including commercial negotiations and closing. The Head of Customer Success partners closely with Sales to shape account strategies, quantify customer value, identify and qualify opportunities, manage renewal risks, and support successful commercial outcomes.


What excites you

  • Building something from the ground up. You're excited by the opportunity to shape and scale a Customer Success function, creating the structure, processes, and standards that will support Rivia's next stage of growth.

  • Making a real impact on drug development. You're motivated by working at the intersection of life sciences and technology, helping biotech companies make better decisions and accelerate clinical development.

  • Being close to customers. You enjoy understanding complex scientific and technical challenges, building trusted relationships, and translating customer needs into meaningful outcomes.

  • Combining leadership with hands-on execution. You love developing high-performing teams but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves, solving difficult problems, and taking ownership of strategic accounts.

  • Driving measurable business impact. You're energized by improving customer retention, demonstrating value, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships in close partnership with Sales.

  • Thriving in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy autonomy, ambitious goals, and the opportunity to influence decisions directly, without waiting for someone else to tell you what to do.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and coach the Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering teams, setting clear standards for performance, development, capacity planning, and hiring.

  • Build and scale the end-to-end post-sales experience, including onboarding, implementation, technical delivery, success plans, executive business reviews, escalation management, and value realization.

  • Own customer health, adoption, retention strategy, and renewal readiness; partner with Sales on renewal and expansion planning and execution.

  • Oversee complex implementations, integration quality, delivery timelines, and smooth handoffs from Sales.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior scientific, technical, and business stakeholders at biotech and pharma customers.

  • Translate platform usage into measurable outcomes, including time saved, costs avoided, and operational improvements.

  • Define and monitor customer success metrics, including adoption, time to value, GRR, NRR, renewal performance, and expansion opportunities.

  • Resolve critical customer escalations and translate recurring feedback into priorities for Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.

  • Introduce scalable account segmentation, coverage models, reporting, and operating rhythms without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What excites us:

  • Experience leading and developing customer-facing teams in a B2B technology environment, while remaining personally close to customers.

  • A background in life sciences, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, or a closely related scientific field.

  • Experience with biotech, pharma, clinical development, scientific software, or other complex life-sciences technology customers.

  • Evidence of driving customer retention, renewals, adoption, and account expansion through cross-functional collaboration.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics and customer success metrics, including GRR, NRR, customer health, and renewal rates.

  • Ability to navigate technical implementations, manage executive escalations, and influence senior stakeholders.

  • A structured, hands-on leadership style, commercial judgment, direct communication, and urgency in a fast-moving environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience building a Customer Success function at an early-stage or Series A company.

  • Deep familiarity with clinical trials, clinical data, or pharmaceutical R&D workflows.

  • Experience supporting strategic expansion in enterprise biotech or pharmaceutical accounts.

  • A track record of measurable improvements in retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team.

  • In it to Win it: Approach challenges with determination, resilience, and drive.

  • Embrace change: See change as an opportunity to improve.

  • Why not?: Challenge assumptions and stay curious.

  • Find the gap: Proactively identify and solve problems.

  • Collective accountability: Own outcomes together and support one another.

  • Value add solutions: Deliver meaningful, impactful results.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, Europe
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager in Europe to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe, with London preferred. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer

We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.title: Tour Guide for Christmas Season
jobs.description: Do you love Finnish history, storytelling, and meeting people from around the world?Nordic Signature Tours is a Helsinki-based tourism company specializing in engaging, historically informative, and entertaining walking tours for international visitors.Our mission is simple: **We dont just show people Helsinki. We bring its stories to life!**From Finlands journey toward independence to its extraordinary experiences during the Second World War and the political tensions of the Cold War, we believe that history should be experienced through compelling stories rather than simply memorizing dates and facts.We are currently looking for knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and reliable freelance walking tour guides to join our team, particularly during the upcoming Christmas and New Year holiday season.**Key Responsibilities**As a freelance walking tour guide, you will be responsible for:- Leading engaging and historically accurate walking tours throughout central Helsinki. - Demonstrating **extensive knowledge of Finnish history**, including Finlands Swedish and Russian periods, independence, political development, and modern society. - Possessing **strong knowledge of Finland during the Second World War**, particularly the Winter War (1939–1940), Continuation War (1941–1944), and their historical significance. - Explaining complex historical events in clear, accessible, and entertaining English for international audiences. - Delivering compelling historical narratives using storytelling, humor, and audience interaction. - Answering guests questions confidently and accurately about Finnish history, culture, and society. - Maintaining a professional, welcoming, and enthusiastic atmosphere throughout each tour. - Ensuring the safety and comfort of guests while navigating Helsinkis streets and landmarks. - Arriving punctually, managing tour schedules, and communicating professionally with guests and company management. - Conducting tours outdoors in various weather conditions, including Helsinkis winter season. **Essential Requirements**Applicants **must meet the following requirements:**- **Fluent English is mandatory**, with excellent verbal communication and presentation skills. - **Must currently reside in Helsinki or the surrounding Helsinki metropolitan area.** - **Must possess strong knowledge of Finnish history**, particularly Finnish independence, national development, and the Second World War. - Must be comfortable speaking confidently in front of international groups. - Must demonstrate excellent interpersonal skills, professionalism, and reliability. - Must be physically capable of leading walking tours of approximately 2–3 kilometers. - Must be comfortable conducting tours outdoors during winter conditions. - Must be available for agreed tour assignments and communicate scheduling availability in advance. - Must be able to work under a freelance or entrepreneurial invoicing arrangement. Previous experience in tourism, historical interpretation, teaching, acting, or public speaking is considered an advantage.While previous tour-guiding experience is not mandatory, **a strong historical foundation and the ability to communicate history effectively are essential.****Christmas Holiday Season Availability****We are particularly seeking guides who can provide tour coverage between December 1, 2026, and January 10, 2027.**During this period, additional guides will be needed to support our two primary walking tours:**Epic Helsinki: Storytelling Walking Tour**An engaging introduction to Helsinkis history, architecture, culture, and the events that shaped Finlands capital.**Helsinki During WWII Walking Tour**An immersive historical experience exploring Finlands involvement in the Second World War, including the Winter War, Continuation War, and the experiences of Finnish soldiers and civilians.Applicants who can provide reliable availability during the Christmas and New Year holiday period will be particularly valued.Tour assignments will depend on customer bookings, visitor demand, and individual guide availability.**Compensation and Freelance Contract**- €35 per completed walking tour, generally lasting approximately two hours. - Guides retain **100% of tips** received from guests. - Flexible scheduling based on agreed availability and confirmed bookings. - Compensation is arranged through a freelance or entrepreneurial invoicing agreement. - No guaranteed minimum number of tours or working hours. **Contract Extension Opportunities**Although we are currently recruiting for the Christmas holiday season, freelance cooperation may be extended beyond January 10, 2027.Extensions will depend on the number of visitors traveling to Helsinki, customer bookings, operational needs, and each guides availability.This provides an opportunity for successful guides to continue working with Nordic Signature Tours throughout the year as tourism demand allows.**How to Apply**Interested in joining Nordic Signature Tours?Please email **nordic.tours@outlook.com** the following:1. Your CV or résumé. 2. A short introduction explaining your interest in Finnish history and why you would make an excellent tour guide. 3. Details of your experience with Finnish history, particularly the Second World War. 4. Your availability between **December 1, 2026, and January 10, 2027**. 5. Confirmation that you currently reside in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Shortlisted applicants may be invited to participate in an interview.**At Nordic Signature Tours, we believe that great tour guides do more than explain history. They bring it to life, creating experiences that visitors remember long after leaving Helsinki.**We look forward to welcoming enthusiastic storytellers to our team!

jobs.title: Research and Development Engineer in Artificial Intelligence (H/F)
jobs.description: Who we are ?Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise.The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes.A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components.Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on developing AI components for verification guidance, investigating natural-language and LLM-based assistance for formal modelling, and integrating these capabilities into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in the preparation of training and evaluation datasets, the development of experimental benchmarks, and the assessment of the proposed approaches in terms of effectiveness, computational efficiency, and reliability. The overall objective is to make formal verification more scalable and accessible while preserving the rigorous guarantees provided by the verification framework.Your main responsibilities will include :Carry out R&D work in artificial intelligence for formal verificationContribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom

jobs.title: Konstruktionsingeniør til STEENBERGs tegnestue
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde med bærende konstruktioner og være med til at omsætte skitser og beregninger til byggeri, der fungerer i praksis? Og trives du med en varieret hverdag, hvor statiske beregninger går hånd i hånd med tilsyn, byggetekniske gennemgange og tæt samarbejde med kollegaer, håndværkere og bygherrer?

Hos STEENBERGs tegnestue på Bornholm søger vi en konstruktionsingeniør, der har lyst til at arbejde bredt med både statik og praktiske, byggetekniske opgaver.

Om stillingen

Du bliver en del af projekter med nybyggeri, ombygninger og renoveringer i forskellige størrelser og med varierende kompleksitet. Vi arbejder som totalrådgiver, og du får mulighed for at følge løsningerne fra de første overvejelser og beregninger til udførelsen på byggepladsen.

Arbejdet spænder fra klassiske statikopgaver med beregninger, tegninger og dokumentation til mindre og større byggetekniske problemstillinger. Det kan eksempelvis være en håndværker, der står med en konkret udfordring på byggepladsen og har brug for din hjælp til at finde en byggeteknisk holdbar og bygbar løsning.

Du bliver en del af et tæt fagligt samarbejde på tegnestuen, hvor vi bringer vores forskellige kompetencer i spil. Inden for statik får du en stærk sparringspartner, som du kan drøfte beregninger, konkrete løsninger og byggetekniske problemstillinger med.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Projektering og beregning af beton-, stål- og trækonstruktioner.

  • Udarbejdelse af statisk dokumentation, tegninger og konstruktionsdetaljer.

  • Byggeteknisk rådgivning og løsning af konkrete problemstillinger i dialog med håndværkere og bygherrer.

  • Byggetekniske gennemgange og fagtilsyn.

  • Samarbejde og koordinering med tegnestuens øvrige faggrupper.

  • Eventuelt byggeledelse.

Du lærer tegnestuens arbejdsmetoder og igangværende sager at kende i samarbejde med dine kollegaer. Undervejs får du ansvar for egne opgaver med mulighed for sparring om både beregninger og byggetekniske løsninger.

Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet ingeniør med speciale i bærende konstruktioner og har en praktisk tilgang til dine opgaver. Du interesserer dig for sammenhængen mellem beregninger, materialer og udførelse og har blik for både bygbarhed og økonomi.

En håndværksmæssig baggrund vil være en fordel. Erfaring fra byggepladsen er værdifuld, når du skal forstå en konkret problemstilling og finde en løsning i dialog med dem, der skal udføre arbejdet.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • Har en bred konstruktionsmæssig forståelse og lyst til at arbejde med både statik og byggetekniske opgaver.

  • Har erfaring med relevante beregningsværktøjer, eksempelvis StruSoft Dimension og FEM Design.

  • Kan omsætte din faglige viden til praktiske og gennemarbejdede løsninger.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

  • Kan forklare tekniske forhold forståeligt til både bygherrer og håndværkere.

  • Bidrager til den faglige sparring og er åben for andres erfaringer.

En tegnestue med korte veje mellem faglighederne

På STEENBERGs tegnestue løser vi opgaverne i fællesskab. Vi bringer vores forskellige kompetencer i spil og hjælper hinanden med at skabe sammenhæng mellem arkitektur, konstruktioner og installationer.

Hverdagen er præget af en flad struktur, fagligt engagement og en uformel, humoristisk omgangstone. Du får mulighed for at påvirke dit arbejde og bidrage med dine erfaringer og idéer.

Vi tilbyder frokostordning, pension med sundhedsforsikring og løn efter kvalifikationer.

Interesseret?

Kontakt Anders Bjerregaard på 56 95 53 30, hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen.

Send ansøgning og CV til ab@steenberg.dk. Fortæl gerne om projekter, du har arbejdet med, og hvilke opgaver du har løst.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Tiltrædelse aftaler vi sammen.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja, Jyväskylä, Keljo (viite 40157)
jobs.description: Haemme Keski-Suomen hyvinvointialueen henkilökohtaisen avun keskuksen kautta avustajaa toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen 33-vuotiaalle naiselle Jyväskylään Keljoon. Työnantajalla on osittainen selkäydinvamma ja hän liikkuu itsenäisesti manuaalipyörätuolilla, mutta kynnyksissä, pidemmillä matkoilla sekä vaihtelevassa maastossa tarvitsee työntöapua. Ulkoillessa käyttää sähköpyörätuolia. Siirtymiset onnistuvat itsenäisesti pystyasennon kautta, myös rollaattorin avulla pystyy pieniä matkoja kävelemään.Työtä tarjotaan 38 h/viikko päivittäisiin toimiin ja 30 h/kk vapaa-aikaan, tunnit jaetaan kahden avustajan kesken. Työvuorot suunnitellaan kuukaudeksi eteenpäin, huomioiden työnantajan menot. Työtä on pääasiassa aamu- ja iltapäivä painotteisesti, mutta voi olla myös iltaisin sekä vähintään kahtena viikonloppuna kuukaudesta.Työnantaja tarvitsee apua päivittäisissä toimissa kuten pukeutumisessa, hiusten kiinnilaitossa ja ruuanlaitossa. Kodin hoito kuten siivous, tiskienlaitto, sängyn petaus ja roskien vienti kuuluvat avustajan työtehtäviin. Työnantaja tykkää elokuvissa, festareilla ja keikoilla käymisestä, mutta erityisen tärkeänä hän kokee ulkoilun ja mahdollisuuksien mukaan luonnossa liikkumisen. Työnantaja tykkää askarrella, tehdä makramee töitä ja leipoa. Eläimet varsinkin koirat ja kissat ovat lähellä sydäntä, vaikkei omaa lemmikkiä tällä hetkellä olekaan. Työnantaja on aktiivisesti mukana järjestöissä ja erilaisissa vertaistapaamisissa sekä käy puhumassa kokemustoimijana opiskelijoille ja muille vertaisille. Palkka Heta TES A 13,23 €/h +mahdolliset kokemuslisät.Avustajaksi haetaan tunnollista, joustavaa, reipasta, puheliasta, avointa ja lämminhenkistä ihmistä. Aikaisempaa kokemusta avustajan työstä ei tarvitse olla, motivaatio työtä kohtaan ja huumorintaju katsotaan eduksi.Työsuhteet ovat aina yksityisiä. Työsuhteeseen valittu henkilö on työsuhteessa avustettavaan.Haastatteluun valitulle tieto ilmoitetaan henkilökohtaisesti.Työ alkaa sopivan avustajan löydyttyä.Työnantajalla on oikeus pyytää iäkkäiden ja vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työhön valitulta työntekijältä rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi kerran työsuhteen alkaessa (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).Rikosrekisteriote on salassa pidettävää tietoa ja sitä ei tule lähettää hakemuksen yhteydessä. Hae työpaikkaa lähettämällä hakemuksesi suoraan työnantajalle osoitteeseen pasanensini92@gmail.com voit ottaa suoraan yhteyttä työnantajaan ja kysyä lisää työpaikasta soittamalla p. 045 1560380.
