jobs.title: Rustfri Smed
jobs.description:
Rustfri smed

 

Er du erfaren indenfor rustfri svejsning ? Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være udlært smed – det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring og kan levere et godt stykke håndværk, og er en kompetent og alsidig håndværker, som har fokus på kvalitet. Vil du gerne indgå som et ansvarligt medlem af et team i en professionelt ledet virksomhed? Så er du måske én af vores nye medarbejdere.

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Svejsning og bearbejdning af emner i rustfrit stål

  • Arbejde ud fra tegninger og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Kontrol af kvaliteten på de færdige emner

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om at få opgaverne sikkert og effektivt gennem produktionen

Har du også erfaring med aluminium, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav.

 

IQ Metal er i vækst, og for at møde vores kunders forventninger om leveringsfleksibilitet og -sikkerhed, har vi besluttet at øge antallet af medarbejdere og investere i en række nye maskiner. Du vil blive en del af et team med mere end 450 medarbejdere i IQ Metal, som samarbejder med store kunder i hele Europa. Vi leverer typisk samlede løsninger af produkter og fokuserer på at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse ved at sikre komplet levering til tiden, i rette kvalitet.

Kan du se dig selv i virksomheden?

Du indgår som en fast del af et godt team med 10-15 mand, som selv planlægger hverdagen og skaber overblik over ordreplanen. Vores maskinpark sikrer, at alt kører som det skal. En del af vores maskiner er fuldautomatiske, mens andre er semi-automatiske. Vi inviterer gerne på en kop kaffe og tur rundt i produktionen, hvis du er interesseret i et job hos os.

Vi tilbyder:

Løn og ansættelsesforhold er gode og konkurrencedygtige, og indeholder udover pension også en sundhedssikring. Alle fastansatte på nathold tilbydes årligt sundhedstjek. Der er kaffe og vand tilgængeligt i kantinen, og vi har en god stemning på virksomheden, som er professionelt ledet.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet?

Vi tilbyder selvstændigt arbejde i moderne faciliteter. Det er et krav, at du er en erfaren smed, som har arbejdet inden for faget inden for de sidste par år. Du skal have tegningsforståelse, samt selv kunne udvikle og fremstille fiksturer og værktøjer til at sikre optimal håndtering af emner.

Vi forventer at du er en god kollega, som hjælper til når det er krævet af hensyn til teamet og opfyldelse af kunders forventninger. Du har humor og smil på læben i hverdagen, også når der er travlt. Bopæl nær Hasselager/Århus vil være en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav.

Interesseret?

Læs mere om virksomheden hjemmesiden www.iqmetal.com eller kontakt vores produktionsleder Lars Holm på telefon 8738 9036 for en uforpligtende og fuldt fortrolig snak. Ansøg ved at sende dit CV eller skriv lidt om din erfaring på: lh@iqmetal.com.

jobs.title: Civil Site Coordinator
jobs.description: **The opportunity**Are you ready to play an important role in delivering the infrastructure that enables the energy transition?We are looking for a Civil Site Coordinator to join our Nordic Site Management organization at Hitachi Energy. In this role, you will coordinate civil construction activities and contribute to the successful delivery of Grid Integration and substation projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark.You will work closely with Site Managers, project teams, contractors and other stakeholders, helping ensure that civil works are planned and executed safely, efficiently and to a high standard. This is an excellent opportunity to work in an international project environment and contribute to some of the key projects shaping the future of the Nordic power grid.The position can be based in Finland (Helsinki, Tampere or Vaasa), Sweden (Västerås, Ludvika or Stockholm) or Denmark (Middelfart or Ballerup). Depending on the project phase, the role involves travel to project sites approximately 2–3 days per week in Finland, Sweden or Denmark.**How you'll make an impact****\-** Coordinate civil construction activities for projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark.\- Support Site Managers throughout project execution and help ensure smooth site operations.\- Coordinate interfaces between civil and electrical disciplines.\- Support resource planning and workforce coordination according to project needs.\- Participate in tendering, constructability reviews and execution planning.\- Support inspections, handovers and preparations for commissioning.\- Work closely with project teams, contractors and other stakeholders to ensure effective coordination.\- Promote a strong safety culture and high-quality performance across project sites.**Your background**\- You have a technical education in Civil Engineering, Construction Management or a related field.\- You have experience in substation, infrastructure, energy, construction or industrial projects.\- You have strong coordination, communication and collaboration skills.\- You are comfortable working with several stakeholders in an international project environment.\- You are proactive, structured and able to adapt to changing project needs.\- Fluent written and spoken skills in local language. Strong skills in English.\- You are willing and able to travel regularly across Finland, Sweden and Denmark.

jobs.title: Liikunnanohjaaja
jobs.description: Lappeenrannan kaupungin liikuntapalvelut hakee liikunnanohjaajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Liikunnanohjaajan tehtävä sisältää monipuolisesti erilaisten liikuntaryhmien ohjausta, sekä uinninvalvontaa.Uinninvalvontatyössä vastaat asiakaspalveluhenkisesti asiakkaiden turvallisuudesta, sekä muista uimahallin päivittäiseen toimintaan liittyvistä tehtävistä. Uinninvalvoja huolehtii uimahallin järjestyksestä ja sääntöjen noudattamisesta.Tehtävässä ohjataan työikäisten ja senioreiden matalan kynnyksen liikuntaryhmiä. Ryhmät voivat olla esimerkiksi kuntosaliohjauksia, vesiliikuntatunteja, kehonhuoltotunteja tai muita eri välinein ja kehonpainolla ohjattavia liikuntatunteja. Lisäksi työ voi sisältää kuntalaisille tarkoitettuja kuntosali- ja vesijuoksuopastuksia. Tehtävässä on mahdollista päästä mukaan edistämään kuntalaisten liikkumista esimerkiksi erilaisia tapahtumia järjestämällä.Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena tehtävään on liikunnanohjauksen perustutkinto tai muu tehtävään soveltuva koulutus, sekä tehtävään soveltuva työkokemus. Tehtävään valittavan tulee suorittaa hyväksytysti SUH:n uinninvalvojan testiuinti ennen työsuhteen aloitusta. Katsomme eduksi kokemuksen uimahalliympäristössä toimimisesta, sekä vesiliikunnan ohjaamisesta.Tehtävässä edellytetään kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti, sekä osana liikunnanohjaajien ja uinninvalvojien tiimiä. Lisäksi edellytämme hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja. Odotamme hakijalta itseohjautuvaa työotetta, kykyä toimia muuttuvissakin tilanteissa, sekä ongelmanratkaisutaitoa.Viikkotyöaika on KVTES:n yleistyöajan mukainen 38,25 tuntia viikossa. Työtä tehdään pääasiassa kahdessa vuorossa, jolloin aamuvuoro on yleisesti klo 6-14 ja iltavuoro klo 12-20. Työtä tehdään sekä Lappeenrannan että Lauritsalan uimahalleilla. Tarkempi työpiste sovitaan erikseen. Tehtävä sisältää työtä myös viikonloppuisin. Tehtävän aloitus sopimuksen mukaan vuoden 2027 alussa. Voimme aloittaa haastattelut jo hakuaikana.Liikkumisen edistämisen palveluyksikkö tarjoaa ohjattua liikuntaa kaikenikäisille kuntalaisille Lappeenrannassa. Liikunnanohjaajien ohjaamat terveysliikuntaryhmät on suunnattu kaikenikäisille kaupunkilaisille. Ryhmät ovat matalan kynnyksen liikuntaryhmiä, joissa tärkein tavoitteemme on lisätä kuntalaisten liikunnan harrastamista sekä tarjota terveyttä edistävää ja ylläpitävää liikuntaa.

jobs.title: Artome: Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description: **Type:** Full-time**Location**: Syrjäläntie 81, 19110 Heinola**Application deadline**: 22.11.2026Ready to grow Artome's presence across Europe? Take ownership of international sales, build partnerships and bring smarter spaces to life!**What will you be doing?**Artome is looking for a Regional Sales Manager to accelerate growth across European markets. Artome develops innovative, movable audiovisual solutions that make it easy to transform everyday spaces into functional presentation and learning environments. With growing demand across Europe, Artome is strengthening its international sales team.**In this role**, you will combine business development, channel management and hands-on sales. You will identify opportunities in new markets, develop relationships with local partners such as distributors and resellers, and manage the entire sales process from prospecting to closing. Your customers will primarily be schools, educational institutions, and other public-sector organizations.International travel is an essential part of the role, taking approximately 20–40% of your working time. The position covers multiple European countries, with your specific markets determined partly by your experience and language skills. **What makes you a great fit?**We are looking for a proactive sales professional who enjoys opening doors, developing partnerships, and turning opportunities into results. You bring genuine curiosity and the determination to keep moving forward. Most importantly, you believe in the products you represent and you are excited about your work.**We require you to:**- At least couple of years of experience in B2B sales, including international sales - A good understanding of distributor and reseller sales models and how to develop successful channel partnerships - Experience managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and customer meetings to negotiations and closing deals - Have a full working proficiency in English - Willingness to travel regularly across Europe **We consider as an asset:**- Working proficiency in additional European languages, for example French or German - Experience using AI tools to improve sales efficiency **We can offer you:**- The freedom to take ownership of your work and shape your schedule around your responsibilities - An international role where you can develop new markets and see the results of your work - An environment where your ideas can influence how Artome grows across Europe - Opportunities to build your career and expand your responsibilities as the company develops - A supportive and people-oriented team that values trust, independence, and collaboration

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Solutions
jobs.description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.About the jobReady to take on challenging mechanical engineering work with a clear purpose? With us you will contribute to global priorities such as energy efficiency, clean water, and Alfa Laval's net-zero 2030 ambition. Let's shape a better tomorrow together! We design and supply process solutions within various industries, mainly water treatment. As a Mechanical Engineer you will create solutions through selection of standard components and detailed engineering combined. Our designs contain pipes, pumps, decanters, evaporators, membranes, heat exchangers etc., and they are delivered as equipment packages or skid solutions. Work involves both new development and standardization of solutions to bring down lead time on customer projects. During project execution you will be working in global project teams with Project Manager, Process Specialists, Automation, Sourcing, Workshops and customers.Key tasks and responsibilities:    Use P&ID + mass balance to design process solutions in Autodesk Inventor    Selection of standard components matching process needs    3D pipe routing using Inventor Piping/Sovelia    Detailed Engineering of skid solutions, including fabrication documentation    DFM in collaboration with workshop    FAT, piping line walk and SAT    Standardization of 3D design templates using skeleton and iLogic    Review 3D designs and 2D drawings    Review technical specifications from customers and develop technical deviation lists.    Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and CE marking    Agile project execution using MS DevOps    Ensure that the quality management system is followed Planned travels, mostly within Europe, for inspections and commissioning are part of the job - approximately 20 - 25 days per year. You will be part of an innovative mechanical team of ten who are continuously implementing smarter ways of working. You report to Jesper Bergstrøm, a people-oriented leader who is passionate about his team thriving in their roles and look forward to going to work!At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, allowing you to work from home when it aligns with your tasks.Joining Alfa Laval means being part of a flat, open, and inclusive culture that values collaboration and empowers employees. The company supports continuous learning and career development, fostering a strong growth mindset. As an established yet nimble global organization with 300+ locations and a long heritage of innovation, Alfa Laval offers both stability and autonomy often found in smaller firms. You will also gain meaningful cross-cultural exposure by working with international teams on impactful projects. Who are youYou are a results-driven, high-energy professional who maintains focus and a positive attitude while pursuing ambitious goals. You take initiative, make calculated decisions with confidence, and consistently turn plans into action. You build strong networks across and beyond the organization, using your relational skills to influence, collaborate, and create impact. Proactive, timely, and quality-minded, you work effectively with others and help drive collective success.What you knowWe are looking for you with solid skills and experience in project execution within the wastewater, fluid handling, or a related processing industry.Requirements:     Degree in mechanical engineering.    Strong understanding of P&ID, piping, and detailed engineering.    Experience in driving standardization within piping and flange designs.    Familiarity with GEP, CE marking and ATEX requirements.    Understanding relevant industry standards and regulations, including ISO and ASME.    Excellent communication skills in English For more information, please contactJesper Bergstrøm, Engineering Manager, Mechanical Engineering & Design, WIFH PM&E +45 4271 8160 or Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner atWe are conducting a continuous review of received applications and the ad might be closed before ending date. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).Please send your application no later than November 25, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area.Our commitment to integrityWe care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games. #LI-CL1

jobs.title: Myyntikoordinaattori
jobs.description: **Etsimme myyntikoordinaattoria määräaikaiseen sijaisuuteen**_Haluatko olla mukana toteuttamassa upeita elämyksiä ja kokemuksia yhdessä ammattitaitoisen ja innostuneen tiimin kanssa Suomen parhaassa tapahtumatalossa?_**Etsimme Logomoon myyntikoordinaattoria määräaikaiseen, kokopäiväiseen työsuhteeseen sijaisuuden ajaksi. Työ alkaa 4.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Sijaisuuden kesto on vähintään 12kk.**Päivittäiseen työhösi kuuluu erityisesti yritysasiakkaiden B2B-tapahtumien ravintolapalveluiden myynti ja koordinointi. Huolehdit myös kokous- ja tapahtumapakettien sekä aitioiden varauksista yhdessä muun myyntitiimin kanssa. Lisäksi vastaat asiakkaiden kontaktoinnista, tarjousten laatimisesta ja laskutuksesta.Tehtävä on kokopäivätyö, joka sijoittuu pääosin arkipäiviin. Logomon tapahtumaluonteisen toiminnan vuoksi arvostamme kuitenkin joustavuutta ja valmiutta työskennellä toisinaan myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.Odotamme sinulta vahvaa ravintola-alan tuntemusta ja kokemusta yritysasiakkaille suunnattujen suurten B2B-tilaisuuksien parissa työskentelystä. Arvostamme erityisesti käytännön kokemusta ravintola- ja catering-palveluiden myynnistä, tapahtumien toteutuksesta sekä kykyä tunnistaa yritysasiakkaiden tarpeita. Nämä ovat tehtävässä merkittäviä vahvuuksia, jotka auttavat sinua onnistumaan työssäsi.Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään itsenäisesti ja vastaat omasta tehtäväkokonaisuudestasi osana tiivistä yhteistyötä myyntitiimin ja ravintolan kanssa. Olet oma-aloitteinen, järjestelmällinen ja aikaansaava tekijä, jolla on erinomaiset yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä asiakaslähtöinen työskentelyote. Viihdyt sekä itsenäisessä työssä että tiimissä, hallitset useita asioita samanaikaisesti ja pystyt työskentelemään joustavasti myös kiireen ja paineen alla. Toivomme sinulta sujuvaa viestintätaitoa sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Arvostamme rohkeita ideoita, positiivista asennetta ja halua kehittää omaa työtäsi.Pääset osaksi kokous-, tapahtuma- ja ravintola-alan monipuolista maailmaa, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen. Logomossa pääset työskentelemään ainutlaatuisten tapahtumien parissa osana innostunutta ammattilaistiimiä.

jobs.description: Etsimme monipuolisen osaamisen omaavaa autoasentajaa Nurmijärvelle!Työn kuvaus:Etsimme vakituiseen työhön osaavaa autoasentajaa paikalliseen huoltoliikkeeseen Nurmijärvelle. jobs.title: Warehouse Specialist
jobs.description:
About Talgo

Talgo is a leading international train manufacturer and maintenance provider with more than 75 years of experience in railway innovation.

Department: Talgo Warranty / Logistics & Warehouse Operations

Position Summary: The Warehouse Specialist is responsible for the efficient receipt, storage, movement, control, and distribution of materials supporting Talgo warranty operations. The role ensures stock accuracy, timely material availability, safe warehouse practices, and effective communication with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and customers.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Update and consult information related to incoming and outgoing materials using the designated software application (SW tool).

  • Analyze, plan, and organize material flow and delivery to assembly workstations in coordination with senior management.

  • Monitor and follow up on internally manufactured materials throughout the production flow while maintaining effective communication with all involved departments.

  • Ensure proper management and replenishment of all KANBAN materials.

  • Detect data discrepancies and report errors or inconsistencies to senior management.

  • Move materials using appropriate lifting, handling, and internal transportation equipment.

  • Conduct inventory counts and support stock accuracy initiatives.

  • Follow up and claim required materials from procurement, purchasing, suppliers, and other relevant stakeholders, providing status updates to management.

  • Manage warehouse stock including receiving, storing, counting goods, monitoring shelf life where applicable, and handling expired or rejected items.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and suppliers, ensuring smooth communication and service levels.

  • Operate outdoor vehicles such as vans, trucks, and cars to support operational requirements and resolve logistics issues.

  • Ensure correct receipt, storage, distribution, and internal logistics operations to provide workstations with required materials on time.

  • Pack and palletize all incoming and outgoing materials in accordance with company procedures, quality requirements, and safety guidelines.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Experience in warehouse, logistics, material control, or a similar role.

  • Ability to use warehouse management and inventory software systems.

  • Knowledge of stock control, inventory management, and material handling processes.

  • Strong organizational, planning, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work safely, accurately, and effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Good teamwork and problem-solving capabilities.

Om Talgo

Talgo er en førende international togproducent og leverandør af vedligeholdelsestjenester med mere end 75 års erfaring inden for innovation i jernbanesektoren.

Stillingen

Vi søger en engageret og teknisk dygtig Warranty Elektriker til vores team i Næstved. Du bliver en del af vores warranty-afdeling, hvor du vil arbejde med fejlfinding, diagnosticering, reparation og teknisk support af tog under garantiperioden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Udføre montage, demontering, målinger, fejlsøgning og korrigerende vedligeholdelse på elektriske og elektroniske systemer i tog.

  • Udskifte og reparere elektriske og elektroniske komponenter.

  • Gennemføre og dokumentere ændringer baseret på analyser af tilbagevendende fejl.

  • Overvåge og følge op på togssystemers funktion og ydeevne.

  • Anvende diagnoseværktøjer, software og interfaces til dataindsamling og fejlfinding.

  • Yde teknisk support og samarbejde tæt med Product Maintenance-teamet.

  • Udarbejde tekniske rapporter og dokumentation.

  • Sikre overholdelse af sikkerheds-, kvalitets- og driftsstandarder.

  • Bidrage til root cause-analyser og løbende forbedringsinitiativer.

Din profil

  • Uddannet elektriker, el-tekniker eller tilsvarende.

  • Erfaring med elektrisk vedligeholdelse og fejlfinding.

  • Evne til at læse og forstå el-diagrammer og teknisk dokumentation.

  • Gode engelskkundskaber i skrift og tale.

  • Struktureret, kvalitetsbevidst og teamorienteret.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et internationalt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Faglige og personlige udviklingsmuligheder.

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår.

  • Arbejde med moderne og innovativ jernbaneteknologi.

///

Talgo is a leading international train manufacturer and maintenance provider with more than 75 years of experience in railway innovation.

The Role

Join our warranty team delivering troubleshooting, repairs, diagnostics and technical support for train electrical and electronic systems during the warranty period.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform assembly, disassembly, measurement, diagnosis, corrective maintenance, and follow-up of electrical/electronic failures in the various train systems.

What We Offer

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Intelligent Computing Architectures
jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a one-year postdoctoral researcher position within Intelligent Computing Architectures, focusing on Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning. The appointment runs for one year from March 1, 2027, with the possibility of extension subject to available funding.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to design, optimize, and evaluate hybrid quantum-classical learning systems under realistic hardware constraints. The project is platform-independent and will investigate how noise, limited quantum resources, device connectivity, and classical computational overhead affect learning performance and practical implementation.

Possible research directions include hardware-aware model design and training, quantum-classical ensemble learning and mixture-of-experts, resource-efficient learning methods, and automated architecture search. The specific research programme will be defined with the successful applicant according to their expertise and the project objectives, with a focused and achievable scope for the initial year. Evaluation will include suitable classical baselines and explicit assessment of computational resource requirements.

The successful candidate will work on model design, quantum programming, simulation, training, and experimental evaluation of hybrid quantum-classical learning systems. The position includes collaboration with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners, identifying relevant research and implementation opportunities, and supporting joint activities. The candidate will also contribute to research proposals and funding applications related to quantum machine learning, intelligent computing architectures, and resource-efficient computing, as well as publications, technical documentation, and project reporting. The research will be supervised by Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio.

 

As a Postdoc in Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning, your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Design, implement, and simulate hybrid quantum-classical learning models, investigating the effects of noise, connectivity, finite sampling, resource limitations, and training conditions. Explore suitable methods such as hardware-aware training, ensemble learning, mixture-of-experts, or architecture search within the agreed research program.

  • Conduct reproducible experimental evaluations of learning performance, trainability, noise resilience, and computational resource requirements using quantum programming frameworks and machine learning tools. Compare results with suitable classical baselines and correlate observed behavior with model design and hardware constraints.

  • Support collaboration with Danish and international academic, industrial, and technology-development partners in quantum machine learning and intelligent computing architectures, identify relevant research and implementation opportunities, contribute to joint activities, and prepare research proposals, funding applications, publications, technical documentation, and project reports.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • An opportunity to develop a platform-independent research program in hardware-aware quantum machine learning, combining quantum programming, simulation, and machine learning methods with resource-aware evaluation.

  • Opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in quantum machine learning, microelectronics, AI accelerators, and advanced computing.

  • Strong support for professional development through the Lecturer Training Programme and mentoring, as well as opportunities to develop experience in research proposal writing, project development, and collaboration with Danish and European technology partners. 

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, computing architectures, quantum computing, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Quantum Computing, Machine Learning, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Demonstrated experience in quantum programming using frameworks such as Qiskit, PennyLane, or equivalent tools, including implementation and simulation of quantum circuits.

  • Demonstrated experience in machine learning, including model implementation, training, and evaluation, with strong programming skills. Experience in quantum machine learning, hybrid quantum-classical models, noise-aware optimization, ensemble methods, or automated architecture search is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

  • Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners. 

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. The postdoc will work with Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio on hardware-aware quantum machine learning, with opportunities to connect this research to the section’s expertise in AI accelerators and energy-efficient computing architectures.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Odense. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the research and the position, please contact Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio (chisio@sdu.dk), research contact and supervisor. Additional enquiries may be directed to Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial one-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Research Assistant in Learning Design
jobs.description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a Research Assistant position. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is for 12 months.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This position sits where those ideas become things people can actually use. You will take responsibility for designing and creating content — reusable set of pedagogical modules that instructors can adopt without redesigning a whole course — and for the hands-on work of redesigning selected software engineering courses at SDU. The project’s research produces findings; this role turns them into activities, materials, rubrics, and guidance that survive contact with a real semester. Implementation is iterative rather than one-shot. Modules go into classrooms, evidence comes back through classroom interventions, surveys, artifact analysis, and educator feedback, and the next version is better for it. If you like building educational material and watching it improve under real use — and you would rather serve teaching than only write about it — this is a role with unusually visible results. Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and produce reusable pedagogical modules — guided scenarios, reflection and verification activities, assessment tasks, rubrics, and instructor guidance — that courses can adopt on demand.

  • Redesign selected SE courses at SDU. Work with course responsibles and programme leaders to rework intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment so that responsible AI use is explicitly taught and examined.

  • Coordinate classroom deployments across semesters, keeping instructors supported and the logistics from eating the pedagogy.

  • Gather and act on evidence. Administer surveys, analyze student artifacts (decision notes, verification evidence, reflections), collect structured educator feedback, and feed it into the next iteration.

  • Document and release. Maintain the toolkit as open, well-documented material others can pick up after the project ends, and contribute to project reporting and publications.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree, on Game Development and Learning Technology, Design and Interaction, Educational Technology, Media and Communication, or a closely related field. The degree must be completed before the starting date — this is a firm requirement.

Qualifications Required

  • Demonstrated experience creating educational content — course materials, learning modules, exercises, assessment tasks, e-learning components, or training programmes — with examples you can show us. Please, share a link to your portfolio if available.

  • An educational or pedagogical background, whether through your degree, formal training in teaching or learning design, or substantial practical experience.

  • Excellent written and spoken Danish and English, and the ability to write clearly for two audiences at once: students and the instructors who will use your materials.

Personal competences

  • Craft in making things others will use. You care whether an activity actually works in week seven of a busy semester, not only whether it reads well in a design document.

  • A service orientation towards instructors. Course responsibles own their courses and have limited time. We value someone who makes adoption easy and earns agreement through evidence and patience rather than argument.

  • Organized and self-directed. You will be coordinating deployments across courses at SDU and several semesters, and much of the scheduling discipline will rest with you.

  • Comfort with iteration. The first version of a module will be wrong in interesting ways. Treating that as information rather than failure is most of the job.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be collecting data from people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

 

Workplace description 

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications, if you have any.

  • Publications most relevant for the position (max. 2).

  • Up to two references (can be supplied later in the hiring process).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 9, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment termsAppointment as a research assistant is temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. 

Employment as a research assistant requires qualifications at minimum master’s level (equivalent to a Danish master’s degree) at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for research assistant as described therein.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

jobs.title: Anaesthetic Nurse Wanted – Anaesthesia Unit 1
jobs.description:
Are you looking for new challenges? Would you like to work alongside skilled colleagues in an educational and dynamic environment where professional excellence and high-quality patient care are top priorities?You can expect a varied, fast-paced and sometimes unpredictable working day, with plenty of responsibility. In return, we promise you a workplace characterised by high job satisfaction and a strong sense of teamwork, where there is always room for humour and a smile, no matter how busy things get.About Anaesthesia Unit 1The unit covers several specialties and operates across two hospital sites. You will primarily be based at the new Hospital City East (Hospitalsbyen Øst), with only occasional shifts at Aalborg South. This advertisement describes the position within Anaesthesia Unit 1 East, which will be your primary place of employment.We bring together two specialties in a combined orthopaedic and neurosurgical anaesthesia unit.Neurosurgical anaesthesiaWe provide anaesthesia for:
  • Intracranial surgery
  • Conventional spinal and neurosurgery
  • Surgery involving pain stimulation electrodes
Orthopaedic anaesthesiaWe provide anaesthesia for both children and adults across all orthopaedic subspecialties, covering everything from day surgery to major spinal surgery.In addition, our responsibilities include:
  • Providing emergency anaesthesia services for acutely ill medical patients in the Acute Treatment Centre (ATC).
  • Receiving trauma patients as part of the hospital's trauma team.
  • Managing patient transfers both within and outside the North Denmark Region.
  • Providing anaesthesia for interventional radiology procedures.
  • Providing anaesthesia for MRI and CT scans.
We operate a total of eight operating theatres each day.Our team consists of approximately 34 anaesthetic nurses, including a Nurse Manager, two coordinating anaesthetic nurses, anaesthetic nurses working in the U and UU functions, and specialist pain nurses.The unit is also a clinical training site for:
  • Nurses undertaking specialist training in anaesthesia.
  • First-semester nursing students.
  • Anaesthesiology doctors undertaking specialist training.
  • Ambulance practitioners and paramedics.
  • Medical personnel from the Danish Armed Forces.
Make a Difference with UsAs an anaesthetic nurse, your primary responsibility will be to provide anaesthesia for both elective and emergency patients.You will quickly develop your ability to assess, analyse and make the right clinical decisions, working alongside a broad team of highly skilled colleagues who make a real difference to our patients every day.What We OfferYou can look forward to a challenging role with considerable responsibility and the opportunity to work across several specialties. You will also be involved in emergency anaesthesia duties throughout the hospital.The position involves a rotating shift pattern, including weekend shifts.In addition, we offer:
  • Skilled, positive and dedicated colleagues who are committed to their own professional development and to advancing anaesthetic nursing
  • A team that places great importance on maintaining a positive working environment
  • The opportunity to submit preferences for your shift schedule through our OPTIMA scheduling system
You will be in good hands from your very first day. Throughout your induction period, you will be supported by experienced colleagues who will ensure that you are well prepared to undertake your responsibilities independently.You will also have opportunities to attend relevant professional development courses, including:
  • Courses at Aalborg University Hospital's Skills and Simulation Centre (Nord Sim).
  • Simulation-based training within the unit.
  • ATCN (Advanced Trauma Care for Nurses).
  • Courses offered through FSAIO, both nationally and internationally.
About YouYou contribute to a positive and respectful working environment and enjoy collaborating with colleagues in a busy setting involving complex, multidisciplinary care.You are recognised for your ability to communicate clearly and respectfully, including in challenging situations that require immediate action and sound clinical judgement.In addition, you:
  • Hold a recognized specialist qualification in anaesthetic nursing.
  • Already has or can obtain a Danish Authorization in accordance with Danish law
  • Are fluent in Danish, Norwegian or Swedish (preferably)
  • Can communicate effectively with both patients and colleagues and actively contribute to a positive working environment in an ever-changing workplace.
  • Have a positive attitude towards change and development. We experience plenty of both, whether we are refining our daily workflows or adapting to the new facilities and working procedures at Hospital City East.

jobs.title: Postdoc and Assistant Professor Positions in Communications, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design
jobs.description:
Would you like to advance wireless connectivity and radar sensing for intelligent devices and autonomous systems? The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more Postdoc (2 years) and/or Assistant Professor positions in Communications, Signal Processing, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design. Join a growing research environment connecting electronic systems research with applications in robotics, drones, defence technology, and the Internet of Things (IoT). The preferred starting date is February 1, 2027.

 

Job Content

Your research will advance communications, signal processing, radar systems, and antenna design, with a focus on real-time wireless connectivity, physical-layer technologies, and antennas for intelligent devices, IoT systems, and edge computers. The scope spans 5G, mmWave, terahertz technologies, 6G and beyond, LoRa, software-defined radio, and integrated sensing, including communication protocols, modulation techniques, and antenna design and implementation. Applications include autonomous collaborative robotics, drone swarm communications, radar-based object detection and tracking, low-power radio sensor networks, and defence technology.

You will have the opportunity to connect your research with the section’s complementary expertise in FPGA and neuromorphic computing, edge AI, machine learning, sensing technologies, and energy harvesting. Working with academic colleagues and professional staff across SDU campuses, you will contribute to a collaborative research community and the development of academic programmes.

Postdoc: You will conduct research within the position’s scope, contribute to course planning, support teaching, and supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s students in relevant fields. You will also support the research team in developing applications for external funding.

Assistant Professor: You will develop and sustain a research agenda that strengthens or complements the section’s activities, secure external research funding, and publish in reputable journals and international conference proceedings. You will plan and teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in communications, radar and sensor technologies, and antenna theory and practice, while advising and mentoring students and supervising their research projects. You will also contribute to academic service at section and department levels, participate in professional activities and conferences locally, nationally, and internationally, and undertake other duties assigned by the Section Chair.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics, Communications, or a closely related field. Your application must document the following qualifications:

  • Research expertise relevant to the position in communications, signal processing, or antenna design.

  • Demonstrated potential to teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses at university level.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants, pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position’s teaching and research responsibilities.

International research experience gained in an environment other than the institution where the applicant completed their PhD will be considered an advantage. 

 

Workplace description 

The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics brings together research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communications. Using advanced reconfigurable computing and sensing technologies, we develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions for autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grids, and healthcare. This breadth creates opportunities to connect fundamental research with practical engineering challenges. 

Our research is organized into four complementary areas: 1) Infrastructure Inspection and Maintenance, 2) Bio-inspired Intelligent Systems, 3) High-Frequency Power Management, and 4) Radar Remote Sensing. The section is growing steadily and comprises 15 staff members, including professors, PhD students, and engineers, who contribute to research, industrial collaboration, and education. We play a central role in electrical engineering education in Odense, contributing to Bachelor’s and Master of Science programmes in Electronics Engineering. 

SDU’s Odense campus brings together six faculties, with a large university hospital soon to join the campus environment, creating opportunities for interdisciplinary research and a vibrant student life. Odense offers a culturally rich setting with a growing robotics community, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river through the city centre. 

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU.

 

Further information 

To learn more about the positions and research environment, please contact Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, Head of the Section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics, at esme@sdu.dk. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

We welcome applications outlining how your expertise and research ambitions would contribute to the section. Please submit your application in English and include the following documents: 

  • A motivation letter describing your interest in the position, relevant qualifications, and reasons for joining the section (maximum 2 pages).

  • A detailed curriculum vitae, including contact information, research experience, teaching experience, computational skills, and other relevant qualifications.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a Teaching Portfolio documenting your teaching qualifications and experience. 

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a research plan outlining your proposed research direction and plans for developing a research line, securing external funding, and building a research team. 

  • For Postdoc applicants: a brief research plan outlining your proposed research focus, approach, and expected contributions during the two-year appointment, including its alignment with the position and the section’s activities. 

  • PhD, Master’s and     Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent (original     and an official English translation). 

  • A list of publications, with the most relevant     publications highlighted.  

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Names and email addresses of up to three     researchers who can provide an informed reference at short notice.     Reference letters and documentation of other relevant qualifications may     also be included.  

  • A statement/documentation     of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

 

The application deadline is December 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

The appointments are temporary for an initial 2-year period (for the postdoc position) or 3-year period (for the assistant professor position). Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.  

Employment as a postdoctoral fellow and assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for either postdoc or assistant professor as described therein.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Hoitaja
jobs.description: TULE SAHRAN TIIMIIN!Etsitkö työtä, jossa et ole vain numero muiden joukossa, vaan osa huipputiimiä? Sahran Sosiaalipalvelut etsii nyt uutta työkaveria kotihoidon tiimiin Pirhan alueelle!Etsimme sinua, jolla on jo kokemusta sosiaali- ja terveysalan asiakastyöstä ja sydän mukana tekemisessä! Olitpa sitten lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja tai sosionomi, saatat hyvinkin olla juuri etsimämme tyyppi.Erityisesti etsimme ammattilaista, jolla on aiempaa kokemusta vammais-, kehitysvamma- ja/tai mielenterveysalan asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä. Arvostamme osaamistasi, mutta meille on yhtä tärkeää, millaisella asenteella kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit.Mitä me odotamme sinulta?Ammattitaito hallussa: Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva sosiaali- tai terveysalan tutkinto. Lääkehoidon laajat luvat, ensiaputaidot ja hygieniapassi kuuluvat osaamiseesi.Edellytämme sinulta hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa.Kokemusta erityistä tukea tarvitsevien asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä: Vammais-, kehitysvamma- ja/tai mielenterveysalan asiakastyö on sinulle jo tuttua. Osaat kohdata erilaisia ihmisiä yksilöllisesti ja ymmärrät, että jokainen asiakas tarvitsee omanlaisensa lähestymistavan.Ajokortti tulee löytyä taskusta, sillä työtehtävät edellyttävät liikkumista paikasta toiseen. Omaa autoa et kuitenkaan tarvitse, sillä menopeli löytyy talon puolesta.Ratkaisukeskeinen asenne: Joskus arki heittää eteen mutkia, mutta sinä et hätkähdä, vaan keksit ratkaisun hymyssä suin.Tiimihenkeä: Olet loistava tyyppi, jonka kanssa muiden on kiva tehdä töitä. Osaat toimia itsenäisesti, mutta tiedät myös, että parhaat onnistumiset syntyvät yhdessä.Miksi Sahralla on kivempaa?Meillä et ole yksin. Tarjoamme joustavan työn, jossa pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan asiakkaiden arkeen. Meillä nauru saa kuulua, omia ideoita saa tuoda esiin ja apua saa aina pyytää.Arvostamme ammattitaitoasi, luotamme osaamiseesi ja haluamme, että viihdyt työssäsi. Meille hyvä työyhteisö ei ole vain hieno lause työpaikkailmoituksessa, vaan asia, jota rakennamme yhdessä joka päivä.Oletko sinä meidän uusi kollega?Älä suotta hio hakemustasi viikkoja – meitä kiinnostaa ennen kaikkea, kuka sinä olet, mitä osaat ja millaista kokemusta sinulle on kertynyt!Laita viestiä tai hakemusta tulemaan:rekrytointi.kotihoito@sahraoy.fiToimi heti, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan tyypin löydyttyä!

jobs.title: Produktionslederassistent søges til fast aftenhold i Give
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring fra produktion, og trives du med at tage ansvar, skabe overblik og sikre, at hverdagen fungerer? Så har vi en spændende mulighed for dig som produktionslederassistent på aftenhold i Give.

Vi søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst produktionslederassistent (PLA) til en moderne fødevarevirksomhed i Give, som er i rivende vækst. Her får du en alsidig stilling, hvor du både bliver en aktiv del af den daglige produktion og samtidig får en vigtig rolle i at sikre struktur, samarbejde og en stabil drift på produktionslinjen.

Stillingen er oplagt til dig, der allerede har erfaring fra produktionsmiljøet og gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere. Måske har du tidligere haft en koordinerende rolle eller fungeret som mellemleder, eller måske er du den kollega, der naturligt tager initiativ og hjælper med at holde styr på opgaverne, når der er travlt.

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed, hvor der er fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og godt samarbejde, og hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.

Om jobbet:

Som produktionslederassistent får du en vigtig funktion i den daglige drift på aftenholdet. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med dine kolleger i produktionen, hvor du både deltager i de praktiske arbejdsopgaver og hjælper med at koordinere arbejdet, så produktionslinjen kører effektivt.

En stor del af din hverdag vil foregå i produktionen, hvor du blandt andet skal betjene og overvåge produktionsmaskiner samt sikre, at arbejdet bliver udført i overensstemmelse med virksomhedens krav til kvalitet, hygiejne og orden.

Samtidig bliver du en vigtig støtte for dine kolleger. Du skal være med til at skabe overblik over dagens opgaver, hjælpe med at fordele arbejdet og tage initiativ, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs. Det kræver, at du kan bevare roen, træffe beslutninger og være med til at sikre en god arbejdsrytme på holdet.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:

  • Deltagelse i den daglige produktion samt betjening og overvågning af produktionsmaskiner

  • Koordinering af opgaver og understøttelse af en stabil drift på produktionslinjen

  • Opfølgning på kvalitet, hygiejne og orden i produktionen

  • Støtte og vejledning af kolleger i det daglige arbejde

  • Håndtering af udfordringer og sikring af et effektivt produktionsflow

Du får dermed en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du både kan bruge dine praktiske erfaringer og udvikle dine evner inden for koordinering og ledelse.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra produktion og er vant til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, kvalitet og samarbejde er afgørende for, at opgaverne bliver løst. Har du tidligere arbejdet inden for fødevareproduktion, er det en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at tage ansvar.

Du er typen, der naturligt tager initiativ og hjælper til, hvor der er behov for det. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men trives også med at være en del af et team, hvor man hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok.

Det er vigtigt, at du er god til at bevare overblikket, også når der er mange opgaver i gang på samme tid. Du arbejder struktureret, er løsningsorienteret og har forståelse for, hvordan man skaber en effektiv hverdag i produktionen.

Har du tidligere haft en rolle som teamleder, produktionskoordinator eller mellemleder, vil det være et stort plus. Det er dog ikke et krav, så længe du har lysten og evnerne til at påtage dig en koordinerende funktion.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra produktion, gerne inden for fødevareindustrien

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, mødestabil og engageret

  • Kan bevare overblikket og træffe beslutninger i en travl hverdag

  • Er samarbejdsorienteret og god til at motivere og hjælpe dine kolleger

  • Trives med både praktiske opgaver og koordinering af personale

  • Taler og skriver dansk

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

Du får mulighed for at blive en del af en moderne fødevarevirksomhed, der er i positiv udvikling, og hvor der er gode muligheder for at vokse med opgaverne.

Her bliver du en del af et produktionsmiljø, hvor du får ansvar og mulighed for at præge den daglige drift. Du får en varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og koordinerende opgaver, hvor din indsats har direkte betydning for, at produktionen fungerer optimalt.

Stillingen tilbydes som et Try & Hire-forløb med henblik på efterfølgende fastansættelse. Det giver både dig og virksomheden mulighed for at lære hinanden godt at kende, inden en fast ansættelse.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • Fast aftenhold i en fuldtidsstilling

  • Try & Hire-forløb med mulighed for fastansættelse

  • En spændende rolle med ansvar i den daglige produktion

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde

  • En arbejdsplads i rivende vækst

Arbejdstider:

Stillingen er på fast aftenhold.

Arbejdssted: Give

Er du vores nye produktionslederassistent?

Har du erfaring fra produktion, og er du klar til en hverdag, hvor du både får mulighed for at arbejde praktisk og tage mere ansvar? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send dit CV til mo@teamly.dk, og skriv "PLA" i emnefeltet.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne dit CV allerede i dag.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.description: Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés. Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.Descriptif missionOverview: In this role, the Lead Engineer (Mechanical Design) will actively participate in conceptual and detailed design of NPI (New Product Introduction), redesign and technology programs of Safran Electronics & Defense business unit and will support various Actuation Systems product lines including Power Door Opening System (PDOS), Thrust Reverser Actuation Systems (TRAS) and Highlift Flap and Slat Actuation systems.Position: Lead Engineer (P2) - Mechanical DesignPrimary Responsibilities:o Understand system requirements, design intent, and comply with applicable design practices, aerospace standards, customer requirements and regulatory requirements.o Contribute and implement the design and development of engineering solutions taking account of critical constraints for cost, safety, and sustainability.o Perform trade study involving conflicting demands from engineering functions (stress, reliability, Performance).o Carry out conceptual design and detailed design (modelling and drafting) for NPI, Technology programs and value engineeringo Apply GD&T and perform tolerance stack-up analysis for components/Sub-systems. o Provide inputs to improve Processes, tools, methods, and productso Design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM and DFA) and optimize the design for cost reduction, weight reduction, mistake proofing, material selection. o Perform design failure mode and effects analyses o Support manufacturing concessions and engineering change requestso Self-motivated and keen to get involved in new technologies and projects and learn new skills to map out future career path.o Actively participate in a team environment and work with customers, suppliers, and cross functional teams for product developmento Develop optimized product design by challenging existing design and ideas and by offering innovative ideas. o Ensure design works are done in time and with the required details and quality
