jobs.title: Enhetschef (familjeledighetsvikariat)
jobs.description: **VI SÖKER EN ENHETSCHEF!****– Vill du vara med och göra skillnad för barn, unga och familjer?**Luna Familjecenter söker en engagerad och ansvarstagande **enhetschef till vår verksamhet för periodiskt professionellt stöd (PPS) och övriga öppenvårdstjänster**.Tjänsten är ett **familjeledighetsvikariat på ett år**, från och med 4.1.2027 eller enligt överenskommelse, med möjlighet till förlängning.Vi söker dig som trivs med att leda och utveckla verksamhet, skapa struktur och arbeta nära både personal, klienter och samarbetsparter.**Om vår verksamhet**Luna Familjecenter erbjuder mångsidiga socialvårdstjänster för barn, unga och familjer. Vårt arbete präglas av ett systemiskt förhållningssätt där vi ser till barnets och familjens hela livssituation, med fokus på delaktighet, trygghet och individuella behov.**Periodiskt professionellt stöd (PPS)** är en av våra öppenvårdstjänster och bedrivs vid vår enhet **Tomtebo i centrala Jakobstad**.Verksamheten erbjuder planerade stöddygn där barn och unga får vistas och övernatta i en trygg och hemlik miljö med stöd av professionell personal. Stöddygnen utformas individuellt utifrån barnets och familjens behov och målsättningar.Syftet är att stöda barnets välbefinnande, utveckling och vardagsfärdigheter samt bidra till att stärka familjens resurser och fungerande vardag. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med barnets vårdnadshavare och ansvariga sociala myndigheter.Barn och unga som får stöddygn kan även ha andra öppenvårdsinsatser, såsom stödperson eller familjearbete. När dessa insatser är knutna till stöddygnen ansvarar enhetschefen även för att koordinera och samordna uppdragen, så att stödet bildar en fungerande helhet utifrån barnets och familjens behov.**Om tjänsten**Som enhetschef har du ett övergripande ansvar för verksamhetens personal, dagliga arbete och klientprocesser.**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:**- Leda, stöda och utveckla personalgruppen samt ansvara för personalfrågor. - Ansvara för planering, genomförande, uppföljning och utvärdering av klienternas individuella stödinsatser. - Planera och samordna verksamhetens resurser och bemanning. - Säkerställa ett gott samarbete med sociala myndigheter, vårdnadshavare och övriga samarbetsparter. - Ansvara för verksamhetens kvalitet, struktur och kontinuerliga utveckling. - Ingå i Luna Familjecenters ledningsgrupp och aktivt bidra till utvecklingen av hela organisationens verksamhet. **Behörighetskrav**För tjänsten förutsätts:- **Lämplig utbildning inom social- eller hälsovårdsbranschen**, exempelvis socionom (YH), sjukskötare (YH) eller socialarbetare, samt registrering som yrkesutbildad person inom social- eller hälsovården. - **Erfarenhet av ledarskap alternativt fortbildning inom ledarskap.** - **Kännedom om socialvård och/eller barnskydd.** - **Goda kunskaper i både svenska och finska**, såväl muntligt som skriftligt. **Som merit ses utbildning inom eller kunskap om systemiskt arbetssätt.****Vem söker vi?**Vi söker en trygg, engagerad och ansvarstagande person med ett genuint intresse för arbete med barn, unga och familjer.Vi värdesätter att du:- Har god organisationsförmåga och kan planera, prioritera och skapa struktur. - Har ett närvarande och inkluderande ledarskap där du kan stöda, motivera och utveckla medarbetarna. - Är självständig och lösningsfokuserad samt trygg i att fatta beslut. - Har god samarbetsförmåga och lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer. - Har intresse för kvalitetsarbete och verksamhetsutveckling. **Vad erbjuder vi?**Hos Luna Familjecenter blir du en del av en **välmående, positiv och engagerad arbetsgemenskap** där samarbete, delaktighet och utveckling värdesätts.Vi erbjuder:- Ett meningsfullt och varierande arbete med möjlighet att påverka och utveckla verksamheten. - En självständig chefsroll med stort utrymme att planera och strukturera det egna arbetet. - Ett nära samarbete med verksamhetschefen och övriga enhetschefer i ledningsgruppen, där du får stöd och möjlighet till gemensam reflektion. - Heltidsarbete som i huvudsak utförs under kontorstid, med flexibilitet och möjlighet att påverka arbetstidens förläggning. - Epassi-personalförmån som stöd för välbefinnande och fritid. - En positiv, stödjande och välmående arbetsgemenskap med engagerade kollegor och ett gott samarbetsklimat. **Välkommen till Luna Familjecenter!**Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera ett nära och närvarande ledarskap med ett betydelsefullt arbete för barn och familjer. Du blir en viktig del av en organisation där vi tillsammans utvecklar verksamheten och arbetar för att skapa trygghet, delaktighet och positiva förändringar.**Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!**

jobs.title: Gestionnaire des partenariats liés au Streetwork et autres réseaux (m/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Gestionnaire des partenariats liés au Streetwork et autres réseaux (m/f) L'administration communale se propose de recruter pour les besoins du Service dynamiquesse et intervention sociale, un éducateur gradué ou assistant social, dans le régime du salarié, à plein temps, sous contrat de travail à durée indéterminée et à rémunérer par analogie au groupe d'indemnité « A2 - sous-groupe éducatif et psycho-social » de l'employé communal. a) Conditions d'admissibilité : Les candidat(e)s doivent :être ressortissant d'un Etat membre de l'Union européenne tel que déterminé par la loi du décembre modifiant l'accès des ressortissants communautaires à la fonction publique luxembourgeoise ;faire preuve d'une connaissance adéquate des trois langues administratives (français, allemand et luxembourgeois) telles que définies par la loi modifiée du février sur le régime des langues ainsi que de la langue anglaise ;être détenteur d'un diplôme ou d'un certificat autorisant le/la titulaire à porter le titre d'assistant social ainsi que d'une autorisation à exercer cette profession au Luxembourg ou détenir un « Bachelor » en sciences sociales et éducatives ou similaire. Les diplômes d'études supérieures doivent être inscrits au registre des titres de formation prévu par la loi modifiée du octobre relative à la reconnaissance des qualifications professionnelles. b) Missions et tâches : Missions : Le titulaire assure le pilotage, la coordination et le développement du dispositif de Streetwork et des projets de travail social en milieu ouvert sur le territoire de la Ville de Luxembourg. Il/elle exerce un management transversal auprès des associations conventionnées, sans responsabilité hiérarchique directe, et veille à la cohérence des interventions, au respect des objectifs conventionnels, à la complémentarité des actions et à la qualité des partenariats. Il/elle constitue l'interlocuteur de référence entre la Ville de Luxembourg, les associations, les Streetworkers et les partenaires institutionnels. Tâches : 1. Pilotage et coordination du travail social en milieu ouvert Piloter et coordonner les projets de Streetwork et de travail social en milieu ouvert ;Mettre en réseau les acteurs et favoriser la coopération et le partage de bonnes pratiques entre les acteurs ;Veiller à la complémentarité des interventions et limiter les doublons entre les différents services;Accompagner les gestionnaires dans la réalisation des activités prévues par les projets ;Identifier les difficultés ou nouveaux besoins du Secteur, et proposer des réponses adaptées ;Assurer une veille sociale, légale et professionnelle susceptible d'avoir un impact sur les projets ;Identifier les besoins émergents et les dispositifs insuffisamment couverts ;Proposer l'adaptation ou la création de projets ;Développer de nouvelles collaborations ;Contribuer à la stratégie de la Ville en matier/ière de Streetwork, de travail social en milieu ouvert et de lutte contre le sans-abrisme. 2. Management transversal et animation du réseau Animer le réseau des gestionnaires et professionnels ;Organiser et modérer les réunions de coordination ;Définir les priorités avec les partenaires et assurer leur suivi ;Faciliter la circulation de l'information entre les différents acteurs concernés ;Favoriser le partage d'expériences et de bonnes pratiques ;Intervenir dans les situations de conflit ou de difficulté en assurant un rôle de médiation et de régulation ;Accompagner les partenaires dans l'adaptation de leurs pratiques aux besoins constatés sur le territoire de la Ville. 3. Suivi du dispositif Streetwork Assurer la coordination journalier/ière du dispositif ;Coordonner les gestionnaires des différentes associations impliquées dans le Streetwork ;Préparer et modérer la réunion mensuelle avec les institutions intervenant autour du Streetwork afin de partager les observations du terrain, les informations pertinentes et les difficultés rencontrées auprès de la population cible ;Rédiger, corriger et assurer le suivi des comptes rendus des réunions ;Organiser annuellement une formation continue de deux jours destinée aux Streetworkers afin de soutenir le développement et l'évolution du Streetwork sur le territoire de la Ville de Luxembourg; - Organiser, lorsque cela est nécessaire, des formations ou séances d'information portant sur des thématiques liées au travail de rue ;Rassembler et analyser les données annuelles relatives au Streetwork ;Elaborer le rapport annuel du Streetwork ;Assurer le suivi des problématiques identifiées sur le terrain avec les services compétents de la Ville de Luxembourg, notamment en matier/ière d'hygiène et de sécurité ;Rechercher, en collaboration avec les acteurs concernés, des solutions pour les situations individuelles complexes pour lesquelles les interventions de terrain n'ont...

jobs.title: Rakenna oma liiketoiminta Kotkassa
jobs.description: **Rakenna oma hoiva-alan liiketoiminta ja vaikuta paikallisesti - kannattavasti.**Kotona Asuen Seniorihoiva on muuttamassa ikääntymisen kasvot Suomessa. Jo vuodesta 2008 olemme mahdollistaneet ikäihmisille turvallisen ja mielekkään arjen omassa kodissaan asuen ja rakentaneet samalla mahdollisuuksia kannattavaan liiketoimintaan paikallisille franchiseyrittäjille.Etsimme nyt Kotkaan liiketoiminta- ja yrittäjähenkistä franchiseyrittäjää, joka haluaa:- Rakentaa, johtaa ja kehittää paikallista yritystä osana arvostettua ja pitkään toiminutta ketjua. - Tehdä ihmisläheistä työtä, jolla on konkreettinen ja myönteinen vaikutus omalla alueella. Hoiva-ala on tulevaisuuden ala, sillä senioreiden määrä Suomessa kasvaa nopeasti ja väestön ikärakenne on muuttumassa voimakkaasti. Yli 85-vuotiaiden määrä vähintään kaksinkertaistuu seuraavien parinkymmenen vuoden aikana, mikä lisää merkittävästi kotiin vietävien hoivapalvelujen tarvetta.**Mitä hoiva-alan franchiseyrittäjyys käytännössä on?**Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjänä vastaat oman alueesi liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta ja kannattavuudesta. Et tee hoivatyötä itse, vaan johdat ja rakennat tiimiäsi.Vastuualueeseesi kuuluu esimerkiksi:- Liiketoiminnan johtaminen ja kehittäminen. - Hoivanantajien rekrytointi ja perehdyttäminen. - Paikallinen myynti ja markkinointi. - Asiakassopimusten tekeminen ja asiakassuhteiden hoito. Saat tueksesi valmiiksi testatun konseptin, ketjun täyden osaamisen, tunnetun brändin ja jatkuvan tuen arjen johtamiseen.**Kenelle tämä sopii erityisesti?**Tämä yrittäjyys sopii sinulle, jos:- Sinulla on kokemusta myynnistä, markkinoinnista, johtamisesta, asiakkuuksista tai liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä, tai vähintään vahva halu ja kyky kehittyä näillä alueilla. - Sinua motivoi vastuu, vaikuttaminen ja oman työn tulokset. - Haluat rakentaa yritystoimintaa ja taloudellista pääomaa pitkäjänteisesti. - Arvostat merkityksellistä työtä, mutta ajattelet sitä myös liiketoiminnan näkökulmasta. - Elämäntilanteesi ja taloudellinen tilanteesi mahdollistaa yritystoiminnan käynnistämiseen Franchiseyrittäjämme tulevat hyvin erilaisista taustoista, ja ovat aiemmin toimineet esimerkiksi yrittäjinä, myynti-, asiantuntija- tai esihenkilötehtävissä.**Paikallinen vaikuttaminen on osa liiketoimintaa**Yrityksesi ei ole vain tuloslaskelma. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjänä:- Luot omalla alueellasi työpaikkoja. - Mahdollistat ikäihmisille arvokkaan arjen. - Rakennat luottamukseen perustuvaa palvelua. - Kasvatat liiketoimintaa, jolla on aidosti yhteiskunnallinen ja paikallinen merkitys. **Mitä tarjoamme franchiseyrittäjälle?**- Toimivan ja testatun konseptin. - Tunnetun ja arvostetun brändin. - Perusteellisen alkukoulutuksen ja jatkuvan tuen. - Valmiit markkinoinnin ja myynnin työkalut. - Toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän ja ketjun parhaat käytännöt. Olet vastuussa omasta menestyksestäsi, mutta et ole yksin. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjyys on pitkäjänteinen tapa rakentaa menestyvää liiketoimintaa ja tulevaisuutta.**Kiinnostuitko? Selvitetään yhdessä, sopiiko franchiseyrittäjyys sinulle. Ota yhteyttä ja sovitaan alkukeskustelu.**Tämä voi olla ensimmäinen askel kohti omaa liiketoimintaa, jolla on sekä merkitystä että kasvupotentiaalia.

jobs.title: 1.assistent til rengøringsteam SMP - Nordjylland
jobs.description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til vores rengørings-team i Nordjylland.

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team i Nordjylland.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør.

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Er humoristisk anlagt og kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Nordjylland”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 20.11.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

jobs.title: Rakenna oma liiketoiminta Raumalla
jobs.description: **Rakenna oma hoiva-alan liiketoiminta ja vaikuta paikallisesti - kannattavasti.**Kotona Asuen Seniorihoiva on muuttamassa ikääntymisen kasvot Suomessa. Jo vuodesta 2008 olemme mahdollistaneet ikäihmisille turvallisen ja mielekkään arjen omassa kodissaan asuen ja rakentaneet samalla mahdollisuuksia kannattavaan liiketoimintaan paikallisille franchiseyrittäjille.Etsimme nyt Raumalle liiketoiminta- ja yrittäjähenkistä franchiseyrittäjää, joka haluaa:- Rakentaa, johtaa ja kehittää paikallista yritystä osana arvostettua ja pitkään toiminutta ketjua. - Tehdä ihmisläheistä työtä, jolla on konkreettinen ja myönteinen vaikutus omalla alueella. Hoiva-ala on tulevaisuuden ala, sillä senioreiden määrä Suomessa kasvaa nopeasti ja väestön ikärakenne on muuttumassa voimakkaasti. Yli 85-vuotiaiden määrä vähintään kaksinkertaistuu seuraavien parinkymmenen vuoden aikana, mikä lisää merkittävästi kotiin vietävien hoivapalvelujen tarvetta.**Mitä hoiva-alan franchiseyrittäjyys käytännössä on?**Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjänä vastaat oman alueesi liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta ja kannattavuudesta. Et tee hoivatyötä itse, vaan johdat ja rakennat tiimiäsi.Vastuualueeseesi kuuluu esimerkiksi:- Liiketoiminnan johtaminen ja kehittäminen. - Hoivanantajien rekrytointi ja perehdyttäminen. - Paikallinen myynti ja markkinointi. - Asiakassopimusten tekeminen ja asiakassuhteiden hoito. Saat tueksesi valmiiksi testatun konseptin, ketjun täyden osaamisen, tunnetun brändin ja jatkuvan tuen arjen johtamiseen.**Kenelle tämä sopii erityisesti?**Tämä yrittäjyys sopii sinulle, jos:- Sinulla on kokemusta myynnistä, markkinoinnista, johtamisesta, asiakkuuksista tai liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä, tai vähintään vahva halu ja kyky kehittyä näillä alueilla. - Sinua motivoi vastuu, vaikuttaminen ja oman työn tulokset. - Haluat rakentaa yritystoimintaa ja taloudellista pääomaa pitkäjänteisesti. - Arvostat merkityksellistä työtä, mutta ajattelet sitä myös liiketoiminnan näkökulmasta. - Elämäntilanteesi ja taloudellinen tilanteesi mahdollistaa yritystoiminnan käynnistämiseen Franchiseyrittäjämme tulevat hyvin erilaisista taustoista, ja ovat aiemmin toimineet esimerkiksi yrittäjinä, myynti-, asiantuntija- tai esihenkilötehtävissä.**Paikallinen vaikuttaminen on osa liiketoimintaa**Yrityksesi ei ole vain tuloslaskelma. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjänä:- Luot omalla alueellasi työpaikkoja. - Mahdollistat ikäihmisille arvokkaan arjen. - Rakennat luottamukseen perustuvaa palvelua. - Kasvatat liiketoimintaa, jolla on aidosti yhteiskunnallinen ja paikallinen merkitys. **Mitä tarjoamme franchiseyrittäjälle?**- Toimivan ja testatun konseptin. - Tunnetun ja arvostetun brändin. - Perusteellisen alkukoulutuksen ja jatkuvan tuen. - Valmiit markkinoinnin ja myynnin työkalut. - Toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän ja ketjun parhaat käytännöt. Olet vastuussa omasta menestyksestäsi, mutta et ole yksin. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjyys on pitkäjänteinen tapa rakentaa menestyvää liiketoimintaa ja tulevaisuutta.**Kiinnostuitko? Selvitetään yhdessä, sopiiko franchiseyrittäjyys sinulle. Ota yhteyttä ja sovitaan alkukeskustelu.**Tämä voi olla ensimmäinen askel kohti omaa liiketoimintaa, jolla on sekä merkitystä että kasvupotentiaalia.

Jo vuodesta 2008 olemme mahdollistaneet ikäihmisille turvallisen ja mielekkään arjen omassa kodissaan asuen ja rakentaneet samalla mahdollisuuksia kannattavaan liiketoimintaan paikallisille franchiseyrittäjille.Etsimme nyt Lappeenrantaan liiketoiminta- ja yrittäjähenkistä franchiseyrittäjää, joka haluaa:- Rakentaa, johtaa ja kehittää paikallista yritystä osana arvostettua ja pitkään toiminutta ketjua. - Tehdä ihmisläheistä työtä, jolla on konkreettinen ja myönteinen vaikutus omalla alueella. Hoiva-ala on tulevaisuuden ala, sillä senioreiden määrä Suomessa kasvaa nopeasti ja väestön ikärakenne on muuttumassa voimakkaasti. Yli 85-vuotiaiden määrä vähintään kaksinkertaistuu seuraavien parinkymmenen vuoden aikana, mikä lisää merkittävästi kotiin vietävien hoivapalvelujen tarvetta.**Mitä hoiva-alan franchiseyrittäjyys käytännössä on?**Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjänä vastaat oman alueesi liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta ja kannattavuudesta. Et tee hoivatyötä itse, vaan johdat ja rakennat tiimiäsi.Vastuualueeseesi kuuluu esimerkiksi:- Liiketoiminnan johtaminen ja kehittäminen. - Hoivanantajien rekrytointi ja perehdyttäminen. - Paikallinen myynti ja markkinointi. - Asiakassopimusten tekeminen ja asiakassuhteiden hoito. Saat tueksesi valmiiksi testatun konseptin, ketjun täyden osaamisen, tunnetun brändin ja jatkuvan tuen arjen johtamiseen.**Kenelle tämä sopii erityisesti?**Tämä yrittäjyys sopii sinulle, jos:- Sinulla on kokemusta myynnistä, markkinoinnista, johtamisesta, asiakkuuksista tai liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä, tai vähintään vahva halu ja kyky kehittyä näillä alueilla. - Sinua motivoi vastuu, vaikuttaminen ja oman työn tulokset. - Haluat rakentaa yritystoimintaa ja taloudellista pääomaa pitkäjänteisesti. - Arvostat merkityksellistä työtä, mutta ajattelet sitä myös liiketoiminnan näkökulmasta. - Elämäntilanteesi ja taloudellinen tilanteesi mahdollistaa yritystoiminnan käynnistämiseen Franchiseyrittäjämme tulevat hyvin erilaisista taustoista, ja ovat aiemmin toimineet esimerkiksi yrittäjinä, myynti-, asiantuntija- tai esihenkilötehtävissä.**Paikallinen vaikuttaminen on osa liiketoimintaa**Yrityksesi ei ole vain tuloslaskelma. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjänä:- Luot omalla alueellasi työpaikkoja. - Mahdollistat ikäihmisille arvokkaan arjen. - Rakennat luottamukseen perustuvaa palvelua. - Kasvatat liiketoimintaa, jolla on aidosti yhteiskunnallinen ja paikallinen merkitys. **Mitä tarjoamme franchiseyrittäjälle?**- Toimivan ja testatun konseptin. - Tunnetun ja arvostetun brändin. - Perusteellisen alkukoulutuksen ja jatkuvan tuen. - Valmiit markkinoinnin ja myynnin työkalut. - Toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän ja ketjun parhaat käytännöt. Olet vastuussa omasta menestyksestäsi, mutta et ole yksin. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjyys on pitkäjänteinen tapa rakentaa menestyvää liiketoimintaa ja tulevaisuutta.**Kiinnostuitko? Selvitetään yhdessä, sopiiko franchiseyrittäjyys sinulle. Ota yhteyttä ja sovitaan alkukeskustelu.**Tämä voi olla ensimmäinen askel kohti omaa liiketoimintaa, jolla on sekä merkitystä että kasvupotentiaalia.

Il aide ses clients à mener leur transformation digitale et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables. Le Groupe apporte une réponse globale aux enjeux de compétitivité des grandes entreprises et organisations, combinant une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d'activité et des technologies innovantes à une approche résolument collaborative.Sopra Steria place l'humain au centre de son action et s'engage auprès de ses clients à tirer le meilleur parti du digital pour construire un avenir positif. Jo vuodesta 2008 olemme mahdollistaneet ikäihmisille turvallisen ja mielekkään arjen omassa kodissaan asuen ja rakentaneet samalla mahdollisuuksia kannattavaan liiketoimintaan paikallisille franchiseyrittäjille.Etsimme nyt Rovaniemelle liiketoiminta- ja yrittäjähenkistä franchiseyrittäjää, joka haluaa:- Rakentaa, johtaa ja kehittää paikallista yritystä osana arvostettua ja pitkään toiminutta ketjua. - Tehdä ihmisläheistä työtä, jolla on konkreettinen ja myönteinen vaikutus omalla alueella. Hoiva-ala on tulevaisuuden ala, sillä senioreiden määrä Suomessa kasvaa nopeasti ja väestön ikärakenne on muuttumassa voimakkaasti. Yli 85-vuotiaiden määrä vähintään kaksinkertaistuu seuraavien parinkymmenen vuoden aikana, mikä lisää merkittävästi kotiin vietävien hoivapalvelujen tarvetta.**Mitä hoiva-alan franchiseyrittäjyys käytännössä on?**Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjänä vastaat oman alueesi liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta ja kannattavuudesta. Et tee hoivatyötä itse, vaan johdat ja rakennat tiimiäsi.Vastuualueeseesi kuuluu esimerkiksi:- Liiketoiminnan johtaminen ja kehittäminen. - Hoivanantajien rekrytointi ja perehdyttäminen. - Paikallinen myynti ja markkinointi. - Asiakassopimusten tekeminen ja asiakassuhteiden hoito. Saat tueksesi valmiiksi testatun konseptin, ketjun täyden osaamisen, tunnetun brändin ja jatkuvan tuen arjen johtamiseen.**Kenelle tämä sopii erityisesti?**Tämä yrittäjyys sopii sinulle, jos:- Sinulla on kokemusta myynnistä, markkinoinnista, johtamisesta, asiakkuuksista tai liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä, tai vähintään vahva halu ja kyky kehittyä näillä alueilla. - Sinua motivoi vastuu, vaikuttaminen ja oman työn tulokset. - Haluat rakentaa yritystoimintaa ja taloudellista pääomaa pitkäjänteisesti. - Arvostat merkityksellistä työtä, mutta ajattelet sitä myös liiketoiminnan näkökulmasta. - Elämäntilanteesi ja taloudellinen tilanteesi mahdollistaa yritystoiminnan käynnistämiseen Franchiseyrittäjämme tulevat hyvin erilaisista taustoista, ja ovat aiemmin toimineet esimerkiksi yrittäjinä, myynti-, asiantuntija- tai esihenkilötehtävissä.**Paikallinen vaikuttaminen on osa liiketoimintaa**Yrityksesi ei ole vain tuloslaskelma. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjänä:- Luot omalla alueellasi työpaikkoja. - Mahdollistat ikäihmisille arvokkaan arjen. - Rakennat luottamukseen perustuvaa palvelua. - Kasvatat liiketoimintaa, jolla on aidosti yhteiskunnallinen ja paikallinen merkitys. **Mitä tarjoamme franchiseyrittäjälle?**- Toimivan ja testatun konseptin. - Tunnetun ja arvostetun brändin. - Perusteellisen alkukoulutuksen ja jatkuvan tuen. - Valmiit markkinoinnin ja myynnin työkalut. - Toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän ja ketjun parhaat käytännöt. Olet vastuussa omasta menestyksestäsi, mutta et ole yksin. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjyys on pitkäjänteinen tapa rakentaa menestyvää liiketoimintaa ja tulevaisuutta.**Kiinnostuitko? Selvitetään yhdessä, sopiiko franchiseyrittäjyys sinulle. Ota yhteyttä ja sovitaan alkukeskustelu.**Tämä voi olla ensimmäinen askel kohti omaa liiketoimintaa, jolla on sekä merkitystä että kasvupotentiaalia.

jobs.title: SAP Functional Expert –Order Management (SAP OTC / SD)
jobs.description: Sandvik is a global, high-tech engineering group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability, and sustainability for the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. We are at the forefront of digitalization and focus on optimizing our customers processes. Our world-leading offering includes equipment, tools, services and digital solutions for machining, mining, rock excavation, and rock processing. In 2025, the group had approximately 42.000 employees, sales in more than 150 countries and revenues of about SEK 121 billion.Our Sandvik Mining Enterprice Technology IT Delivery organization supports end to end business processes with solutions by providing solution design & architecture, project implementation, and service operations.IT Delivery organization within Sandvik Mining supports end-to-end business processes with solutions by providing solution design & architecture, project implementation and service operations.We are now looking for SAP OM Functional Expert. The position is permanent and preferred location is Tampere, Finland, where several key business stakeholders and Sandvik divisions are located.Your MissionSAP OM Functional Expert works closely with internal business stakeholders on SAP Order Management business processes ensuring the system is fully utilized, and SAP best practises are followed. In this role you will be leading requirements gathering, workshops, development of functional design. You work collaboratively with other functional experts and business and technical teams to define solutions and business process in SAP S/4 HANA. You will play a critical role in ensuring the business requirements are fully understood and that solutions meet business expectations.You will also support the BAU change processes of live sites and play a leading role in ongoing transformation projects leveraging S/4HANA. You will have an opportunity to participate in upcoming global SAP implementation initiatives and large-scale business transformation programs.You should have 8+ years of experience in similar roles, demonstrating a solid understanding of order management, logistics, and trade compliance processes.What can you bring to our team? We are looking for an experienced SAP Order Management professional who thrives at the intersection of business processes, solution design, and technology.To succeed in this role, you have hands-on experience with SAP Order-to-Cash processes, particularly within Sales & Distribution (SD), and have participated in SAP implementation and transformation projects. Experience with SAP S/4HANA is essential, while knowledge of Advanced ATP, Supply Assignment (ARun), Supply Protection, BOP, or SAP GTS is an advantage.You are comfortable working independently in a global environment and can confidently gather requirements, challenge assumptions, and recommend practical solutions to business stakeholders. You combine strong analytical skills with the ability to communicate complex SAP topics clearly.We value professionals who take ownership, collaborate effectively, and proactively seek support when needed. Experience working with distributed teams and guiding developers is highly appreciated.Your main responsibilities· Enable Order Management S/4 HANA transformation with ongoing and future SAP S/4HANA deployments.· Lead requirements gathering and validation activities through workshops with business process owners and business analysts· Perform fit/gap analysis and create related functional documentation to provide the business with overview of options and provide recommendations for the best fit for the business· Develop functional specifications for customizations and enhancements which include reports, data migration and integrations· Transform business requirements into solution designs based on best practices to ensure the business is fully utilizing SAP S/4HANA functionality· Providing training and advice on best practices· Ensure documentation is prepared and maintained according to best practice· Support business teams during the creation of user test stories and provide functional support during business acceptance testing· Work closely with the Project Management team preparing status reports etc. with regards to the ongoing projects· Time-to-time travel is required to meet our stakeholders in our sales areas and in our production units around the globe.Key qualifications· SAP SD / Order-to-Cash expertise· Experience in SAP implementation and transformation projects· Ability to create and maintain functional design specifications, translate business needs into SAP solutions, and support configuration and implementation activities.· Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP solutions.· Strong analytical mindset with the ability to evaluate business requirements, prioritize solutions, and make recommendations in complex environments.· Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities· Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams and offshore development teams.· Bachelors or Masters degree in IT, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related fields· Fluent English language skills· Finnish language skills are beneficial but not required.Experience in manufacturing or supply chain environments is considered an advantage.Sandvik will offer you - A glimpse of our cultureSandvik will offer an opportunity for you to influence and structure our organization with new and innovative ways of working, good perks, flexible hybrid work, and an opportunity to continuously learn with a good work-life balance. Company has a truly international environment with great opportunities for your professional development and growth.We have an inclusive company culture where our values are Curiosity, Responsibility, Customer Focus, and Winning together. We believe in an inclusive, equal, and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results.We believe in finding a perfect mix between work, family life and interests, and we happily support our employees in balancing this. jobs.title: Ingénieur(e) développement logiciel - Backend - Sécurité - Login (f/m/d) H/F
jobs.description: Ingénieur(e) développement logiciel - Backend - Sécurité - Login (f/m/d) L'équipe Login est le pilier de l'écosystème Decathlon. Composée de profils passionnés et multiculturels, notre équipe d'une dizaine de personnes construit une solution d'authentification sécurisée et haute performance pour plus de 80 pays. Notre ambition ? Offrir une expérience membre fluide via un point d'entrée unique et hautement sécurisé. Notre défi actuel est de taille : mener une migration d'architecture d'envergure internationale depuis notre système Spring Security 5 vers Spring Security 7. Rejoins une équipe de passionné-es au cœur des enjeux globaux de Decathlon !TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTIONLa mission principale est d'accompagner la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités et l'amélioration de jobs.title: Restaurant Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 

Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description - Restaurant Manager –Indian Dining Experience

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on Restaurant Manager to take full ownership of our service. If you have a passion for authentic Indian cuisine and the drive to build a high-performance culture, we will look forward to welcome you to lead our team.

This is not a back-office role. We are looking for a visible leader who thrives on the floor, inspires the team, and ensures every guest leaves with a memorable experience.

Responsibilities:

Service ownership: Take complete charge of the dining room, ensuring service personnel are attentive, aligned, and delivering our high-quality service standards.

Team Leadership: Build a high-performance culture through hands-on training, onboarding, and continuous development of the service team.

Guest Experience: Actively engage with diners, capture valuable feedback, and guarantee ultimate guest satisfaction.

Operations & Standards: Hands-on maintenance of high-quality hygiene and take full control of FOH supplies, inventory, and stock.

Digital Presence: Manage our social media channels to showcase our vibrant dishes, culture, and events.

Who We Are Looking For:

· Experience: 3–4 years of proven leadership experience in the hospitality industry is essential.

· Cuisine Expertise: Deep knowledge of Indian cuisine is essential; prior management experience in an Indian restaurant is highly preferred.

· Language: High-level fluency in English.

· Personality & Presence: Outgoing, hardworking, and naturally hospitable. You bring a "service with a smile" mentality and project a welcoming, highly professional presence on the floor.

· Bonus Skills: Hands-on experience with beverage pairing, craft cocktails, and premium coffee making will give you a significant advantage.

What We Offer:

· A highly competitive salary.

· Autonomy to shape the service culture and FOH operations.

· A vibrant, fast-paced work environment with a passionate team.

· Opportunities for long-term career growth.

Ready to lead our service?

Please send your CV (including a professional headshot) and a cover letter describing your experience and motivation to info@tandooritwist.dk.

jobs.title: Arbejd med fødevaresikkerhed: Bliv tilsynstekniker i Kødkontrollen ved Tican i Brørup
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at højne fødevaresikkerheden i Danmark, så er der mulighed for at blive en del af et fagligt dygtigt team ved Fødevarestyrelsens Kødkontrol ved Tican Fresh Meat A/S i Brørup. Om jobbet Som tilsynstekniker er din primære opgave post mortem-kontrol af slagtesvin. Kontrollen foregår som båndkontrol, hvor der i øjeblikket slagtes på én linje med en hastighed af 760 enheder i timen på både daghold og aftenhold. Foruden din primære opgave, vil du også kunne beskæftige dig med;
  • Andre tilsynsopgaver og prøveudtagning.
  • Diverse praktiske opgaver, som hører med til afdelingens dagligdag.
  • Deltagelse i afdelingsmøder, teammøder og interne kurser.
Om dig Vi leder efter dig, der er uddannet tilsynstekniker og som befinder sig godt i rollen som myndighedsperson. Vi ønsker os tilmed en kollega, som bidrager med godt humør, er fleksibel, hjælpsom og har gode samarbejdsevner. Vi lægger vægt på, at du;
  • Er fagligt interesseret og omhyggelig i dit arbejde
  • Er indstillet på at kompetenceudvikle dig, når der sker ændringer i regler og procedurer
  • Er klar til at give og modtage konstruktiv feedback, så vi sammen kan nå vores mål om at udvikle den bedste kødkontrol
  • Kan kommunikere på dansk
  • Har grundlæggende IT-kundskaber
Om os Styrelsen for Fødevarer, Landbrug og Fiskeri er en statslig organisation med stor samfundsmæssig betydning. Vi arbejder for, at fødevarer er sikre, og at dyr behandles forsvarligt. Kødkontrollen kontrollerer alle slagtedyr på danske slagterier og har fokus på smitsomme sygdomme, dyrevelfærd og fødevaresikkerhed. I vores sektion er vi ca. 48 medarbejdere – vi er dyrlæger, tilsynsteknikere, administrativt personale, elever, timelønnede og 1 sektionsleder. Vi spænder bredt i aldersfordeling og erfaringsgrundlag, og vi ser det som en styrke at få vores forskellige kompetencer i spil, så vi i fællesskab kan løse kerneopgaven. Vi har et kontinuerligt fokus på at optimere kvaliteten af kontrollen samtidig med, at vi er tilpasningsklar som følge af, at vi er en politisk styret organisation. Det praktiske Der er tale om faste fuldtidsstillinger på 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Ansættelsesområdet er Fødevarestyrelsen. Tjenestestedet er Kødkontrollen ved Tican Fresh Meat A/S i Brørup, Markedsvej 9, 6650 Brørup. Virksomheden slagter både dag og aften og arbejdstiden i Kødkontrollen er derfor på daghold fra kl. 6.00 til kl. 14.00 mens arbejdstiden på aftenholdet er fra kl. 14.00 til kl. 21.15. Vi roterer mellem dag- og aftenhold, således at man hver anden uge arbejder aftenhold og tilsvarende hver anden uge arbejder daghold. Ansættelsen sker efter gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer samt organisationsaftale for tilsynsfunktionærer ved eksportautoriserede slagterier. Til tilsynsfunktionærer, der har gennemført uddannelsen som tilsynstekniker, gives et pensionsgivende teknikertillæg på 3.948 kr. pr. måned. Herudover indplaceres tilsynsteknikere på en basisløn på enten 27.972 kr. pr. måned (1. og 2. år) eller 28.389 kr. pr. måned (3. og følgende år). Herudover vil det være muligt at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg alt efter den enkeltes kvalifikationer i relation til stillingen. Pensionsbidraget for tilsynsfunktionærer udgør 13,68 %. Sådan kontakter du os og søger stillingen Vi glæder os til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning, CV, kopi af eksamensbevis og eventuelle andre relevante bilag senest den 23. november 2026. Du søger stillingen ved at sende en mail til kkhr@fvst.dk med emnefeltet: ”Ansøgning til stillingen som tilsynstekniker i Brørup”. Du opfordres til at læse mere om Fødevarestyrelsen på www.fvst.dk. Fødevarestyrelsen betragter mangfoldighed som et aktiv og opfordrer alle uanset baggrund til at søge.

jobs.title: DIAS Professor in Clinical Translational Psychiatry and Centre Leader for the Elite Centre for Clinical and Translational Psychiatry at Odense University Hospital and the University of Southern Denmark
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS), the Department of Clinical Research at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and the Region of Southern Denmark seek an outstanding candidate to fill a fully tenured Professor position in the field of clinical translational psychiatry. The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

We seek an exceptional researcher with demonstrated excellence in their discipline and a proven ability to push boundaries, challenge conventions, and engage in groundbreaking interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to cutting-edge advancements in their field while fostering collaboration across disciplines, embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven research. The ideal candidate will have a strong international research profile, an outstanding record of attracting competitive research funding, and a demonstrated ability to conduct interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research, DIAS, and the Region, and must be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU and in the Region of Southern Denmark. 

What we offer

  • The opportunity to lead a new elite centre for clinical and translational psychiatry, with five-year funding of DKK 17 million (equivalent to Euro 2.3 million), with the potential for a five-year extension.

  • A strong interdisciplinary research environment through DIAS, comprising leading academics across medicine, science, and the humanities, with the opportunity to collaborate with outstanding researchers across SDU’s five faculties.

  • Access to state-of-the-art research facilities at the newly built Odense University Hospital (OUH), where psychiatry and somatic care are integrated to foster collaboration between these fields.

  • Comprehensive research support services from DIAS and SDU, targeting prestigious funding such as DNRF, ERC, and grants from Danish private foundations.

  • If recruited from abroad or from industry, the candidate will be eligible for a fast-track DKK 11 million  (equivalent to Euro 1.5 million ) Lundbeck Foundation Start-Up grant.

  • Reduced teaching obligations compared to a standard professorship, allowing the candidate to focus on research and leadership within the elite centre.

Who we are looking for 

We are seeking a highly accomplished researcher with expertise in the field of clinical translational psychiatry, who is eager to engage in collaborative activities within the DIAS framework. 

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

  • A record of internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Publications in high-level peer-reviewed academic journals and leading innovative research programmes in clinical psychiatry. 

  • An ability to attract significant external funding to support independent and collaborative research initiatives.

  • Engagement in the international academic society. 

  • Extensive experience in building and leading multidisciplinary research teams that integrate basic and clinical sciences, with an emphasis on translational research spanning from laboratory findings to clinical trials.

  • A research focus in areas such as child and adolescent psychiatry, clinical psychopharmacology, epidemiology, molecular neurobiology, substance use disorders, or serious mental illness.

  • The ability to develop a translational research programme in one or more of the mentioned fields, with a focus on building cooperative, multidisciplinary teams that bridge basic science and the design and execution of early-phase clinical trials.

  • A demonstrated commitment to mentorship, teaching, and leadership, fostering the next generation of researchers in interdisciplinary research environments.

  • Experience at Full or Associate Professor level within relevant fields.

  • Fluency in English

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, mentor DIAS fellows, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.  

The Department of Clinical Research

The Department of Clinical Research does translational research spanning from basic research to patient care, within both somatics and psychiatry. The interdisciplinary research aims to improve patient treatment, health, and well-being. Researchers at the institute often have joint appointments between clinic, research, and education, ensuring a strong academic foundation for the research at Odense University Hospital (OUH) and in psychiatry. The researchers at the Department of Clinical Research primarily consist of doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals with main employment at OUH.

The Centre for Clinical and Translational PsychiatryThe centre will be based at the new Odense University Hospital, which integrates psychiatric and somatic care to promote close collaboration between the fields. The hospital includes a state-of-the-art adult psychiatric department with around 600 employees, 142 single rooms, and specialized sections for joint somatic-psychiatric care, rehabilitation, telepsychiatry, and more. The child and adolescent psychiatric department cover the entire region with about 600 employees, two inpatient wards with a total of 34 beds, and outpatient clinics at four geographical sites.The centre’s aim is to advance novel psychiatric research through innovative approaches that will significantly impact future patient care. This includes translating discoveries from the laboratory to clinical settings, whether within narrow clinical fields or through broader cross-disciplinary collaborations that involve various clinical functions, professions, and institutions.

Additional informationFor further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk For further information and questions about the position, please contact the Head of the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen at +456550 3477 or via email at rllarsen@health.sdu.dk or Medical Director Bjarne Dahler-Eriksen, Odense University Hospital, at +4523284068 or via email at bde@rsyd.dk. You may also contact the Vice Dean for Research and Innovation at the Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU, Uffe Holmskov at +45 6550 3775 or via email at uholmskov@health.sdu.dk regarding the position.

Application, salary, and employment terms

This position will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research in Odense. The successful candidate will be expected to regularly engage in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense. 

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

For more details on salary and taxation, please refer to the provided links about salary and taxation.

Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

Application requirements

Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply now" link provided below.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

The application must include the following:

  • A motivation letter.

  • A detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV), including contacts for possible references.

  • Copies of relevant certificates/diplomas.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing previous teaching experience.

  • A complete list of publications, highlighting those most relevant to the position.

  • Up to ten of the most relevant publications

  • A research and publication plan for the next five years, including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

Submission guidelines

Applications that are incomplete with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed by the committee. Shortlisting and tests may be used in the recruitment process and references may be obtained.  

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit the websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you will find information and facts about moving to, working, and living in Denmark.

SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.Equal opportunity employment

The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

jobs.title: Revenue Cycle Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health.

Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today.

By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth.

We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company.

Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B.

We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where".

Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare.

Role overview

Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution.

What Youâll Do

  • Manage and support RCM specialists working across home health revenue cycle workflows.

  • Track attendance and monitor individual and team performance against established KPIs and daily quotas.

  • Review workflow boards throughout the day to spot backlogs, red flags, and specialists at risk of missing their end-of-day quotas.

  • Respond promptly to specialist questions while balancing real-time workflow monitoring and other team needs.

  • Identify process gaps and work with the team to resolve issues affecting daily performance.

  • Apply your home health and Homecare Homebase (HCHB) knowledge to help specialists navigate workflows and resolve operational questions.

Accounts receivable and collections

  • Guide specialists and team leads in prioritizing assigned commercial, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage receivables, including aged balances, payer responses, rejections, denials, and upcoming filing or appeal deadlines.

  • Oversee claim follow-up through resolution: verify claim status and payment, investigate collection barriers and underpayments, and guide appropriate corrections, reprocessing, reconsiderations, or appeals under payer-specific requirements.

  • Review and respond to escalations when a specialist cannot determine the next action; surface recurring payer, workflow, or system issues to leadership and coordinate their resolution.

  • Ensure claim activity, supporting evidence, next actions, and follow-up dates are documented accurately in the applicable AR workflow and HCHB.

  • Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution.

  • Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process.

Quality and team development

  • Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance.

  • Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues.

  • Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong experience in home health revenue cycle operations.

  • Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB).

  • Experience managing RCM specialists, including tracking attendance and performance KPIs.

  • Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets.

  • Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve.

  • Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements.

  • Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams.

  • Ability to respond promptly to team questions while managing multiple priorities.

  • Ability to identify workflow or process gaps and help the team address them.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing distributed or offshore revenue cycle teams.

  • Familiarity with commercial fee-for-service and Medicare or Medicare Advantage home health claims, including episodic/PDGM workflows.

  • Experience with AR dashboards, clearinghouses, and payer portals such as Waystar and Availity.

  • Experience using denial trends, quality reviews, or operational data to improve collections workflows and team training.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary

  • Comprehensive health insurance, dental, and commuter benefits

  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer contribution

  • Opportunity for growth in a fast-growing company

  • Collaborative team valuing innovation and problem-solving

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

The role

Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

  • Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

  • Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

  • Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

  • Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

  • Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

  • Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

  • Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

  • Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

  • Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

  • Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

  • Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

Your background

You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:

  • A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

  • Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

  • Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

  • A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

  • A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

  • Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦

  • Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires;

  • Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows;

  • Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them.

  • Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive.

  • Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability.

KPIs & Success Measures

We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output:

  • Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow adoption (lead): percentage of monthly active users who run a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow run growth: month-on-month percentage growth in workflow runs. Target [TBD]%.

  • First workflow conversion: percentage of new users who complete a successful run within their first [TBD] days.

  • Share of generations through workflows: percentage of all generations produced by workflow runs.

  • Agent and human collaboration: percentage of workflow runs built or started by Scribble.

  • Connector adoption: percentage of active workspaces that use at least one third-party connection in a workflow each month. Target [TBD]%.

  • Integration usage: percentage of workflow runs that start from, or deliver to, a third-party connection. Target [TBD]%.

  • Reliability (hygiene bar): percentage of runs that complete without manual intervention, held at or above [TBD]%.

  • Learning velocity (supporting): percentage of launches reviewed after release against their stated hypothesis. Target 100%.

Benefits

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for our UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We're called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group's mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco ItaÃº, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of PokÃ©mon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund).

The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. It was named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies 2021 by Fast Company, and by CB Insights as one of the World's Most Valuable Private Unicorns.

https://www.thebrandtechgroup.com

Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

Our Technology Stack

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Finance Manager (Corporate Finance)
AI Developer
jobs.description:
Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on AI Developer to help build it.

Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role.

You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work.

Key Responsibilities

AI / LLM Engineering (core focus)

  • Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality.
  • Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources.
  • Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features.
  • Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs.
  • Grow into model optimization over time: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, and offline/air-gapped deployments.

DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting)

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used).
  • Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker.
  • Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting.
  • Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.
  • Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers).
  • 3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling.
  • Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have).
  • Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus.
  • DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).
  • Strong problem-solving & communication with a root-cause troubleshooting mindset, self-directed learning, strong ownership, and seamless remote/distributed team collaboration.

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has a very successful "land and expand" business model; our customers start using Notion for free, upgrade over time as they expand their teams, and embrace increasingly sophisticated use cases. Often, these users and champions are different than the person who has enterprise purchasing authority.



The Demand Generation team serves as a dot-connecter across sales, marketing, and operation teams to identify, engage, and convert decision makers at our target mid market and enterprise companies.



In this role, you will partner with demand generation teammates and sales stakeholders to ideate and execute in-person events, designed to help open, accelerate, and close business.



As a Field Marketing Manager, you will own and execute field events that are Notion-hosted, third party, co-partnered, and ancillary to third party events. This strategic position focuses on driving pipeline that meaningfully contribute to Notion's bottom line.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Delight Notion customers and prospects, with a guest-first approach to creating field events and experiences that bring the Notion brand and product to life.

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners.

 - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition.

 - Leverage quantitative and qualitative insights to make recommendations on how we invest in field events to drive incremental business impact.

 - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts

 - Partner with our Operation and BizTech teams to manage and better utilize our go-to-market systems




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8-12+ years of related marketing experience.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory.

 - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking.

 - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it.

 - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment

 - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses

 - Salesforce, Marketo experience



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $175,000-$200,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.
