jobs.description: HOW TO APPLY? PLEASE SEND YOUR CV TO: EURES.SELECCIO.SOC@GENCAT.CAT REFERENCE: SKI LIFT OPERATOR IF YOU ARE ATTENTIVE, RESPONSIBLE, STRONGLY CUSTOMER-SERVICE AND SAFETY-ORIENTED, AND LOOKING FOR A ROLE ENSURING SMOOTH, COMFORTABLE, AND SAFE ACCESS FOR OUR GUESTS ACROSS THE ENTIRE SKI RESORT, WE WANT TO MEET YOU! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: BOARDING AND UNLOADING ASSISTANCE: HELP SKIERS AND SNOWBOARDERS SAFELY BOARD AND UNLOAD FROM CHAIRLIFTS, GONDOLAS, OR SURFACE LIFTS, PAYING SPECIAL ATTENTION TO CHILDREN, BEGINNERS, AND INDIVIDUALS WITH REDUCED MOBILITY. ACCESS AND QUEUE CONTROL: VERIFY THAT GUESTS ACCESS LIFTS WITH A VALID SKI PASS AND MANAGE WAITING AREAS IN AN ORDERLY, SMOOTH, AND FRIENDLY MANNER. BASIC OPERATIONAL SAFETY: MONITOR THE OPERATION OF THE ASSIGNED LIFT FROM THE CONTROL BOOTH OR PLATFORM, EXECUTING EMERGENCY STOPS OR SPEED ADJUSTMENTS WHENEVER NECESSARY. SITE MAINTENANCE: CLEAR SNOW AND ICE FROM LOADING AND UNLOADING RAMPS, ENSURING THAT PLATFORMS REMAIN LEVEL, SAFE, AND OBSTACLE-FREE THROUGHOUT THE OPERATING DAY. INTERNAL COORDINATION: PROMPTLY REPORT ANY DETECTED MECHANICAL ANOMALIES TO THE TECHNICAL TEAM OR CENTRAL DISPATCH, AND COLLABORATE WITH THE SKI PATROL TEAM DURING WEATHER OR SAFETY INCIDENTS. CANDIDATE PROFILE: EDUCATION: HIGH SCHOOL DIPLOMA OR EQUIVALENT QUALIFICATION, BASIC KNOWLEDGE OF OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH AND SAFETY IS A PLUS. EXPERIENCE: PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE IN CUSTOMER SERVICE, TOURISM, OR OUTDOOR PHYSICAL WORK IS APPRECIATED (PRIOR SKI LIFT EXPERIENCE IS NOT REQUIRED, AS ROLE-SPECIFIC TRAINING WILL BE PROVIDED). LANGUAGES: FLUENT SPANISH, KNOWLEDGE OF CATALAN, FRENCH, OR ENGLISH IS A PLUS FOR INTERACTING WITH LOCAL AND INTERNATIONAL GUESTS. KEY STRENGTHS: STRONG FOCUS AND SENSE OF RESPONSIBILITY, A FRIENDLY AND EMPATHETIC ATTITUDE, EASE IN OPERATING BASIC CONTROL PANELS AND MANUAL TOOLS, GOOD PHYSICAL FITNESS, AND A WILLINGNESS TO WORK OUTDOORS UNDER CHANGING HIGH-MOUNTAIN WEATHER CONDITIONS. jobs.title: Job i udlandet - Job på Cypern - Gaming supporter - Betalt bolig de første 2 måneder.
jobs.description:
Vi søger engagerede gaming eksperter til vores danske gaming support‑team hos en international virksomhed på Cypern. Du bliver en del af en dynamisk organisation med et moderne arbejdsmiljø og mulighed for at opleve den solrige middelhavsø Cypern. Udover værdifuld international erhvervserfaring får du mulighed for at udforske en kultur med stærke traditioner, smukke strande og en afslappet livsstil.

Kvalifikationer

  • Du taler dansk og er komfortabel med at tale og skrive engelsk

  • Du har gode computerfærdigheder

  • Interesse for gaming er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Benefits

  • Fast månedsløn med attraktivt bonussystem

  • Betalt træning og onboarding

  • Relocation‑pakke med flere muligheder:

    • Relocation‑support for kandidater, der flytter til Cypern

    • Mulighed for at modtage €1.500 ved selv at arrangere bolig

    • Alternativ løsning med flykompensation op til €300 og firmabolig i op til to måneder

  • Fordelagtigt skattesystem med 0 % indkomstskat op til €19.500 pr. år

  • Rabatter og tilbud hos lokale restauranter, caféer, fitnesscentre m.m.

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder

  • Moderne, nyrenoveret og centralt beliggende kontor

  • Internationalt arbejdsmiljø

  • Hjælp til administration såsom åbning af bankkonto og migration

  • Månedlige aktivitetsdage, hvor du kan udforske Cypern

  • Support fra teamledere, HR og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

Hvorfor arbejde internationalt?

Et job i en international virksomhed inden for gaming, IT og tech kan åbne døren til betydelige karrieremuligheder. Du får erfaring, der styrker dit CV, udvider dine kompetencer og gør dig attraktiv for fremtidige arbejdsgivere. Samtidig får du mulighed for personlig udvikling og en unik oplevelse i et nyt land.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Kontakt os og bliv en del af vores spændende team på Cypern!

Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

būvstrādniekus darbam būvniecības objektos.

 

Darba pienākumos ietilpst dažādu palīgdarbu veikšana būvobjektā, vienkāršu zemes darbu izpilde, celtniecības materiālu un palīgmateriālu pārvietošana, kā arī būvjavu un betona sastāvu sagatavošana. Darbiniekam būs jāpalīdz būvkonstrukciju uzstādīšanā un demontāžā, jāveic vienkārši mūrēšanas un virsmu sagatavošanas darbi, kā arī jānodrošina būvgružu savākšana un teritorijas sakārtošana.

Darbs paredz arī rokas un vienkāršu elektrisko instrumentu izmantošanu, kā arī pieredzējuša speciālista vadībā vienkāršu nojaukšanas, remonta un apdares darbu veikšanu, tostarp apmetuma labošanas, grīdu pamatņu sagatavošanas, koka konstrukciju izbūves un krāsošanas darbus. Darba pienākumi var ietvert arī citus vienkāršus ēku, dzīvojamo, saimniecības vai ražošanas ēku remonta darbus.

No kandidātiem sagaidām atbildīgu attieksmi pret darbu, spēju strādāt komandā un ievērot darba drošības prasības. 

Uzņēmums piedāvā stabilu darbu un regulāru atalgojumu, nodrošina darbam nepieciešamo aprīkojumu, kā arī sniedz profesionālās izaugsmes iespējas un darbu draudzīgā kolektīvā.

French-speaking Sales Executive - Industrial Automation
jobs.description:
Native French speaker, fully remote

Work tasks: Condor Automation is a growing company selling to industrial customers all over Europe. We help factories keep their machines running by finding the automation parts they urgently need: PLCs, HMIs, drives, servo drives, motors, electronic boards and sensors from brands such as Siemens, Omron, Allen Bradley, Fanuc, Mitsubishi, Yaskawa, Schneider and ABB. Our speciality is the obsolete and hard-to-find parts that local distributors can't supply. We are looking for an ambitious French-speaking Sales Executive to help us grow in France and Belgium. This is a real chance to grow with the company: your results will be seen, valued and rewarded. You will: - Find and contact new B2B customers (factories, maintenance teams, OEMs and integrators) by phone and email - Follow up enquiries and quotes and close sales - Build long-term relationships with existing customers - Work closely with the purchasing team to offer fast and competitive quotes - Keep customer and sales activity up to date in our CRM (Odoo)

We offer: - EUR 2,500 gross monthly salary + uncapped commission - there is no limit to what you can earn - Flexible hours: organise your day around your life, while covering our customers' needs - A real work-family balance, with a team that supports you when life happens - Work from home, anywhere in Estonia - 100% remote - Full training on our products, sales techniques and tools - A stable, long-term role with real room to grow as the company grows We are a small, international team spread across the UK, Italy and Spain. We believe people do their best work when their life outside work is looked after too. If you are a parent, you can give your best at work knowing the team has your back when something comes up at home.

Other requirements: The team works in English; you will speak to customers in French. - Native French (essential) - Good working English to communicate with the team - Proven experience in B2B sales of industrial, electrical or automation products - An existing network of industrial customers in France or Belgium is a strong advantage - Confident on the phone and good at following up - Organised, proactive and comfortable working remotely and independently - Technical knowledge of industrial automation is a plus - we will train you on our products - Resident in Estonia

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern, Frontend (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.



This internship will take place from May 24 - August 13 or June 14 - September 3 (based on your summer schedule) and you will need to be able to work out of our SF or NY office during this time.



Please only apply to the internship role that best fits your interest / experience. Multiple applications may result in delayed review of your application.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Ship frontend features to real users. Build and launch production UI on Notion’s web client, from marketplace and seller surfaces to permissions and sharing controls, partnering with designers, PMs, and senior engineers.

 - Strengthen the foundation other teams build on. Contribute to shared components, product primitives, and tooling so engineers across Notion can build faster and more consistently.

 - Make Notion performant, scalable, and accessible. Use real metrics to find and fix problems in load time, responsiveness, and accessibility on the web client.

 - Help people discover, install, and use products from Notion and its ecosystem, and control who can see and do what. Work on distribution surfaces for creators, consultants, and partners, and on interfaces for access across pages, databases, teams, groups, and guests.

 - Own a scoped project from design to launch. Measure its impact and present what you learned to your team and partners.




QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or another related field. Must graduate before Summer 2028.

 - Working toward proficiency in React / TypeScript

 - Previous internship experience.

 - You find large challenges exciting and enjoy discovering problems as much as solving them.

 - You are able to problem-solve and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

This internship will take place from May 24 - August 13 or June 14 - September 3 (based on your summer schedule) and you will need to be able to work out of our SF or NY office during this time.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Thoughtful problem-solving: For you, problem-solving starts with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You can decompose tricky problems and work towards a clean solution, by yourself or with teammates. You're comfortable asking for help when you get stuck.

 - Put users first: You think critically about the implications of what you're building, and how it shapes real people's lives. You understand that reach comes with responsibility for our impact—good and bad.

 - Not ideological about technology: To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go.

 - Empathetic communication: You communicate nuanced ideas clearly, whether you're explaining technical decisions in writing or brainstorming in real time. In disagreements, you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and compromise when needed.

 - Team player: For you, work isn't a solo endeavor. You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to accomplish shared goals, and you care about learning, growing, and helping others to do the same.

 - AI enthusiast: You have built or prototyped features with AI technologies (LLMs, Embeddings, ML) and are interested in learning more.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have expertise with specific technologies that are part of our stack, including TypeScript and React.

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.

 - You have interests outside of technology, such as in art, history, or social sciences.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated hourly range for this role is $57/hr for Bachelors and $61/hr for Master’s.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Opérateur technique - parc de loisirs CDI 35H F/H - KOEZIO LYON
jobs.description: Tes FUTURES responsabilités chez koezio : Ton métier. ? c'est tous les jours différent ou presque !   Des activités du parc, en passant par les travaux, réparations sur le bâtiment, notre Opérateur technique joue un rôle clé : celui de garantir le bon fonctionnement et le niveau de qualité optimal de l'ensemble des installations du groupe Koezio. Il œuvre ainsi quotidiennement à faire vivre une expérience mémorable à nos clients en toute sécurité. Il place au premier plan les meilleures pratiques en matière de santé et de sécurité dans tous les travaux effectués, en veillant au respect de toutes les normes et réglementations.   Ton rôle consiste à :  - Réaliser la maintenance curative et préventive des équipements dans le respect des procédures et du temps imparti - Anticiper les réglages préventifs (chauffage et éclairages extérieurs.) - Organiser, avec le Responsable Technique et Sécurité, les gros nettoyages pour garantir la tenue et la sécurité du site - Organiser, en lien avec le Responsable Technique et Sécurité, ton planning hebdomadaire de réparation et maintenance en fonction des priorités - Analyser, proposer et soutenir l'amélioration continue en apprenant des pannes, en proposant des suggestions d'amélioration et en communiquant clairement avec le RTS - Prendre des initiatives adaptées, utiles au bon fonctionnement des équipements et en référer au ResponsableTechnique et Sécurité - Gérer les chantiers internes et externes en organisant, anticipant, planifiant et réalisant tous les petits ou gros chantiers sur le site en fonction des priorités définies par ou avec le Responsable Technique et Sécurité - Accompagner et participer aux chantiers ponctuels : modifications, nouvelles attractions, améliorations...  En tant que membre à part entière de l'équipe du parc, tu participeras activement à son bon fonctionnement et seras amené à assurer les missions suivantes : - Accueillir et conseiller nos visiteurs. Tu seras la 1ère personne avec qui ils seront en contact. L'occasion de montrer ton plus beau sourire pour leur faire vivre un moment unique ! - Participer à l'animation du parc, et à l'orgnaisation du service en salle et au bar. - Dynamiser le commerce, en assurant la mise en place et la vente des produits ainsi que l'entretien du point de vente, afin qu'il soit le plus attractif et suscite l'envie de nos visiteurs !Tu es dynamique, débrouillard, organisé et tu ne manques jamais d'une touche d'humour pour égayer tes journées ! On te surnomme "Bob le Bricoleur" ? Réparer, entretenir, améliorer. Rien ne te fait peur ! Tu as le sens pratique, tu es habile de tes mains et tu trouves toujours une solution à chaque problème. Une première expérience dans un parc d'attractions ou de loisirs serait un vrai plus, mais ta motivation, ton bon sens et ton envie d'apprendre feront toute la différence !   Tu te reconnais dans ce portrait ? Alors, ce poste est fait pour toi !

jobs.title: Fast ufaglært afløser til team hos respiratorbruger i Vodskov
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde 1:1 med din arbejdsleder og har du mulighed for at tage vagter med kort varsel, kan du være den rigtige person til denne stilling. 

Som respiratorisk hjælper får du et meningsfuldt job med et stort ansvar, for at din arbejdsleders liv, som et svært fysisk handicappet menneske med muskelsvind, kan fungere. 

Arbejdsleder er en kvinde på 74 år, der søger en fast afløser til respiratorisk overvågning, personlig pleje, praktisk hjælp og ledsagelse. 

•       Du kan tilhøre alle aldersgrupper og begge køn.

•       Du er rolig, ansvarsfuld og mødestabil.

•       Du kan udføre de daglige arbejdsopgaver i et respektfuldt samarbejde.

•       Du har selv et godt liv, med interesse for mennesker og en god indlevelsesevne. 

•       Du har en udpræget praktisk sans og er god til rutiner.

•       Du ryger ikke.

•       Du har kørekort B, kørerutine og tør køre en stor bil.

•       Du vil fremvise din straffeattest.

Inden du får selvstændige vagter, vil du blive grundigt oplært i både det plejemæssige og det respiratoriske. Efter endt oplæring tilbydes du akutte vagter ved sygefravær samt afløsning i ferieperioder. Vagterne vil være på skiftende ugedage – også på skæve helligdage.  For at kunne opretholde rutine i de respiratoriske opgaver, vil du få en fast vagt hver 4. lørdag.

Stillingen er ufaglært, med en grundtimeløn på 161,87 kr. Der gives tillæg for vagter på lørdage, søndage og helligdage, desuden gives der arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg aften og nat. BPA Nord er arbejdsgiver.

Send din ansøgning i e-mail, med en beskrivelse af dig selv, dit cv og et vellignende foto. Ansøgningen sendes til: LK@bpa-nord.dk . Eventuelle spørgsmål rettes også hertil.

Den seneste frist for ansøgning er d. 1/12 - 26, men søg gerne før. Samtaler afholdes løbende og stillingen besættes når den rette person er fundet. Er du ikke inviteret til en personlig samtale inden d. 15/12 – 26, er stillingen besat til anden side.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

This is an opportunity to join Notion's TPM organization as a key partner to our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) leadership. You'll work hand-in-hand with the most senior engineering, product, and design leaders at Notion to help run the programs and operating rhythms that keep EPD focused, aligned, and shipping. You'll own a portfolio of programs that spans internal engineering initiatives as well as cross-functional, externally facing efforts with partners across Go-to-Market, Marketing, Support, and beyond, ensuring that we meet the ever-growing expectations of our global user base.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Work closely with senior EPD leaders to drive multiple concurrent programs, from internal engineering initiatives (platform, infrastructure, quality, and developer productivity) to external, cross-functional programs such as major launches and customer-facing commitments

 - Combine long-term vision with near-term execution: be accountable for overall delivery, including prioritization, success criteria, and program communications in coordination with your partners

 - Help design and run EPD's operating cadence, including planning cycles, goal-setting, roadmap reviews, leadership syncs, and business reviews

 - Act as a connector across EPD and the broader company, bringing the right people together, driving decisions to closure, and making sure follow-through happens

 - Prepare clear, concise materials for leadership, including status updates, decision docs, and executive summaries that turn complexity into clarity

 - Monitor program status, proactively identify and communicate issues / risks, and unblock work wherever possible

 - Take on high-priority, ambiguous special projects for EPD leadership and drive them from problem definition to outcome

 - Forge strong partnerships with technical and business leaders across the company, ensuring that team resource investments align with company priorities

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of technical program management experience at a technology company, or in an equivalent technical or operational capacity, delivering clear and impactful results

 - Proven track record of running multiple complex, cross-functional programs at once, from inception to delivery

 - Enjoy solving hard problems and can turn incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs into action plans and drive them to impact

 - Strong technical fluency: you can go deep with engineers on systems and tradeoffs, and translate them for non-technical audiences

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with experience creating executive-ready updates, narratives, and decision docs

 - Strategic thinking and sound judgment: you can see the big picture, prioritize ruthlessly, and know when to escalate

 - Experience designing and running operating rhythms, such as planning, OKRs, leadership meetings, and reviews, for a growing organization

 - Builder mentality and an automation-first instinct: you'd rather script, automate, or build a lightweight tool than run the same process by hand twice, and you bring that bias to every program and operating rhythm you own

jobs.title: Account Executive, Growth (EMEA)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. As an Account Executive at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role is specifically based in London. We’re looking for someone who can work from our London office in Shoreditch 3 days per week (Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays), as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region. 

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly and annual targets

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

What we're looking for

 - 5+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling to a technical audience; bonus if you have previous experience working with a collaboration or developer tool

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms 

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

jobs.title: High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor is a member of the Student Support Team and shares responsibility for student wellbeing, inclusion and mental health across the High School. The role provides direct counselling, psychological support, consultation, and system-level guidance to students, families and staff, with particular attention to students who are socially, emotionally or psychologically vulnerable. Working hours and days are flexible and can be arranged to fit your existing schedule. You have the freedom to allocate your working hours across the week in a way that suits your availability while meeting the needs of students and the school.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide individual social-emotional counselling to students aged 15–19, supporting their mental health, resilience, relationships and academic wellbeing.

  • Design and implement preventive and systemic interventions at class and year-group levels to promote student wellbeing and positive group dynamics.

  • Develop, implement and review individual student support plans in alignment with the IB Access and Inclusion Policy.

  • Collaborate with the student wellbeing team, student support staff, teachers and parents to coordinate appropriate support.

  • Guide students and families through the Danish public and private healthcare and youth support systems, including PPR, specialist clinics and pathways to diagnostic assessment.

  • Prepare professional referrals and supporting documentation for external assessments, including neuropsychological or psychiatric evaluations, within the scope of professional competence.

  • Follow safeguarding, confidentiality and data protection requirements; identify students requiring specialist intervention and coordinate appropriate follow-up and support.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Relevant qualifications and training in psychology, counselling or social-emotional support. A qualification as a psychologist, including assessment and diagnosis, is preferred; demonstrated expertise in social-emotional counselling will also be considered.

  • Knowledge of the Danish healthcare and youth support systems, including PPR.

  • Experience with psychological screening and assessment tools such as WISC, WAIS, BASC, and BRIEF is an advantage.

  • Experience working within the International Baccalaureate (IB) system is desirable but not required.

  • Reports to: High School Principal / Programme Principal

  • Position: Part-time (50%)

  • Start date: January 2027, or by agreement

jobs.title: Fortegaardens private plejecenter søger en fast aftenvagt.
jobs.description:
Er du uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent og funger du arbejdsmæssigt bedst om aftenen?

Vil du være med til at skabe en god hverdag, med hyggelige aftenstunder for vores beboere?

Kan du lide at sætte din faglighed i spil hver dag? Samt være en del af fællesskabet, hvor tværfaglig sparring er en del af hverdagen?

Så er du måske vores nye aftenvagt .

 

Plejecenter Fortegaarden er en selvejende institution, beliggende i Risskov, tæt ved letbanen og busforbindelser og med gratis parkering. Vi har i alt 50 lejligheder, der er fordelt på 5 bo-enheder med 10 boliger i hver, hvor du primært bliver tilknyttet en enkelt bo-enhed, og hvor der også er ansat både sygeplejerske, terapeuter, rengøringspersonale samt andet sosu-uddannet personale. Via det daglige, tværfaglige samarbejde og planlagte borgergennemgange er der derfor rig mulighed for sparring.

 

Som aftenvagt vil du blive en del af et aftenvagtsteam på i alt 8, der er fordelt på de 5 bo-enheder, hvoraf én i teamet er ansvarshavende social-og sundhedsassistent. Dine arbejdsdage vil som udgangspunkt være mandag og tirsdag samt med weekendvagt i ulige uger.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at stillingen ligger inden for det døgndækkede område, og vil fortrinsvis at være i aftenvagt, men der vil på en 12 ugers plan forekomme 2 vagter, der vil ligge i et andet vagtlag efter aftale.

 

Kandidatens profil:

·       Du er autoriseret social-og sundhedsassistent.

·       Du arbejder helhedsorienteret og personcentreret med udgangspunkt i borgernes mål og ressourcer og med rehabilitering for øje.

·       Du er spontan og kreativ i dit arbejde, og har hjertet på rette sted.

·       Du er engageret og brænder du for at gøre en forskel i ældre menneskers hverdag og liv.

·       Du udforsker muligheder, ser ikke begrænsninger i en travl hverdag?

·       Du har et godt overblik og kan håndtere en varieret arbejdsdag.

·       Du kan lide faglige udfordringer, men er samtidig bevidst om egne kompetencer.

·       Du har et anerkendende menneskesyn, og i dit arbejde er du altid den bedste udgave af dig og din faglighed.

·       Du er fleksibel og langtidsfrisk.

·       Du har forståelsen for vigtigheden af den rette dokumentation, så kendskab til og anvendelse af CURA eller anden elektronisk journalføring vil være en fordel

·       Du taler og skriver forståeligt dansk

 

Om Fortegaarden:

Vores kerneopgave er: ”Fortegaarden - et meningsfuldt og attraktivt senior fælleskabe”. Her trives fællesskab og god vilje, vi er klar til udfordringer og vi kan se os selv leve her som ældre.

Hos os er vi alle med til at bidrage til det gode arbejdsmiljø. Vi vil skabe gode relationer med hinanden, både kollegaer imellem, til vores beboere og deres pårørende. Vi passer på hinanden i hverdagen, griner sammen men kan også være alvorlige når det kræves, og tør snakke om det der er svært.

Du skal derfor vælge/gribe muligheden for at arbejde hos os, da vi:

 

·       Kan tilbyde dig et spændende og selvstændigt job, hvor tværfaglig sparring, vidensdeling og nysgerrighed er en naturlig del hverdagen.

·       Har mange forskellige kompetencer, som vi bruger aktivt i hverdag med borgerne.

·       Prioriterer ledelsesmæssig opbakning og nærvær

·       Kan lide vores målgruppe, vi kan lide hinanden, og vi kan lide de udfordringer, der er på et plejecenter, fordi vi står sammen og tager et fælles ansvar for det gode arbejdsmiljø.

 

 

Ved ansættelse på Plejecenter Fortegaarden, får du adgang til fitness/træningsfaciliteter samt tilbudt en sundhedsforsikring, tilbydes flere årlige, sociale arrangementer, er en del af frugt- og kaffe/the ordning samt får rabat i Caféen.

Ansættelse pr. 1/01 2027 eller hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder løbende samtaler og slår til, når den rette kandidat har præsenteret sig.

Løn efter overenskomst og en kommende løntilpasning efter kompetencer.

Vil du høre mere om stillingen og Fortegaarden, kan du kontakte daglig leder Tine de Place, tlf. 5154 0634 eller daglig leder Karin Fenger Ellekrog, tlf. 5114 0810

jobs.description: Assistant(e) / Administratif des ventesRésumé du poste :FVS Entertainment, basé près de l'aéroport Paris-CDG, est un fournisseur de contenus audiovisuels et de solutions techniques pour les compagnies aériennes (appelé Content Service Provider). Pour garantir la bonne lecture des contenus à bord (films, séries, musique, etc.), FVS alimente les systèmes embarqués via des fichiers Excel et plateformes spécifiques, propres à chaque compagnie et système. Chaque compagnie renouvelle sa programmation par cycle (mensuel, bimestriel, trimestriel), avec des volumes de contenus variables selon les périodes. Maîtrise avancée des outils bureautiques, notamment Excel.- Aisance informatique générale (manipulation de fichiers, logiciels variés).- Sens de l'organisation et rigueur dans le traitement des données.- Aisance relationnelle, esprit d'équipe, capacité à coordonner les parties prenantes internes et externes.- Autonomie, réactivité et capacité à gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle.- Une appétence pour le cinéma, les séries et/ou l'aviation est un vrai plus !Ce que nous offrons- Une ambiance bienveillante et familiale, au sein d'une PME à taille humaine avec un esprit startup.- L'Excel deviendra ton meilleur allié.- L'anglais sera ton outil quotidien pour communiquer avec nos partenaires à l'international.- Des missions où ta rigueur fera la différence.- Horaires : 9h00 - 12h30 / 13h30 - 17h00FVS s'engage en faveur de l'égalité des chances et de la diversité. Toutes les candidatures sont étudiées sur la base des compétences et des qualifications requises pour le poste.

jobs.title: INTERNATIONAL JOURNALISTS & MEDIA PROJECT MANAGERS
jobs.description:
Factspilot.com – European Media Network

MinBy™ | Denmark

Journalism · Fact-checking · Artificial Intelligence · European Cooperation

WORK WITH US FROM YOUR OWN EU COUNTRY

Are you an experienced journalist, freelance journalist or media project manager living in an EU country outside Denmark?Do you have professional knowledge of your national media industry, established contacts and an interest in international journalism?

We would like to hear from you.MinBy™ is seeking experienced and independent media professionals to help establish and develop Factspilot.com, an international media and technology initiative.Our ambition is to build a European network of locally based journalists, media professionals and project coordinators working together across national borders.We are particularly interested in candidates who already understand their own country's media landscape and can contribute from the beginning.You will work from your own country. Relocation to Denmark is not required.

ABOUT FACTSPILOT.COMFactspilot.com is an international initiative developed by MinBy™, a Danish digital media network comprising 1,522 ultra-local media outlets across Denmark's 98 municipalities, alongside a portfolio of specialised digital magazine concepts.

Factspilot aims to develop a scalable European media infrastructure combining:

  • Independent journalism and news production.

  • Fact-checking, source verification and documentation.

  • Artificial intelligence and editorial technology.

  • Automated translation and multilingual publishing.

  • International news collection and distribution.

  • Cooperation between journalists and media organisations across Europe.

Our ambition is to connect national and local journalistic expertise with a shared international platform.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are recruiting candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas.

1. FREELANCE JOURNALISTS / MEDIA PARTNERS

We are looking for experienced freelance journalists interested in contributing to Factspilot's development in their own countries.

Your potential responsibilities include:

  • Researching and producing journalistic content.

  • Identifying reliable national and regional news sources.

  • Conducting fact-checking and source verification.

  • Establishing relationships with local journalists, editors and newsrooms.

  • Contributing to cross-border journalism and multilingual publishing.

  • Helping develop Factspilot's national media network.

You may already be working independently, seeking new assignments or interested in becoming part of a larger international media initiative.

You do not need to own a company to apply.

2. JOURNALISTS / EDITORS / MEDIA PROFESSIONALS

We are seeking journalists and media professionals with practical experience and strong knowledge of their national media environment.

Relevant backgrounds include:

  • Journalism and editorial production.

  • Investigative journalism and research.

  • Fact-checking and verification.

  • Digital publishing and news distribution.

  • Editorial coordination and media development.

We particularly value candidates who understand their country's media structures, professional standards and relevant sources.

3. MEDIA PROJECT MANAGERS / NATIONAL COORDINATORS

We are also seeking experienced project managers who can contribute to establishing and coordinating Factspilot's activities in their own countries.

Your potential responsibilities include:

  • Identifying relevant journalists and media contacts.

  • Building national professional networks.

  • Developing international cooperation opportunities.

  • Coordinating local project activities.

  • Contributing to project planning, budgets and implementation.

  • Supporting European partnerships and potential funding applications.

Experience with international media projects, European cooperation or EU funding programmes is an advantage.

YOUR LOCAL EXPERIENCE IS OUR PRIORITY

We are particularly interested in applicants who:

  • Live in an EU Member State outside Denmark.

  • Have professional experience in journalism, media or project management.

  • Understand their national media industry.

  • Have relevant professional contacts and relationships.

  • Speak and write the language of their country fluently.

  • Can communicate professionally in English.

  • Work independently and take responsibility for results.

  • Are comfortable using modern digital tools and AI-supported workflows.

  • Are interested in international cooperation and long-term project development.

An established professional network and practical experience may be more important than formal qualifications.

EUROPEAN PROJECT DEVELOPMENT

Factspilot is exploring opportunities for international project financing, including the European Union's Creative Europe – Journalism Partnerships programme.

Selected candidates may contribute to the development of European cooperation projects, including the identification of national partners, editorial activities and project coordination.

Experience with EU programmes or international project funding is particularly relevant for project management candidates, but is not required for journalists.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer the opportunity to participate in the development of an ambitious international media initiative from an early stage.

Depending on your professional background and the project's development, opportunities may include:

  • Journalism and editorial assignments.

  • Fact-checking and research activities.

  • National media coordination.

  • International project development.

  • Participation in European media cooperation.

  • Longer-term professional collaboration.

You will have the opportunity to contribute your existing expertise while working from your own country.

WORK LOCATION AND EMPLOYMENT CONDITIONS

Location: Your country of residence within the European Union, excluding Denmark.Work arrangement: Remote, with activities carried out locally in your own country.Professional profiles: Journalists, freelance journalists, editors, media professionals and project managers.Employment and cooperation: Depending on the role, opportunities may include employment or paid freelance and project-based assignments.

jobs.title: WE ARE HIRING – CLEANING SUPERVISOR
jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRING – CLEANING SUPERVISOR

Join the REMA GROUP Team!

Location: Copenhagen & Greater Copenhagen

Are you our new Cleaning Supervisor?

At REMA GROUP, we believe that professional cleaning is about much more than just clean surroundings. It's about people, responsibility, trust, and delivering quality that our clients can rely on every single day.

We take pride in our work, our employees, and the long-term relationships we build with our clients.

As we continue to develop our business, we are looking for an experienced, dedicated, and hands-on Cleaning Supervisor who shares our values and wants to become an important part of the REMA GROUP team.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just supervise cleaning operations, but takes ownership, leads by example, and understands that excellent service starts with motivated employees and attention to detail.

Does that sound like you? Then we would love to hear from you!

YOUR ROLE AT REMA GROUP

As our new Cleaning Supervisor, you will have an important role in ensuring that our daily cleaning operations run smoothly and that our clients consistently receive the high standards they expect from REMA GROUP.

You will be the link between our cleaning teams, our clients, and our management.

Your role will involve both practical supervision and daily coordination, and we expect you to be visible, approachable, and actively involved in maintaining our quality standards.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Planning, coordinating, and supervising daily cleaning operations across our client locations.

  • Leading, motivating, and supporting our cleaning employees.

  • Training and guiding employees in professional cleaning methods, hygiene, and safe working procedures.

  • Performing regular quality inspections and ensuring that our cleaning standards are consistently maintained.

  • Following up on quality issues and making sure improvements are implemented.

  • Ensuring that cleaning products, equipment, and materials are used correctly and responsibly.

  • Maintaining relevant documentation, quality reports, and operational follow-up.

  • Building positive relationships with clients and ensuring professional communication.

  • Supporting efficient daily operations while maintaining our commitment to quality, service, and sustainability.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

At REMA GROUP, we value attitude, responsibility, and professional pride.

We are looking for a supervisor who enjoys working with people, knows how to create structure in a busy working day, and understands the importance of being both a strong team leader and a reliable representative of our company.

We expect you to:

  • Have solid experience within professional or commercial cleaning.

  • Have previous experience as a Cleaning Supervisor, Team Leader, or in a similar position.

  • Be confident in planning, organizing, and supervising cleaning operations.

  • Have a natural ability to motivate, train, and support employees.

  • Be quality-conscious and have a strong eye for detail.

  • Be independent, reliable, flexible, and solution-oriented.

  • Have a positive attitude and take responsibility for your work.

  • Be comfortable communicating with both employees and clients.

  • Be able to communicate professionally in English.

  • Be willing to work flexible hours when required.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who takes pride in doing things properly and who wants to make a positive difference every day.

WHY JOIN REMA GROUP?

We want our employees to feel that they are part of something meaningful.

At REMA GROUP, we work with a strong focus on quality, responsibility, sustainability, and long-term partnerships.

Our ambition is to deliver professional cleaning solutions while reducing our environmental footprint through responsible product choices, efficient cleaning methods, and environmentally conscious working practices.

We believe that good results come from good people, clear communication, and mutual respect.

What we offer:

  • A full-time position in a professional and growing cleaning company.

  • An important role with real responsibility and influence on daily operations.

  • A varied working day across different client locations in Greater Copenhagen.

  • A supportive working environment where teamwork and mutual respect matter.

  • Opportunities to develop your professional and leadership skills.

  • Long-term career opportunities within REMA GROUP.

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience.

POSITION DETAILS

Position: Cleaning Supervisor – Full-time

Location: Copenhagen & Greater Copenhagen

Working hours: Flexible according to operational requirements. Occasional early morning, evening, night, and weekend work may be required.

Start date: As soon as possible or by agreement.

Salary: Based on qualifications and experience.

READY TO BECOME PART OF REMA GROUP?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career and become part of a company where quality, responsibility, and people come first?

Then we would be happy to receive your application.

Please send your CV and a short personal application to:

info@remagroup.dk

Email subject: Cleaning Supervisor – Copenhagen

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to welcoming the right person to the REMA GROUP team!

REMA GROUP

Green Heart. Green Footprints. Professional Cleaning.

IMPORTANT – APPLICATIONS BY EMAIL ONLY

Please note that we only accept written applications sent by email.

We kindly ask applicants not to contact us by phone regarding this position.

jobs.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
jobs.description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

jobs.title: To konsulenter til politisk og ledelsesmæssig betjening samt til understøttelse af reformimplementering
jobs.description:
Trives du med en hverdag, hvor opgaverne er komplekse, varierede og tempoet er højt? Har du en skarp pen, et godt overblik og flair for politik og offentlig forvaltning? Og har du en god portion holdånd, en positiv grundindstilling og kan du arbejde selvstændigt? Så er du én af de to nye kollegaer, vi søger, til afdelingen Forebyggelse og Tværgående Koordinering i Center for Sundhed og Omsorg. 

Konkret søger vi to konsulenter, som skal indgå i teamet omkring centerledelsen og primært have opgaver indenfor politisk og ledelsesmæssig betjening på ældre- og sundhedsområderne samt opgaver i relation til understøttelse af reformimplementering.

Både sundheds- og omsorgsområdet undergår en rivende udvikling i disse år. Med både en national sundhedsreform og en ældrereform står centeret i en spændende tid, hvor sundheds- og omsorgsområderne skal fremtidssikres, mens der holdes fast i det allervigtigste: Tryghed for borgerne, en høj faglighed og et godt arbejdsmiljø for medarbejderne.

Den ene af de to stillinger, vi søger besat, vil primært løfte opgaver indenfor ældreområdet, som foruden politiske sager og ledelsesbetjening vil indebære opgaver indenfor administrativ understøttelse af en koordineret implementering af ældrereformens tiltag om bl.a. helhedspleje, mere selvbestemmelse, et tættere samspil med civilsamfundet samt generel forebyggelse på ældreområdet. 

Den anden af de to stillinger vil primært omhandle politisk og ledelsesmæssig betjening indenfor sundhedsområdet, herunder i forhold til implementering af sundhedsreformen, det tværsektorielle samarbejde med regionen, udarbejdelsen af en kommende nærsundhedsplan, samt ny folkesundhedslov og generelle kommunale sundhedsopgaver.

Om dig

Det er en væsentlig fordel, hvis du har kendskab til sundheds- og/eller ældreområdet, da det vil give dig et godt afsæt for at forstå og navigere i områdets opgaver, rammer og kompleksitet.

Du har en uddannelsesmæssig og/eller erhvervsmæssig erfaring og kompetencer i forhold til at varetage politisk og administrativ understøttelse.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund eller din erhvervserfaring gør, at du besidder evnen til at gå analytisk til en opgave, sætte dig ind i et større skriftligt materiale, og arbejde selvstændigt med en skriftlig opgave. Tidligere erfaring med betjening af politiske udvalg eller andre lignende beslutningsorganer er ikke et krav men en fordel.  

Hvem du er som person er mindst lige så vigtigt for os som din baggrund og erfaring. Du er udadvendt og formår at bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag – og du trives med at arbejde indenfor til tider korte frister.

Du trives med at veksle mellem de større, komplekse opgaver og de mindre, løbende opgaver i det daglige, såsom at sikre gode Power Point-slides eller dagsordner til interne møder i administrationen.

Endelig har du flair for at arbejde med brug af data og har en grundlæggende forståelse for økonomi.

Hvem er Forebyggelse og Tværgående Koordinering?

Forebyggelse og Tværgående Koordinering udgøres af cirka 35 fagkonsulenter. Medarbejderne arbejder selvstændigt med opgaver indenfor sundhedsfremme og forebyggelse for borgere i alle aldre, udvikling af ældreplejen, herunder ift. frit valg for borgerne, forebyggende hjemmebesøg, demens, hygiejne og kvalitet, uddannelse af elever og studerende, ensomhed, velfærdsteknologi og IT-administration, tilsyn, tværsektorielt samarbejde mm.

Medarbejdere har forskellige faglige baggrunde, men fælles for alle er, at vi samarbejder på tværs af forskellige fagområder og på tværs af sektorer. Opgavetyperne spænder også vidt og indebærer alt fra drift til udvikling og projektfacilitering, betjening af centerledelse, direktion og politisk fagudvalg, undervisning, administration mm.

De konsulenter, vi søger, vil indgå i afdelingens team omkring centerledelsen.  

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet:

Fællesnævneren for opgaverne, som skal løses i begge stillinger er, at du skal kunne give politisk og administrativ ledelse et oplyst grundlag at træffe beslutninger på af både strategisk og driftsnær karakter til gavn for en mere sammenhængende indsats af høj kvalitet for borgerne på Bornholm. Dette indebærer blandt andet:

- Produktion af politiske dagsordener og andre skriftlige oplæg til hhv. politisk og administrativ ledelse indenfor hhv. ældreområdet og sundhedsområdet

- Centralt for denne understøttelse er at kunne formulere hhv. problemstilling samt beskrivelse af forskellige scenarier/løsningsmuligheder og konsekvenser heraf

- Afsøgning af faglig viden, lovgivning mm. i samarbejde med kollegaer

- Arbejde tæt sammen med andre forvaltninger i kommunen om tværgående sager

- Indgå i samarbejde med eksterne parter, såsom Bornholms Hospital, andre kommuner, alment praktiserende læger, civilsamfundsorganisationer mm.

Du kan godt glæde dig

Vi er en flad, rummelig organisation med højt til loftet. Vi har en uhøjtidelig, om end professionel arbejdsform, hvor vi forsøger at udvikle os i fællesskab. Vi vægter faglighed højt, ligesom engagement, samarbejde, fleksibilitet og hverdagsinnovation er vigtige nøgleord for vores arbejde.

Du bedes i din ansøgning angive, om du har særlig interesse i stillingen på ældreområdet eller i stillingen på sundhedsområdet. Hvis du kan se dig selv i begge stillinger, så kan du også angive det.

Der kan blive to runder af samtaler, som vil finde sted i uge 51. Herudover kan der blive anvendt en skriveprøve forud for samtalen med ansættelsesudvalget.  

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst og efter principperne i lokal løndannelse.

Der vil blive indhentet straffeattest ved ansættelse.

Stillingerne er på 37 timer pr. uge.

jobs.title: Experienced Welder / Tack Welder for Weekend Day Shift
jobs.description:
Do you have solid experience in welding and tack welding, and do you thrive in a structured environment with clear expectations and a strong focus on quality and precision? At Give Steel A/S, you will become an important part of our weekend day shift production team, where your contribution helps ensure strong, documented steel structures.

Why Choose Us?

You will become part of a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company with a strong focus on quality, safety, and responsible production. We are committed to employee development and offer a workplace with freedom under responsibility, well-organised working conditions, and opportunities for professional growth.

You will be employed under the Danish Collective Agreement for the Industry Sector (Industriens Overenskomst). In addition, we offer private health insurance and the option to join our canteen scheme.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will join a team manufacturing load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. The work is carried out on the weekend day shift, where you will follow established work procedures and contribute to ensuring tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality.

Your working hours will be from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Tack welding and welding steel structures based on technical drawings and work instructions
  • Preparing components and checking measurements, fit, and quality
  • Carrying out tasks with a systematic and thorough approach
  • Contributing to strong teamwork with colleagues in production
  • Complying with all applicable safety, quality, and documentation requirements

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced and reliable employee who works in a structured and detail-oriented manner. You thrive in a well-defined environment, can maintain an overview in a busy production setting, and take pride in delivering lasting, high-quality results.

We expect that you:

  • Have solid experience as a welder and/or tack welder
  • Work thoroughly, responsibly, and with a strong focus on quality
  • Can read and understand technical drawings
  • Are reliable and a team player
  • Contribute positively to a professional and safe working environment
  • Speak Danish and/or English
  • Live in Denmark within a reasonable commuting distance of Brande

We can provide certification in various welding methods, so it is not important whether you already hold welding certificates.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Head of Production, Tomas Slepavicius, at tsl@givesteel.com.

We would like to receive your CV, clearly outlining your relevant experience. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and we will remove the job advertisement once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company that develops, designs, manufactures, and erects load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. Quality, safety, and documentation are an integral part of our daily operations, while we also maintain a strong focus on CO₂ reduction and responsible production.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our daily work.

jobs.title: Vil du være den reparatør, der gør en synlig forskel i produktionen?

Hos Rul-let handler vedligehold ikke kun om at holde maskinerne i gang – men om at finde de løsninger, der gør hverdagen lettere, driften stærkere og produktionen endnu bedre. Hvis du trives med ansvar, teknik og frihed til at tænke selv, er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hos Rul-let producerer vi emballage til fødevarer, som bruges i både supermarkeder og industrikøkkener verden over. Vi er i gang med at opgradere vores tekniske setup og søger én ny kollega til vedligeholdelsesteamet med interesse for el, automatik, mekanik og maskinoptimering.

Uanset om du er mest til strøm eller stål, er det vigtigste, at du brænder for teknik, tager ansvar og har lyst til at se dine idéer blive til virkelighed. Du bliver en del af et lille team, hvor vi har ansvar for hver vores linjer, men aldrig står alene. Vi hjælper hinanden, deler erfaringer og lytter til gode forslag – også når de kommer fra værkstedsgulvet.

Dine opgaver

  • Vedligeholde og fejlfinde på mekanisk, elektrisk og pneumatisk udstyr

  • Skifte mellem produkter og materialer i produktionen

  • Bygge og optimere maskindele – gerne med dine egne løsninger

  • Bidrage med input, når vi investerer i nye maskiner og smartere løsninger

Du arbejder primært på daghold ca. 7.00 – 15.00, men du kan forvente aften- og weekendvagt ca. hver 4. uge, hvor weekendvagter er som tilkald. Til gengæld hjælper vi hinanden med bytning af vagter og fridage, så hverdagen også kan hænge sammen uden for arbejdet.

Hvem er du?Du har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og trives med ansvar. Du er nysgerrig, løsningsorienteret og går op i, at tingene virker – både i dag og i morgen. Måske har du en baggrund som automatiktekniker, elektriker, industritekniker, smed eller lignende, men vigtigst er, at du:

  • Har erfaring med automatiserede anlæg og teknisk vedligehold

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en god kollega

  • Taler dansk og forstår engelsk

  • Har lyst til at gøre en forskel – hver dag

Det tilbyder vi

  • En hverdag med variation, ansvar og tekniske udfordringer

  • Gode kolleger, en uformel tone og et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden

  • Frihed til at tænke nyt – og mulighed for at blive hørt, når du har en god idé

Er du klar til at blive en del af holdet?Så send din ansøgning og CV snarest. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

jobs.title: Reparatør til teknisk afdeling i ABENA Produktion
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde med fejlfinding, reparation og vedligehold på højteknologiske produktionsanlæg i en hverdag med faste rammer, dygtige kolleger og stor variation? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Du bliver en del af vores tekniske afdeling, hvor reparatører, elektrikere, teknikere og lærlinge arbejder tæt sammen om at holde produktionen kørende. Hos os møder du engagerede kolleger, høj faglighed og et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar for både opgaverne og hinanden.

Hos ABENA producerer vi hver dag over 3 millioner højkvalitets-bleer til både babyer og voksne. Produktionen foregår på avancerede maskinanlæg, der kræver teknisk forståelse, præcision og godt samarbejde på tværs af produktion og teknisk afdeling.

Om jobbet

Din hverdag bliver alsidig og teknisk udfordrende. Du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre stabil drift på vores produktionsanlæg, og du arbejder tæt sammen med både kollegerne i teknisk afdeling og medarbejderne i produktionen.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • fejlsøge, reparere og vedligeholde maskinanlæg

  • udføre forebyggende vedligehold

  • ombygge og tilpasse maskinanlæg

  • koordinere opgaver ved vedligeholdsstop

  • arbejde i vores IT-baserede vedligeholdssystem

  • deltage i omstillinger og klargøring

Vi er i udvikling og investerer løbende i nye maskiner og ny teknologi. Derfor får du gode muligheder for at udvikle dig fagligt og bringe din viden i spil i en moderne produktion.

Jobbet er primært på daghold. Derudover skal du være indstillet på at arbejde på aftenhold i gennemsnit ca. hver 6. eller 7. uge og have tilkaldevagt ca. hver 12. weekend. Der kan også forekomme perioder, hvor der er brug for din hjælp på natskiftet. 

Vi har stærkt fokus på sikkerhed. Hos os kommer sikkerhed altid først, både i måden vi arbejder på i produktionen, og i den måde vi passer på hinanden i hverdagen. Vi forventer, at du bidrager aktivt til et sikkert arbejdsmiljø.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi leder efter dig, der er fagligt stærk og trives med at være en del af et team, hvor vi løfter i flok.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har en relevant baggrund som fx smed, landbrugsmekaniker, automekaniker, automatikmekaniker eller lignende

  • har erfaring med vedligehold

  • har kendskab til MAG/TIG svejsning, drejebænk, tegningslæsning, lejemontage, systematisk fejlfinding og pneumatikstyring

  • arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret

  • tager ansvar og hjælper dine kolleger

  • taler og skriver dansk

Hvorfor vælge ABENA?

Hos ABENA Produktion får du et spændende og afvekslende job i en virksomhed, hvor vi prioriterer både faglighed og mennesker. Du bliver en del af en afdeling med godt arbejdsklima, engagerede kolleger og gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.

Vi lægger vægt på:

  • et stærkt fællesskab med samarbejde og godt humør

  • en moderne produktion med avancerede maskinanlæg

  • gode muligheder for udvikling og efteruddannelse

  • kantineordning, motionsrum og sundhedsordning

  • en arbejdsplads med tillid, retfærdighed og samarbejde

Hos ABENA skal det være trygt, rart og motiverende at gå på arbejde. Vi tror på ordentlighed, godt samarbejde og høj faglighed, og vi sætter en ære i at passe godt på hinanden, vores kunder og vores leverandører.

Er du vores nye kollega?

Send din ansøgning og CV snarest gennem vores ansøgningssystem. Vi behandler ansøgningerne efterhånden, som vi modtager dem, indtil vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Såfremt der er spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte vedligeholdelsesleder Bo Amdi Holm på tlf.: 51580560.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Rengøringsoperatør - fast aftenhold
jobs.description:
Er du interesseret i at blive en del af en moderne og førende maskinfabrik i vækst?Lige nu søger vi flere rengøringsoperatører til vores faste aftenhold, som vil være med til at sikre rene, ryddelige og sikre rammer på tværs af virksomheden.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Operations Support-team, som understøtter den daglige drift på tværs af virksomheden. Som rengøringsoperatør samarbejder du med kolleger fra flere afdelinger og bidrager til, at produktionsområder, fællesarealer og faciliteter fremstår rene, ryddelige og sikre.

Om jobbet

Din primære arbejdsfunktion er daglig rengøring af virksomhedens produktions- og industrilokaliteter. Som rengøringsoperatør får du en vigtig rolle i at sikre en høj rengøringsstandard på tværs af vores produktions- og fællesområder. Arbejdet udføres på fast aftenhold, hvor du i høj grad kan planlægge og gennemføre opgaverne uden at forstyrre den daglige produktion.

Dine opgaver vil variere, men vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Daglig rengøring af produktionsområder, værksteder, fællesarealer og øvrige faciliteter.

  • Rengøring af gulve, overflader, inventar og sanitære områder.

  • Håndtering af affald og opfyldning af rengørings- og forbrugsartikler.

  • Betjening, rengøring og dagligt tilsyn med rengøringsudstyr og -maskiner.

  • Deltagelse i 5S-arbejde og praktiske ad hoc-opgaver med relation til rengøring, orden og affaldshåndtering.

  • Arbejdet er praktisk og fysisk, og udføres både manuelt og ved hjælp af rengøringsmaskiner.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Arbejder grundigt, systematisk og med blik for detaljen.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, stabil og har en høj arbejdsmoral.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og selv tage initiativ til at løse opgaver.

  • Er en hjælpsom kollega og samarbejder godt med andre.

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, hygiejne og sikkerhed.

  • Kan følge rengøringsplaner, instruktioner og gældende sikkerhedsprocedurer.

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde og med at arbejde på aftenhold.

Faglige kvalifikationer

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at levere rengøring af høj kvalitet og er klar til at lære vores områder, udstyr og arbejdsgange at kende. Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har:

  • Erfaring med erhvervsrengøring, gerne fra en produktionsvirksomhed.

  • Kendskab til rengøringsmidler, dosering og sikker håndtering.

  • Erfaring med rengøringsmaskiner eller lyst til at lære at bruge dem.

  • Evne til at kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk og følge skriftlige instruktioner.

 Vi tilbyder

  • Et fast job på aftenhold i en veletableret produktionsvirksomhed.

  • Grundig oplæring i vores rengøringsrutiner, udstyr og sikkerhedsprocedurer.

  • Gode kolleger, ordnede forhold og attraktive medarbejderfordele.

 

Vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en veletableret, dansk, familieejet eksportvirksomhed, hvor relationerne vægtes højt. Aasted er i 2026 blevet en del af Piovan Group, hvilket giver nye perspektiver og muligheder som en del af en større international koncern.

Kulturen i Aasted er kendetegnet ved, at vi alle er motiverede og stolte af det, vi laver, hvilket skaber et stærkt sammenhold og engagement. Vi har en åben, ærlig og direkte tone og gør en dyd ud af at opføre os ordentligt i alt, hvad vi foretager os.

Vi arbejder kontinuerligt mod at være en inkluderende arbejdsplads med lige udviklingsmuligheder for alle vores medarbejdere. Vi tilbyder en attraktiv barselsordning, sociale arrangementer og en sund kantine ved Meyers Kantine.

Hos Aasted prioriterer vi et sund arbejdsmiljø og er derfor en røgfri arbejdsplads, hvilket betyder, at der ikke må ryges i arbejdstiden og på virksomhedens område.

 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send allerede nu din ansøgning og dit cv

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller blot vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at række ud til HR@aasted.eu.

Aasted ønsker at skabe en arbejdsplads med plads til alle.  Vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset køn og etnicitet, samt seksuel, politisk og kulturel orientering orientering til at søge job hos os.  

Du kan læse mere om os og vores arbejde her:  AASTED | Welcome to our world  

 

Aasted – en dansk pioner

Aasted har i mere end 100 år været markedsleder inden for udstyr og anlæg til chokoladeproduktion i hele verden. I porteføljen af kunder er både mindre, lokale virksomheder og flere af verdens største globale FMCG-spillere.

Vi er på en konstant rejse motiveret af en nysgerrighed, der har gjort os i stand til at retænke, hvad der hidtil har været kendt inden for chokoladeproduktion. Vi sætter spørgsmålstegn ved det umulige – og gør det muligt. Vi lancerer konstant en lang række banebrydende og patenterede løsninger til vores kunder og bidrager tik, at hver enkelt opnår deres unikke vision.

I Aasted er vi mere end 550 mennesker, der gennem passion, erfaring og ekspertise nytænker status quo.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
At Serve Robotics, weâre reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. Itâs designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. Weâre looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Accountant supports the company's accounting operations by maintaining accurate financial records, performing assigned close activities, and preparing financial reports. The role executes and monitors key accounting processes, partners with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve discrepancies, supports audits, and helps maintain compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and company policies.

JOB DUTIES

  • Oversee the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy.

  • Perform account reconciliations, including bank, accounts payable, and accounts receivable reconciliations, and resolve identified discrepancies.

  • Prepare and post journal entries and maintain an accurate and current general ledger.

  • Review, classify, and record expenses in accordance with company policies and applicable budget guidelines.

  • Oversee key accounting processes, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, inventory, accruals, and prepaid expenses.

  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and providing timely, accurate responses to requests.

  • Monitor accounting activities for compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and established company procedures.

  • Identify and recommend process improvements that strengthen controls and increase the efficiency and accuracy of accounting operations.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical accounting experience.

  • 5+ years of full accounting experience

  • Proficiency with accounting software such as Xero or NetSuite and intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, or GAAP, and a strong understanding of Sarbanes Oxley compliance processes, internal controls, and financial reporting requirements.

  • Strong organizational, time management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and partner effectively across teams.

  • High degree of accuracy and analytical ability, including the ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve accounting discrepancies and process inefficiencies.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Progress toward CPA certification.

  • Experience with a publicly traded company or public accounting firm.

  • Experience in a startup or other fast paced environment.

  • Experience with robotics, manufacturing, or technology companies, including exposure to inventory management or cost accounting processes.

  • Demonstrated ability to adapt and operate effectively in a dynamic, collaborative environment.
